comments: Excellent location, nice apartment with terrace, the hosts were very receptive, quiet street with a tram station very close
Super responsive day of check in, made sure we felt comfortable. Cheyenne and Sherley were amazing hosts!
Very strong smell of cigarette smoke permeated the apartment.

Disappointing, stressful & UNSAFE experience - not what you expect from a Superhost. I chose this place because it was listed as a Superhost, which builds a certain level of trust - unfortunately, that trust was misplaced. The layout shown did not match the actual property. I raised this immediately after check-in, but the host did not take it seriously, forcing me to escalate to Airbnb. After I reported it, the host asked me to vacate the next day. Even after Airbnb intervened, they refused to cooperate. I requested one extra day to arrange another stay, but that was also not accommodated. This completely disrupted my plans and caused unnecessary stress while traveling with my wife. Though I received one night free, it hardly compensates for the inconvenience. Communication was so insensitive that I had to insist all interactions happen via Airbnb support. Airbnb and even the host later acknowledged the issue (with messages to prove it). Would not recommend. Ever.

The price for 1 night was to high and the rest is good we left early morning at 5:40 to train station we had the train early morning. But the people in nearby restaurants and bar has too much noise all night long we could not sleep.

Dimi is a very communicative and accommodating host who made us feel  welcome immediately. The apartment is located in an area next to all the busy places, so it‘s more laid-back, but still everything is in direct proximity. Besides that, the flat has some nice furniture, kitchen equipment and everything else you‘d need for a short- or long-term stay.

I have so far booked eleven times through Airbnb and this was my worse experience and totally devoid of basic professionalism and personal touch that airbnb experiences normally provides. I booked this property and indicated one guest as my friend from Germany had not confirmed if he would join me. When my friend confirmed, I informed my host and asked if it has any cost implication. Instead of answering me straight, he was impolite in saying why did book for one guest and getting another guest. I explained to him and said that I was ready to pay extra if it needed. That is why I had asked him about the cost implication. He wrote and put on record that if I pay him 50 CHF more he would make my experience fabulous and he, finally, did it by not even meeting me for more than one minute during my stay for two nights after he came back one not from his duty late night.  His house is close to markets and you can find everything that you need but it is not so centrally located. You need to travel for two stations from the central station to reach his house. The room is indeed big and so is the bed. But it ends there. The kitchen is badly equipped and there is no one to tell you where are things kept and heat you can use and what not. No one to guide you how to go from there to city and other places to visit. I will neither stay ever again nor will I recommend anyone. I am sorry to say this and I also know that the host will turn defensive after reading this review as many other hosts do. Bent I need pt be honest with my experience and let people know that this is not a great place to stay.

Stephanie’s place was awesome! The apartment was very spacious, clean, and check-in was a breeze!  It was plenty big for 3 adults. It has a washer and dryer which we definitely used during our stay. There is a switch on the right hand side against the wall which must be flipped in order to turn it on.   The apartment had an iron, ironing board, hair dryer, some toiletries. You can also cook a meal in the apartment if you wish. Although no air conditioning, we left the windows open and the apartment has 2 oscillating pedestal fans. It is in a very busy area with restaurants, stores, a church (you can definitely hear the church bells but they didn’t bother us) bars, etc.  It was noisy when we were there on a Saturday night but it wasn’t too bad and not as noisy on Sunday and Monday night. We were so tired by the end of the day that it didn’t bother us at all.  Zurich HB which is the train station is only a 10 minute walk from the apartment. It was a wonderful stay!

Rather large apartment at the edge of Zurich. It had everything onr might need for longer stay.  Host was very friendly and responsive. Only minus could be finding a parking space, since it's streetparking in blue zones. But if you are travelling by bus, then there is no issue. Bus stop is 1 minute walk away.
His place worth a lot more than the price he’s asking for

The apartment is very well connected, with the Altstetten station at less than 5 mins walk and the bus stop even closer. Perfect for people that need to commute to the ETH Hönggerberg (direct connection in less than 20 minutes). The area is very well served with several grocery shops and restaurants, and you can easily reach to the Zurich main station in 10 minutes by train.  The apartment is bright, cozy, and all the amenities are accurately described in the listing. Lastly, Joao is a very nice host: funny and polite. Also very helpful every time I needed any indication or suggestion.  I had a great time staying with him in his apartment. I strongly recommend his place, especially for ETH visiting student or researcher.  Enrico
this apartments decor was to our  liking. clean and minimal and relaxing. the house had everything that was needed. hosts were communicative and prompt. would stay again!
I have stayed at Mergim’s before and will again — it is a beautiful apartment, in a great location, well supplied. Mergim is a gracious and responsive host.

Ensuite bathroom had very low water pressure in shower and shower is very dangerous to get in and out of.  Bathroom in the hallway has no sink and same dangerous shower.  Both bathrooms need to be updated.  Lighting in the area of the mailboxes is non existent, therefore making it quite dangerous in the dark
Had such an incredible time and anabel was such an accommodating and lovely host!

Tania's place initially seemed promising, but my stay turned out highly disappointing due to two major issues. The host dishonestly misrepresented the apartment's distance from the city center, causing inconvenience and questioning their integrity. Moreover, the shocking lack of cleanliness, with grimy floors, dust, cobwebs, and spiders, made me uncomfortable and raised maintenance concerns. Despite attempting to contact the host, they remained unresponsive, displaying unprofessional behavior. Overall, my experience was unsatisfactory, and I advise others to consider alternative accommodations. The host never took responsibility for any of these problems despite my messages with proof of it, so I had to solve it with the Airbnb team because she was violating the policies.

The apartment is exactly as pictured and described. It is conveniently located with a variety of shops and restaurants nearby. It is close to public transport and the neighbourhood feels safe. The bed is very comfortable and the apartment is warm and cosy.

Oliver was not there during our stay. His partner was the host for our weekend and she was very unprofessional. Our room wasn't ready when we got there and when we came back from dinner 2 hours later it still wasn't ready. We had to help her set up the bed and she wanted to talk to us for hours while we were clearly exhausted from our trip in and just wanted to rest.  No wifi signal upstairs where our room was, no trashcan or mirror in our bedroom (only in the hall bathroom that was shared with other guests). My husband and I got 1 towel each for our 3 night stay. The bathroom had no basic toiletries that usually come in an Airbnb (i.e. body wash, lotion, toothpaste, a hand towel, etc).  When I booked it for 2 people the price went up by over 65 USD. I think the value of what we got was low at the 1 person booking price, at 2 people it was quite outrageous. I know Switzerland is expensive but the service and space amenities we were received were no better than a private room at a hostel. Maybe it would have been better if Oliver himself was there, but overall really disappointed in the value of this trip's stay.

Great location all around - it was definitely surrounded by a lot of things to do. However, the place was dated and the older structure had some questionable stains and mildew smell. The bathroom has no shelf space for anything. The bath tub needs maintenance. The water didn’t drain well at all so it gathered around the curtain, which smelled like pee and is yellow at the bottom. I was so grossed out it was a relief to double book elsewhere for a night.  The listing needs to be changed to be upfront about laundry. There is nothing convenient around. The closest serviced laundry requires an appt which is days out and is closed early. The closest self service laundry is a 10 min tram ride away, requires cash where there’s no atm nearby, and takes about 2 hrs to complete. The task itself took our whole evening away. Don’t bother booking if you need laundry done during your trip.  Overall, great location for sure. But these major points made this place undesirable.

Unfortunately we did not have a nice stay at Ema house. Not a great fit for us personally and would not recommend this apartment as a family traveling with 2 year old. Check in process is not flexible and limited to a set time with a 30 minute check in process. A few things were missing from the apartment including baby bed which was confirmed a couple days prior. Had to wait for them to bring it and set it up. Couch is very uncomfortable to sit on and relax after a long day out and about. TV did not have any streaming options and only local channels. A comfortable couch and streaming tv are important to us as a traveling family with little one. Apartment in general was clean but have to say did not offer an inviting and comfy place to stay. For that reason we actually checked out a night early.

Do not book any airbnbs managed by Swiss Stay. I have been using Airbnb for over a decade and have never had an issue like this with a host. I booked a same day reservation and 5 hours later still did not have check-in instructions despite my reaching out multiple times. They wanted me to communicate with them outside of the Airbnb platform and I kept getting automated text responses and never could get ahold of an actual person. They claimed to have emailed me a check-in form that I would need to fill out prior to getting the access information. I never received the email and they did not reply to my follow up messages. By this point it was late at night so I ended up cancelling the reservation and Airbnb company kindly refunded me the money.
The images in the application do not reflect reality, in addition to the noise from the street and the air conditioner not working
Just fabulous for a visit to Zurich. It is so central but the balcony makes it feel in the countryside. Cannot recommend highly enough

The place itself is fine, but the check-in process was extremely frustrating and poorly organised. For example, there are two apartments with the same number (201) located only about 8 metres apart. I ended up standing for 10 minutes in front of the wrong apartment 201, which could easily be avoided with different numbers. Additionally, the lockbox is awkwardly placed inside the mailbox, making it very difficult to read the numbers. You need to stick your head into the mailbox.  The access instructions are sent via email, but the formatting is so poor that you have to zoom in just to read them properly. The whole checkin seems like they hate any clients.
Very convenient stay for a stop over in Zurich, close to train station and also walkable to the city centre

There were a lot of roadblocks in our stay for this Airbnb.  My friend and I only stayed for a night for our flight the next day. So we just needed some amenities and make sure our laundry gets done. - The washer was not in the unit. Unfortunately this listing did not specifically say that it was not in unit which was the reason why we booked it in the first place. It was in this basement area which felt kind of suspicious.  - Bodywash and shampoo were on its last legs when we were there. Bodywash wasn't specified on the bottle so I assume it is the nondescript liquid in the small pink bottle. - There was a musty smell in the room. - The communication has fast responses but was extremely slow and kind of frustrating when there was a problem to be solved (ie. body wash and check in).  - Check in instructions could be clearer. They missed announcing a step after the picking up the key, to go back to the front door to open it

The BnB was in a good location outside of the main city of Zurich but with good connections by tram or train to the city centre. The BnB was equipped with a full kitchen with cutlery, glasses and cups and a local spar (shop) was conveniently at the bottom of the appartments. The BnB also had two good sized balconys. A good catch for a stay in Zurich with friends and the host was great to recommend local places and answered questions fast!

Really nice and cosy apartment, located in a quiet green area. When I arrived at night it was a bit annoying dealing with the key coder in the dark, but I managed. Also, there seemed  to be some electricity problems in the staircase and in some sockets in the flat, which were not working. There was no kettle in the flat, and when I wrote about it to Marco he answered (after few hours) that it was broken and “sorry for the inconvenience”. Never the less, I stated there with my daughter and we’ve enjoyed it very much, so for a short stay - highly recommended.
Tania’s apartment was fantastic. Incredibly well located in the heart of Seefeld and very spacious. I would highly recommend!

There's a lot I could say, but to keep it short, I don't know if I could ever find a better host. The room is huge, nicely-decorated, and impeccably clean. Everything was smooth sailing, thanks easygoing communication and amenities.
There was a terrible damp smell in the house. There was mold on many parts of the walls. My allergic son had difficulty breathing at night.

This apartment was great, highly recommended!  Check in was simple and the apartment was well equipped with cooking items and a smart TV. Great location - walkable to downtown in 5-10 minutes with restaurants options much closer as well. I would definitely stay here again!!
Great place to stay for a big group. Highly recommend.
Just go for it if you are looking for something in a budget.
Apartment is really good very close to the public transport, we loved it

Apartment is on 3rd floor, so if you have a lot of luggages it might be a problem. Theres a storage in the basement, and everyone in the building has access to it. Hot water was not available I think after 11pm, although we waited a an hour but there was still no hot water.
Such a great host,such a nice apartment to experience the city. Definitely recommended.

The apartment is beautiful, conveniently located, neat & clean and the kitchen is well equipped. The bus station is right outside and the frequency of buses is very good. The host is helpful and ensures that the guests have a comfortable stay. She answered all my questions patiently and guided me well for the trip.  I would really recommend this place.

Meisam's place is nice and not noisy. I've been there with my father, he slept in the bed but I couln't sleep on the bedsofà because it was without the sheet and pillow lining. He was not available to come and solve the problem and so I had two terrible nights. PLEASE READ CAREFULLY the description, if you sleep on the bedsofà you've to bring your own sheet and pillow lining from home.. A part from this very bad thing the rest was fine.

Pros: Location. The apartment was clean and is very close to the Zurich Lake and park, which are strong highlights. The neighborhood is safe and there are many great restaurants. Cons: The host did not provide portable fans as promised. Twice. With temperature forecast to be 32C (90F), we requested portable fans before arrival because we knew the apartment did not have AC. The host assured us that the apartment would be equipped with fans. However there were no fans when we arrived. I informed the host who promised fans for the next day. Yet again, no fans. Needless to say, the nights in this apartment were sleepless and miserable even with the balcony doors/windows wide open.  The other negative is the street noise from 10pm-2am. This may not have been an issue with the balcony windows/doors closed, but we had to leave them open due  to the heat.  I wanted to leave a better review but the experience was so disappointing because of the heat and the host’s lack of follow-up.

Lea’s place was exactly where I wanted to be for an event at Volkshaus (4 minutes away). There is a tram stop out the front of the building… but I walked everywhere. Downtown is a 20 minute stroll.  It’s in a quiet residential neighborhood, with a Migros grocery store 5 minutes away, restaurants and coffee shops are close by.

Being my first trip to Zurich I couldn't have stumbled into a cooler situation.  The location is 10/10 centrally located but tucked back in the this killer little alley with water to one side and then the downtown district on the other side.  Perfect little retreat to call home for a few days.  Walking distance to the train station and just about everything else.  Thank you Sofia for the mellow stay.
cozy apartment in a quiet area. zurich downtown is about 30 mina walk. the apartment have everything to Cook

DON’T stay. No linens in the 2nd bedroom, got a rude text out of the blue  from the host demanding NO Partying bcs he’d call the police immediately while we were quietly eating take out watching tv. Apparently poor judgment &rented to people who partied.He wanted copies of our ID’s so he could call the police at anytime to kick us out.We’re in our 50’s and wanted peace and quiet.The place is a dump, location sux & well aware the host has 3 kids bcs the extra bedding w no linens were for a baby crib and some yellow stained comforters and pillows. Had to use a baby changing station towel to cover a pillow🤢Took over an hour to get sheets for the 2nd bedroom. Best of all there’s a huge building is being built right outside. So if you want to be woken up w cranes, construction workers yelling at 6:50 am while the windows are open bcs no a/c then this is your place.Miserable experience. He’ll probably write about us.We left it in pristine condition.Don’t want anyone else to deal w this
The host has provide spacious yet cozy apartment.  The only down side is the shape of the bathroom which is a long narrow bathroom which cause some inconvenience of usage!

Great  centrally located apartment with 20 min walk to old town or a 7 min tram ride. Has everything that you need for a quick stay. The only thing are the train tracks are right  across the street so you can hear it between 5am and midnight. However, if you walk enough during the day there shouldn’t be a problem as you’ll be asleep. Also, there is no tv, which is good but could be a problem for some.
Very clean room and nice host both Wolfgang couple. And big space room. Especially the bath room very clean too. Like the breakfast with host and chat everything. Highly recommend

I like the place, because it is 7 minutes walk from the Nature (the nearest forest on the hill), and 5 minutes walk from the final stop of tram 7 which delivers you to the Zurich center in 15-20 minutes.  Besides, you can reach Zurich lake in 15 minutes by walk. The small food store (Migros) is in 1 min walk.

Frank’s accommodation had excellent reviews and attractive photos, which led us to book it for our family trip. Unfortunately, the reality was very different. The property is located on a hill, requiring guests to carry luggage up several flights of stairs to reach a large building complex resembling student dorms. The apartment itself was spacious but felt very basic and poorly maintained. The living area contained a dirty sofa and armchair, the kitchen had an unpleasant smell, and there was visible mold around the windows. The bedding was particularly disappointing, with rough towel-like covers instead of proper bed linen and no mattress protectors. We contacted the host and requested suitable bedding, but rather than addressing our concerns, we were repeatedly told that this was standard practice. Communication eventually stopped altogether. Feeling uncomfortable and unable to stay overnight in such conditions, we left the property, returned the key and booked a hotel instead.

The location and flat itself were okay, but the host asked us to come early to pick up the key, saying he would be leaving at 2 pm (check in was supposed to be at 5), then when we got there, he said he wasn’t leaving until 5, so we left again to kill a few hours, which was inconvenient, since the flat is far from the centre, and my mom was ill. Then once we came back at 5, the host was hosting friends, and they left only 15-20 mins later. And finally, there were only 3 towels, even though there were 4 of us.

The whole stay was generally all good, the downside was no kettle to make tea/coffee and the fact that the checkout was at 12, yet someone was trying to open my door three times since 11am. I assume it was cleaning staff who wanted to check if I’m out, but it felt that I am rushed to leave. They could’ve messaged or check if I’m gone, or check in the key box? It was a bit weird.

Great place, very clean and stylish. Close to public transports and grocery shopping facilities just around the corner. The traffic on the “Wehntalerstrasse” in front of the apartment however is pretty loud.
This was my third stay.   So convenient.  And the owners make it so easy.   Thank you again.  I’ll be back …
Nothing much to say. I had to check out early as I felt the room is not safe & comfortable.

inaccurate location and i was sent the address and a few vague pictures on how the access to the house looks, a few hours before check in.  i was scolded  (definitely it felt like it) for turning up at the wrong building with the address i was given!! The facility has 2 other rooms and the host does not stay on the premises. (it is actually a massage facility).  One shared bathroom with ALL. Thin walls.  No key to the room. I asked - was told "no key". Could be a very awkward/ potentially dangerous situation. But the host is very concerned about the house key. She took back my key the night before check out and gave me weird instructions on how to get out the "house" - such as getting out through the garden door.  the wifi stopped working just when she left the premises for the evening. When i asked her about it she blamed poor internet in whole of Zurich/ switzerland and her lack of understanding of english. While she took my key back saying she may not be back bfore i checked out, she was already stripping out the room much before the check out time while i had popped out for a coffee.  Only a small table light in the room. One of the two lights in the kitchen stopped working on day 2. I am surprised at the criteria/ low bar for a "super host"! Great location, though!
Apartment was exactly as in pictures. Kitchen was well equipped. Very nice one week stay. Would easily book again.

I recently stayed at a studio apartment near the bus stop, which was conveniently located 5-10 minutes from the center city. The apartment itself was comfortable for a short stay, but I must express my disappointment in the lack of communication from the management. As remote workers, our primary concern was the non-functioning internet. We immediately informed them about the issue, but it took them 18 hours to respond with a simple "thank you for letting us know." We followed up daily, asking for updates on the internet, but received no response. Finally, when they did reply, it was to ask if rebooting the router had improved the situation. Unfortunately, even after we replied with a "no," they ignored us once again. This lack of professionalism and unwillingness to help troubleshoot the problem left us quite dissatisfied. Therefore, if you value good communication and reliable internet access, I cannot recommend staying at this apartment.
Would not recommend this place. Noisy street and neighborhood. Kitchen is not decently stocked with basics. Low quality stuff from IKEA. Not worth it

I’ve stayed at several bnb’s over the years. This unit was probably the least worthy in value in my opinion. First off, the unclear, difficult and wonky directions to enter the building. Secondly, the unit is on the 4th floor and there is no elevator. The description of the unit does not mention stairs or lack of elevator. Thirdly, the room is small and very basic and bare bones. The two cheap metal folding chairs broke and I asked for a replacement whereby the owner gave me two equally chairs to sit on. No other place to sit besides the bed. Lastly the ac stopped blowing cold air on the 3rd day and I notified the owner who seemed to just blow me off saying something like the cold air only goes on when the temperature outside rises above … and then mentions something about the “green experience”. Whatever.  There are security cameras in the hallways and stairwells. Very sketchy accommodations and I would not recommend staying here. I also contacted Airbnb support about all of this.

Nice location, clean, and quiet. It’s not far from the city center, making it convenient for getting around. The apartment was comfortable and well-maintained. A washing machine would have been a useful addition, especially for longer stays, but overall we had a pleasant experience.
It was a short trip. The apartment has everything you need.

Location is somewhat okay, you are near train station but the entrance to building is next to trash container and window is right next to main door of building, you cant have privacy.   Bathroom was moldy and therefore smelled on it, system for ventilation was weak and we needed to use window of kitchen for bathroom ventilation.

The apartment itself is quite large and modern and well equip't but the host was quite rude. The first day the room was so cold that I had to sit with my coat on. When I told him about it his words were... "there's nothing I can do about it, I was there on Sunday and it was fine and I haven't changed shit!"  I was shocked and told him to forget it. The flat temperature  did get better by the 3rd day. There isn't a control for u to alternate the temp in the room. I found the host quite patronising and very rude.

There was little to no amenities. We had seven people stay and there was half a bottle of small shampoo. There was no body soap. The TV had no sound the the WiFi password was a sticker behind the router which you had to search to locate.  There were a few hairballs in the bathroom and by the stairway.
Amzing and very large space! This is a steal :)
Clean, organized, very comprehensive info guide. Very responsive to messages. Great location, quiet area, A+++ would recommend to all!

Intended 2 week stay became a 1 day stay. Host was responsive and communicative however overall I checked out early. Check-in was a tricky. The lockbox contained the wrong key, sending me into a different apartment. After retrieving the correct key from inside that unit, the building's front door wouldn’t open. Stranded outside in intense humidity with my dog and no phone data, I had to find a cafe for wifi. Later the hosts brother admitted the lock was stiff and triple-locked. The apartment was quite unhygenic. It smelled bad, had no AC, and the floors and kitchen items were physically sticky with dark marks. I found used bandage wrappings in drawers and dead bugs on the bathroom sill. The final straw was a live, lice-like insect crawling on the fresh bath towel—I had to use my dog’s towel to shower and dry off. The host was initially a bit hostile, calling filth "old scuffs," but realised I was being very fair in my feedback. Due to Airbnb policies, I still lost significant money.
Very close to the train station and trams. Very convenient to get there and around
Super nice place to stay. Spacious, cosy, comfortable. Great location, easy to get tommcity centre.  Dmitry is a super host, easy to communicate and very responsive. Highly recommended!
well located, clean and lovely flat fully furnished. Stayed for about a month and can only highly recommend it.

This is a great place to stay in Zurich, located right next to the lake and five minutes by tram to the county center.  The rooms were clean and tidy. It has a lovely balcony attached not offering the greats view but still big enough for most of the guest to sit there. It has a dishwasher and tabs for it  provided by the host. Big thanks!  Unfortunately the elevator didn’t work, the only bad point.

Very helpful and accommodative. We were a little early and their luggage lockers were full - responded immediately and took our bags while we went out and about and returned at check in time. Conveniently located a few hundred feet from the train station. Having a rotating fan available was a nice touch as it was quite hot even with the windows open. Check in and check out was easy. The location is good - convenient and yet away from the city center so quiet and not busy.
The room is big enough for two people and had everything we need.

Not really what i expected.  -To loud. -Not cleaned correctly. -Soap mixed with water in the bottles... -The door and many other things needs to be repared and replaced and and and. Sorry but i was really disappointed.

I really enjoyed my stay at Lindsay’s apartment! Loved the aesthetic, good neighborhood, close to the center. Perfect choice for my trip! Lindsay is very helpful and polite! I felt at home! Thank you!!!
We loved the apartment so much we wished it was ours! Sarah is an Amazing host. Very nice and always available to meet out needs. Definitely 10/10
This place is hard to live in without AC. Even after enough windows for cross ventilation the apartment was like a heating oven
it was so hot at the bedroom and smells is not good
I'm happy with the place. The owner is also very nice and friendly. The place is clean and comfortable. I will visit here again.

There was no one to receive us as the concierge office is somewhere far away.  The room was on top floor got quite hot during day time and there is no source of cooling not even fan.  The room was on 2nd floor and lift was not working for two days.  They charged me 45 Euro for changing a bed cover, without prior information about the charges.  Asked for help for arranging a vehicle to airport after check out,was refused straight away.

The Wi-Fi didn’t work and there was no hot water for the first two days of our stay. In addition, the keys were not available in lock box as directed upon arrival. We needed to wait in the cold for over an hour for him to respond and arrive.
Asked for a baby-cod last minute and it was already in place and installed when I arrived.
No complaints. Perfect for a few day stay in Zürich.
Toilet seats missing. Stayed 7 days and asked for it to fix since day one with them always saying they will provide and never complying.

When we arrived the apartment smelt of old cigarettes smoke and felt like whoever stays there packed up in a hurry as best they could for our arrival. The location was good and nice outlook but just felt uneasy. No ironing board or iron. It was cluttered in the main bedroom.

Worst Airbnb experience in more than a decade. There was a huge music festival right next door with super loud music until past 2 AM. We could not sleep or relax in the apartment. The host was not accommodating about this situation and gave no advanced warning but rented out at regular rate. The place smelled like smoke when we arrived. The shower head was installed so that it splashed water all over the bathroom. We removed the water as well as we could and in the end the host complained to us that the bathroom was wet instead of apologizing for the lack of a reliable shower facility. No attention to important details like a light in reach from bed. Poor quality of pillows and duvet in one of the rooms. Basically someone trying to make maximal profit off of guests without consideration for convenience.

Because of the walkable distances  from the Zurich HB train station, this place is perfect to tourist visiting Zurich. However, the apartment is located on the 3rd floor (4th floor for the U.S. folks) and does not have an elevator.

Very good location. Easy access to tram stops to get to Zurich HB. Room is a bit stuffy, poor ventilation. Need to open window to get it ventilated but that could be noisy due to traffic from the road.

A bright, generously sized apartment in central Zurich, featuring two balconies and located in a cool neighborhood in the heart of the city. Close to supermarkets, cafés, and restaurants, and just a few minutes from the river.  So beautiful and cozy that you almost don’t feel like going outside.

First, the requested flat was changed by the host due to host in the requested flat as per the host statement. the replacement was downgrade to the first reserved and paid  option. the host made us wait under the rain and cold for over 30 minutes because he forgot to leave the building entrance key in the box. the flat is not very clean. In fact, the small couch is dirty. the tiny sigle beds are not comfortable. the cover sheets were not clean. Some of the coffee cups are not cleaned. The bathroom shelf (Ikea) shelf is safety issue as you can injured your face with it.

Great location but that's about it. The room is worth a quarter of the price its listed for, it was low quality and unclean. We had shower issues which we told the host about but we never heard back from him. Quite disappointing

Coco is super nice and she offered a charming place located in a quiet spot, very close to public transportation and just a quick walk to grocery shopping. My room was very clean and very comfortable, I immediately found everything I needed. Communication with the host went fast and smooth, I can really recommend staying there!

When I arrived, the house was just filthy! Not a pleasant experience to enter the bathroom and find shaved beard hair all over the sink, piss stains on the toilet and even shaved pubic hair! While the room looked tidy, it quickly became clear how the bedsheets and pillowcase were not changed for ages and had an uncomfortable stench. I expressed these concerns to Serdar, who was prompt to respond to my request to change to clean bedsheets. Two friends of Serdar were staying at the same place during my visit and had left the bathroom and kitchen in a horrible state. I did not enter the kitchen during my entire stay to avoid the horrible stench of greasy pans left in the sink. Even if Serdar is not directly responsible for these issues, it is still his responsibility to maintain the apartment in a bearable state for visitors to stay there. Based on my terrible experience I would totally not recommend!
Nice stay in residential area. No parking on site. Must get parking pass and park a block away

We’ve stayed at many Airbnbs in various countries, but unfortunately, this was our worst experience to date. It had a significant negative impact on our vacation in Zurich. As soon as we entered, we found the floor in terrible condition—old, loose, and noisy. Walking on it felt like stepping on eggshells or broken glass. It was unsettling and uncomfortable throughout our stay. The bedding didn’t fit the beds properly, and the pillows were small and stained, which was very off-putting. The curtain in the second bedroom was partially torn, adding to the neglected feel of the place. The bathroom was especially problematic. The toilet and an extremely small sink were placed so close together that it was hard to use either comfortably. The listing photos showed a yellow couch, but it wasn’t there. Overall, this was a disappointing experience for me and my family. They were very unhappy, and we all felt let down by this booking. I strongly believe this property needs urgent renovation
The view is incredible. Right next to one tram stop and down the street from another. They come in handy for all the hills. Close to the main train station, which has everything you might need in it.

I have make a reservation morning , and cancelled reservation the same day at 12:00. The owner not reply to me, i have canceled the reservation but i have left my money, and nobofy answer me on reguest about money. Why is this possibile?

The apartment was clean, 20min walk to Zur HBF, but Issue 1- NOT ENOUGH electric sockets. No bedside sockets, difficult to charge  phones as only 1 in rooms 2&3 + situated so far from the beds. In the kitchen only 2 sockets so overall not enough for 8 occupants to charge phones or use the kettle or use hairdryer as not enough sockets in general. Issue 2- only 1 small rubbish bag was provided for guests of 8 x 6nights. Had to buy a roll of rubbish bag worth CHF16!!! as you are not allowed to just use any other rubbish bag in Zurich(something we didnt know). I asked for atleat 2 spare ones but no reply. Issue 3 - shower head in toilet 2 was not working, emailed them but the handyman didn't come on the day he was expected. so for a few days we 8 people taking turn in a 1 small shower cubicle. When the broken shower was "fixed" it was hard to regulate, in other words, not much of a benefit.

I stayed here for three and a half weeks and was very happy with my overall experience. The apartment was exactly as described, and the location was excellent, with easy access to public transportation and city activities. The apartment was spacious and had everything I needed for a longer stay. I was traveling around Switzerland for work during much of my time in Zürich, so I was not in the apartment very often, but it was always nice to come back to. The hosts were great to communicate with and made the whole process very easy. Both check-in and check-out were smooth and straightforward, which I really appreciated. Overall, I had a very positive stay and would recommend this place to others looking for a comfortable and convenient place in Zürich. The city itself was amazing. The only small downside was that the walls are a bit thin, so you may occasionally hear neighbors or some outside noise. Still, this did not affect my stay much overall.

This place may be fine, I didn’t stay there. I heard myself before I stayed and let them know ahead of time that I couldn’t stay there as their business was not handicap accessible. They responded that they understood and would cancel my reservation. Airbnb asked them to refund me, but despite staying they would, they have gone radio silent. Basically happy to steal my money.  Also note location is not super central (not that it mattered to me because I was taking the train in the morning). They should have put in their description that they are not accessible if you are disabled or have a have a mobility issue

This place was absolutely terrible. Took 4 hours to find the place after getting bad directions, then when we finally got there she had a very rude attitude with me. After all that, we go into the house and the place was filthy. The floors hadn't been swept, the bathroom toilet and shower were not cleaned, our pillows and blankets even smelt so bad that we decided not to use them. There was also barely any furniture downstairs as the pictures show. Just about every picture is a complete lie. As soon as you pull in, it looks like an abandoned lot. Another funny feature is that the main door doesnt lock. So when we decided to leave to tour, we kept our stuff locked up in our van. Getting into town was not easy either. From the house, you have to walk up a very primitive trail. Its completely uphill and its basically just wet leaves and mud the whole way up, so if you plan to be out late you should bring a flashlight. All in all, the place was so bad we considered not even spending the night. I 100% do not recommend this place.
No explicit information how to get the keys past checkin time and she will not answer the phone

We booked Joy's place as we were stuck in Switzerland temporarily due to restrictions brought on by the Covid-19 pandemic virus, and needed a temporary refuge. -the first listing we booked was not what we expected. the listing said it was 2 bedrooms, with spaces for coworking(meaning with desk and chair). I also confirmed the latter with Joy before booking. Upon check in, we discovered that this place actually was a one bedroom with one office, and the office was converted into a second bedroom, and the coworking space from the photos completely  removed. For the amount we paid, we were of course not happy as this is the second time we booked a listing that the owner was deceptive about it's actual layout. Must be a thing over there in Zurich? /shrugs -we called to complain and were received by Joy's Father(which was weird). He then put us in contact with their Hausverwaltung(handy guy), who showed us another property that fit our needs(since they are actually a real estate company with many properties listed on Airbnb). -we liked the place, and Joy's Father immediately asked us for payment outside of Airbnb. Knowing that this was a violation of Airbnb's TOS, I said no, i'd rather make any and all payments through Airbnb. He consented, then sent me the alteration request through Airbnb. Airbnb then stepped in, because, since the inconvenience was on their part, they should've just waived the difference. They wouldn't move on that, stating that the new property was bigger in size therefore the difference still stands. 1st red flag. -it was a safe neighbourhood/public transport was right nearby/ so were many supermarkets, cafes(not that this mattered because at the time of this writing there was still no vaccine out for Covid-19). The new property also had lots of space and a nice kitchen loaded with many things needed for a long stay(coffee maker etc). Their handy guy, Ori, was also a very supportive addition, always there for questions about anything from garbage collection, to the internet. The kitchen was not that clean upon inspection, and there was a random huge table stecked in the middle of the living room. However, since they had to make up for their inconvenience last minute, we gathered that this was a place that they had that they were still in the middle of preparing to put on the market for rent. Furthermore, that massive table became my work table anyway. -two weeks into our stay, Switzerland lifted their stay at home restrictions for Covid-19 drastically, so we decided to leave while we could. I asked Joy if she could refund us either the unused portion of our stay, or the difference that we had to pay to stay in the new listing, since us having to stay there was as a result of discrepancies on their part. Joy refused to refund the unused portion of our stay, which was another 2 weeks, saying and I quote, "I'm not in the position of generosity." She was short on money due to all the cancellations brought on by Covid-19, and despite that, we were there when she needed us to help her sustain her livelihood. Nevertheless, when we needed her to make this experience mutually beneficial her humanity had checked out. Airbnb again stepped in, and made a plea to her to reconsider. Nope. She's a human being hardened by circumstance. So we left them with almost 2000 chf more than they deserved. I hope this money keeps them warm at night in DIE KALTE KALTE SCHWEIZ. Having said all of this, I would recommend them for their conveniently placed properties, but not for their frigid personalities and seemingly deceptive demeanours. This experience, though already stressful,  would've been less traumatic had she tapped into her human side and saw a situation from all angles instead of just one.
Bed is on floor and wasn’t aware of this. Too many people in apartment, lots of noise and music till late
They were so attentive to me, I arrived at 11:00 and they let me store my bags, the apartment was small but it was complete, you won’t regret it if you book it. 🥰
I would highly recommend staying at this place. The apartment was beautiful and Blueground was extremely responsive, and helpful whenever I had a request.
The house is as describe. The cons would be TV does not allow Netflix 😭.

The pros: the flat is spacious, the furniture is pretty, the bedrooms were fairly clean, the small balcony is cute. There is a safe box, so check-in is easy. The cons: the host has nothing to do with this flat, so don't expect any outstanding hospitality when something goes wrong. I would not stay again.  Our stay at this accommodation has been quite disappointing and frustrating. Four of us arrived on  a Friday at 10pm and found that there was no toilet paper in the flat. I called Filipa who told me that she lives an hour away and can't help us until the next morning. If I was responsible for the flat, I would have made sure that my guests will be supplied toilet paper - something essential - ASAP. We ended up having to look for a shop that was still open that late (not easy in Zurich!), walking 20mins to get there and spending our own money on toilet paper. Filipa dropped off some the next morning, specifically, she supplied us with 2 rolls, which is an optimistic amount for 4 people.  Secondly, the listing claims that an iron is available, and I specifically asked the host to make sure it's available as we were going to a wedding. No iron , of course, and no attempt on the hosts side to make sure we were supplied one. We ended up borrowing from a friendly neighbour. The flat is old, and in need of some care, especially the bathroom. We didn't mind the unusual layout - we were warned - but the bathroom is generally in quite a rotten state and needs renovation. The kitchen floor was sticky and the kitchen supplies were limited, which made it difficult for us to keep the place clean (a torn sponge, no tea towels, no kitchen towels.)

Peaceful and friendly host. Thanks Charlotte and Matthias for the hospitality. Fully equipped kitchen, very close to supermarket and transport. And a big illuminated room. If you stay there, you should enjoy the small island closeby to swin. I recommend 100%

Our bathroom had a horrible musty smell. It was unbearable for my sister and I. We did not even use the bathroom. The room layout was different than shown which wasn’t necessarily a bad thing but something to keep in mind. The elevator was also in a weird spot and should have had signage for it.

Michael's place is in a horrible location.  It is across the street from a park where vagrants hangout and make noise until after 2am every night of the week.  It was nearly impossible to sleep at night because of the noise and night coming from the park.   It was also unsafe as I was asked for money multiple times and harassed whenever I was walking in the neighborhood. Find another place to stay!

Arrived at the apartment after 3pm (check in is at 2). The apartment hadn’t been cleaned from the previous stay. All towels dirty, food garbage, dishes, beds unmade, hair covering shower, dirty floors. We had been traveling from the US so this was not ideal. They were responsive and said their cleaning people “had a problem” and were en route. Asked how long it would be and they stated they had 3 other apartments to do so couldn’t give us a time. Seemed like we should have been prioritized but we weren’t. We had to vacate the apartment and couldn’t get back in until after 9pm when they were done. We had a great time in Zurich but not impressed with this management company. Wouldn’t stay again. The apt is spacious and 2 baths is nice -my only positives.

Absolutely TERRIBLE! Stay far, far away. The host is shockingly disrespectful—condescending, insulting, and even ruder when asked to be professional.  The accommodations are filthy: long hair all over the bathroom, stained sheets, a bed so bad you can feel the springs shift under you, and a shower that clearly hasn’t been cleaned properly. Even the vending machine was a disaster; anything you buy gets stuck, and no one is around to help. I repeatedly asked to speak with a supervisor and never heard back. I do NOT recommend this listing to anyone—unless you’re looking for a truly miserable stay.

We stayed at Giancarlo’s place for 4 nights, and absolutely loved it. The apartment was spotlessly clean. The neighborhood is walkable and very convenient to the center of Zurich. We didn't need to work while staying, but the separation between the bedroom and living room would make it an ideal apartment to work from. Giancarlo was immediately responsive and provided all the information we needed. We hope to be back!
Fabienne was a great host and her place is the perfect place to stay if you're attending an event at Letzigrund!

This stay was our worst ever. We didn’t mind that the apartment is old like it shows in the pictures - it is literally crumbling down (shower curtain and frame almost fell on our kid). Pipe smells terrible, cupboards are old, cutlery and utensils are terrible too. Bathtub was cracked, water taps didn’t fully close - not to mention water pressure in the kitchen is a joke. The place had fans, but they were old and noisy - I really think charging this much for a week considering what it offers should be illegal. Oh yes and 2 people entered the apartment uninvited or without prior approval from us - one to fix the shower (which he used duck tape to fix!!) and one by saying oh I am sorry (but actually tried to sneak in before she realized we are home). Washroom - they clean guest towels there (not via a third party) and literally you have no time to put a round of wash yourself. We were all sick during this week and I kind of think it was because of how terrible everything was.

Christine is super easy to talk to and welcoming. She is an experienced host and knows what people need. The house located in a great spot, where you can get to the central less than 10mins. It’s a safe and nice area too. I cannot wait to come back to Zürich again and I would recommend Christine’s place to anyone who is travelling to this beautiful city!
This was my 2nd stay at this property....great experience

The place was extremely hot inside and difficult to breathe and no windows or thermostat to control it. Fans by the beds won’t help. Host ignored my question about the temperature. Internet wifi doesn’t work. Host responded to reset it with 0 instructions and when we can’t write due to its location and bad reception and no wifi. TV in living room doesn’t work either, it’s completely disconnected and when you plug it in, it asks to connect something… we also tried to wash and dry small load of baby clothes and after running 2 drying cycles, we removed a wet clothing.
It was very clean and walkable from the central station.

I have never been so relieved to check out of a place. While it has potential, it suffers from a severe lack of cleaning and basic maintenance.  The bathroom was covered in black mold including the shower, window, and tiling. The showerhead was in such a terrible state that we had to ask for a replacement after the first night. While they replaced the head, no actual cleaning was done. I was there on a high-intensity work trip and didn't have the time or energy to manage their maintenance, so I just counted down the days until we could leave.  The rest of the property wasn't any better. To make matters worse, a heatwave hit, and the only relief was a half-broken fan that barely worked.  These issues have been raised in past reviews, so the hosts clearly do not care to fix them. I missed a buss and i was late to check it, host was not correct with me because she was saying that i can not make a check in after 10am.... in fact keys were at the place as agreed but i was worried if i am gonna remain on street all night.

Jun had a good heart and let me drop off my stuff early. She can’t speak much English and didn’t understand my detailed texts about when I was arriving, then angrily complained I had come at the wrong time. It was the worst place I have ever stayed at. The ad mis-represents the place as three of the images are irrelevant and there are no photos showing the whole room.  I should have realised that when I saw the photo of the washing machine, a buddha statue, a pot plant and a toilet. Jun doesn't live there. The profile doesn’t say you will be sharing the place with other guests.  I found that risky - especially when she said to hide my money!  The room looks out to a car park. Unfortunately when I was there it was 35 degrees and the room was a hot box with no fresh air or open window due to the mosquitos. Fans cost about $10 these days but Jun said she wouldn’t buy one. There was nowhere to put clothes or hang clothes. All the furniture contained her stuff. Two tables which could have been used for guests’ things had 10 pot plants on them. The main light didn’t work. When I messaged her asking where the top sheet was, it took a long time for her to understand what I wanted and she got angry. I would have complained to airbnb, and got somewhere else to stay, but I was too exhausted and jetlagged to pack up, move to another address and unpack as I had a large suitcase for a five country trip. Apartment is spacious, but unfortunately very cluttered and does not look like the photos on the listing at all. There is stuff everywhere!  The home smells like overdue old pillows/blankets. Dryer was full of bedsheets and washer was full of dirty bedsheets and towels when we got there.  The apartment is dark and wasn't clean. We were there for 3 weeks, traveling 5 days during the first week. The worst part was that the entire 2nd and 3rd week jackhammering started between 745-830 AM and lasted pretty much the entire day. It was absolutely exhausting and ruined the entire trip. The owner knew that they were remodeling the garage of the building and we weren't informed of it nor of the noise accompanied by it. I would have never booked this apartment! I work hard during the year to get the 3 weeks off - this was awful! Front room is loud due to close by frequent fire engine station and busy street. This shouldn't be on this platform - it is an expensive house sitting!

near  public transport,   found the  floors very noisy,  unable to move about quietly.   no doors on the toilet in the top bedroom, and no door on the shower room,  had to go through the bedroom downstairs.   host was easily contactable.
Excelente place, the host was really nice all the time!
The space was cozy, warm, and quiet- just exactly what I was looking for.

Hey. One of the best places to stay in a wonderful cozy apartment. The check in was smooth and the guy was really helpful and patient enough to explain everything. I would highly recommend everyone to please stay here. Regards  Ng

We knew there was construction, and noises starting at 8:00 am which we were ok with it since we had plan to see the city most of the day.  What we didn’t know is the bar/ night club under the apartment, on Saturday night until 3:00 am we heard Loud noises and then at 7:00 am ( not 8:00 am as we were told) the very loud construction noise started so we barely got any sleep, the house does not have AC so if you leave the windows open, you can hear the street noise and the metro and if you close the windows during summer, you can’t sleep from the heat. There were 4 of us ( kids and parents ) but not enough shampoo for all of us to take a shower so we had to go and purchase ours, they had provided and almost empty bottle when we checked in, and finally there were a lot of drunk people hanging out by the entry door most of the time. Did not like our stay at all.

I think the place was OK but there was a lot of noise and loud music on my second night which was a bit disturbing. Other than that I can say the place was decent and very easy to access with tram 13 from the center.

Great local suburb located only a 15 min tram ride from old town Zurich and the hauptbahnhoff central station. Apartment was clean, simple and had all amenities needed to feel at home. Would stay here again :)

Airbnb Slumlord. I strongly dislike these types of hosts. They hyper-optimize profit over guest comfort. - No soap, shampoo, or conditioner (aside from an impressively small 'bar' of soap in the bathroom and a half empty container of dish soap). Yes this is listed in the profile, but it should be included. - Coffee machine, but no coffee pods (and no mention of the type of machine they have) - No extra cleaning supplies. The kitchen sponge was dirty, and they were low on paper towels. - Thin walls, you could hear the neighbors talking.  - Headboard had been inexplicably removed, leaving only a stain on the wall near the bed. - The key to the apartment was in an envelope that also contained a trash bag for the kitchen - so I had the pleasure of lining the trash bin after a 14 hour flight.  - A knife set and kitchen items, but no cutting boards. The location could not be better. 5 minute tram ride from the main train station, yet far enough away to be quiet. Within a half block of the river, next to an open bar and Dynamo, an open-use metalworks for youth. The interior was spotlessly clean and everything was as described.

Ramona's apartment was beautiful! It was very spacious, clean, had a full kitchen (if needed) and she had awesome plants growing on the balcony and in the apartment. We had a great stay and Ramona was responsive and even gave us great tips even though she was out of town! I would highly recommend this listing.
The location was ok, but the building is like a college dorm. No soap, or basic items neither. Be prepared to bring your own.

The room was super cute and very clean Great location — just a 10-minute walk from the train station. David replied super fast whenever I needed help and was very helpful. I met Tomislav on my last day — he was so kind and friendly, and gave me great tips for cities to visit in Europe. Highly recommend staying here. 10/10!

1. Ants crawled out of the gaps of the floor (see the first picture). Nathalie is so kind, friendly and always willing to help. I enjoyed my time so much. The place was so comfortable and cozy. I will definitely recommend!

The place it’s not good. The bed it’s uncomfortable and the pillows are really bad. The location is good but it’s important to mention that you have to climb a slope in order to reach de place. Finally it should be noted that the place it’s on the ground floor, thus the windows faces outwards and it’s feels  like you are outside the apartment, everyone can see you.

Joy is a very nice and responsive host. The appartement is ok but not renovated. There was a smell in the entrance. Kitchen not well equipped . Holes in bedsheets and dirty shower curtain. It is an ok place but no more.

It’s a cute location easily walkable to the train and the center of Zurich but unfortunately there was a really bad smell coming from the carpet. It seemed like people over time had really stinky feet and that smell was imbedded in the carpet and really made the place smell so bad. A thorough cleaning and disinfecting of the carpet would help or switching to wood floors and a washable rug. It was not my favorite stay, and I was thrilled be be flying out the next day. It was an extra night for me after my fun vacation and I just wouldn’t recommend the place because of the issues I highlighted but the room was spacious and had garden views and lots of windows which was the only thing I liked.
Awesome spot, definitely recommend for those looking to stay in Zürich
We had an excellent stay. Tobias  was very flexible and helpful.  highly recommended

The location is great and the neighborhood as well. Hosts are really really nice but the price we paid was not worth the quality of our stay. The room was very dirty and the building was old. We selected this place because price was high and we thought it is indeed a studio apartment. But  to our disappointment it is not.

Advantages: + very close to the transport connections + several supermarkets and playgrounds in the vicinity + the host replies quickly, the communication was smooth + a very stylish, pleasant apartment + very clean + a very quiet, peaceful place + a well-equipped kitchen + toys were fantastic to have around. My two young boys were more excited to play with the toys on some days rather than explore Zürich. + a Nespresso coffee machine + we stayed for one week at Christmas and there was a wonderful decorated Christmas tree! Things to consider improving:  - some of the things weren't found in the apartment as promised (the hairdryer, restaurant recommendations and some toiletries, like a regular shower gel and shampoo). - it would be great if there were instructions for using the stove, as there is no microwave oven in the kitchen. - the check-out at 10 was a bit too early for us. - the pillows in the nursery were uncomfortable. Overall, we were happy with our stay. Thank you, Aleksan

Five stars across the board! This is an excellent property in a great location in Zurich. My wife and I and our 9 month old stayed here for a week and used it as a base to explore the area. Public transit was convenient and the apartment was well appointed.
This is the third time that we are staying at Anna's place. It says it all!

This property is not as described - and the appliances as well as service is poor. For example, not enough towels for guests (and very poor, low cost quality). The beds and sheets are very poor quality and not thick enough for winter. This is a serviced apartment not an airbnb. Also, the host is very rude in communication and in his rule. I would unfortunately not recommend it.

Beautiful apartment, centrally located, but extremely hot in summer. No air conditioning and no fans. We had two 30C days and could barely fall asleep it was so hot. Also the host made it very clear that they didn't want young children/toddlers to stay here (threatened extra cleaning costs).
The stay was nice. They were very friendly and open. The roon is a little small but just right if you stay alone.

Absolutely wrong description online about location, it is 5 KM from Zurich main station, not close to lake also, all fluke. Host absolutely Mia guided on location , bad experience to reach there. House was okay kinds , but reaching their was scary

This place is in an excellent location for tourism; a block away from the #4 tram and two blocks away from the airport tram. It is spotlessly clean.  My only hesitation is that it has an electronic door to enter/exit the third floor apartment, and I was worried about escaping the apartment quickly in case of an emergency. Perhaps I am old-fashioned, but I would feel more secure with a key instead of a screwdriver to take off the door screws in case of an emergency.  Also, note that the place is next to a pedestrian ally and near a nightclub, so during the night,  people tend to gather below the apartment. At 3 am one night, we had the unfortunate experience of listening to two drunk American men yodeling for an hour (not Gerald's fault, our country's fault for lack of manners.)

The apartment is very well located, clean and in a quiet neighbourhood. Consequently due to the heat I was not able to sleep for the whole staying at this apartment.  This is just so bad because the apartment is lovely and if u don’t have any issue with the heat at night is a lovely place to stay.
Stay was not as expected due to noice and smell
The perfect stay - cannot recommend Andrea and her apartment enough!

Everything started a went as expected but in the last we had to kill more than 20 cockroaches 🪳. So this was a very bad experience, it seems they had a plague. It seems the product which kept bugs out started to lose its power…
Perfect place for a short stay; close to public transportation and a great neighborhood.

While the apartment itself is ok, it faces directly onto the Langstrasse which is a notorious “party” street in Zurich that is very loud. All the windows of the apartment open out onto this street so the apartment is always noisy. It’s also directly above a McDonald’s, so the smell of fast food wafts into the apartment of the windows are open. The main bedroom does not have curtains, and it’s not a comfortable place to sleep.  The host (Au) was incredibly inconsiderate, inflexible and difficult to deal with, despite incorrectly advertising the location of the apartment (which Airbnb has now forced him to correct). This is one place to avoid.

Great location next to multiple tram stations that can get you anywhere in the city! Comfortable bed and spacious room/bathroom. Only negative was the neighborhood was pretty noisy and you could hear it all through the walls. Also no A/C if that is something that bothers you, it also makes it louder when the windows are open.

Very close to the main train station and walking distrance (ca 20 minutes) from the old centre. Many public transport options . The apartment is very tastefully decorated and has a large outside space.

The bed rooms do not have Doors! The photos in the Lisitng are polished, photoshopped and the real room / furniture is too old to satisfy your expectation. The host ad says, "We are no company, we are family :)".  This hook message is wrong. its a complete commercial business with multiple apartments and as per my conversation with the host,  they are doing it from 8 years.  Does a family stay with no doors ? Our group has 5 people, quite inconvenience. 5) Right next to the main road and park, quite noisy at night. 6) The lake view can't offset with all the cons. We will not stay there again.
Great stay, not a very pleasant check out experience, apart from that everything amazing

DO NOT STAY HERE!!! This place has a sever black mold problem! We had to cancel our stay after the first night due to waking up with an extreme headache and the place having a strong smell of mold. We found mold throughout the bathroom and kitchen. Airbnb should not allow this listing to be up on their website, it’s a shame a host would put customers health at risk like this. There were also many other problems like the kitchen appliances being left dirty and trash left behind. Many other things weren’t left clean also, hair was found in many places and the place did not feel clean in general. Only one pillow was given for each bed. The shutters are broken in half the windows so you can’t get the sunlight like it shows in pictures or proper fresh air. The host was good at communicating before we got there and warned us it was an old building but this does not mean it’s okay to have problems like this.
just okay. not an ideal location, plus shaky WiFi, uncomfortable couch bed. loud construction noises happening right outside. host not very empathetic. clean place!
Great place for medium term stays, recommended for solo travelers.
Wonderful flat, area and view! Sad to leave!

The place was exactly as described just had a few glitches as below - Check in requires a confirmation number which wasn’t communicated well in advance and was not included in instructions shared earlier. For someone on the road and travelling with limited connectivity to internet, can be a hassle. The window in living room was inaccessible due to a broken lock with no other source of ventilation. The dishwasher was broken and we had to call services to get it fixed. While booking, amenities mentions cleaning services available during stay, none of the days did any cleaning lady visit.  Another issue is no elevator available in the building. With big luggage and infant, became an issue to carry everything three floors. Otherwise, delivered as communicated. Responsiveness of host was amazing!

The apartment was well located near a tram stop, clean and generally ok. However, we found the kitchen a bit odd with appliances such as microwave, coffee maker and kettle all unplugged. the only power socket we could find was above the hotplate, which seemed unsafe.

Pedro's place is wonderful. It's directly across the road from the Marriot, and you can walk across the bridge into the industrial parts of Zurich, or walk 10 minutes into the Old Town areas. It's right by the river, and very well connected for food and things to do. It was spotless, clean and warm. An excellent place to stay!

I highly do not recommend this pace due to extremely poor communication and unprofessional behavior. My friend and I could not reach the host until 42 minutes before check-in. He ignored our earlier messages regarding early luggage drop-off. Airbnb support even had to intervene just to get him to send the check-in instructions the night before.On the check-in day, we waited for over two hours with no response. We finally decided to leave our luggage in the room and took the key with us. At 2:18 PM, the host messaged us, rudely blaming us for blocking the cleaner by taking the key. We immediately returned and left the key back by 3:47 PM. When confronted, he was highly unprofessional, stating he is not obligated to reply 24/7.The room was never cleaned during our entire booking period. We felt so unsafe and unwelcome that we did not stay for even a single minute, choosing to book a hotel instead.  PS. There was an AirTag attached to the room key, which is a major privacy concern.

The location is convenient to transit, shops, and markets. The bed is comfortable. The washer and dryer were nice to have.  Overall, this property needs immediate maintenance. Spiders were present in every corner of every room, excessive dust and cobwebs galore, the walls are dirty, there are no instructions to use the appliances, and some of the windows are missing curtains which left us feeling uneasy in the space.  The WiFi didn’t work upon arrival which cost me international fees to call the host, the cleanliness was not improved by reaching out to the host, and trying to use the appliances which were unfamiliar proved frustrating. I booked this apartment for safety while traveling with young kids since there is no balcony, but the lack of cleanliness and privacy caused me to regret that decision.  With proper cleaning and guidance from the host (and possibly the inclusion of washcloths), this property could be a real gem. As is, it’s a dirty disappointment.
Nice apartment! It gets a bit hot during the summer months, but this isn’t too bad and the more-than-excellent location makes up for that.

We booked for 3 days after watching good pictures. This place is not yet ready to receive family with kids. We tried to pas our time by staying out most of the time. For students or youngsters this still can be ok but in that case the cost is exorbitant. We were looking for a cozy place with some furniture around like one expects in any house when you are travelling with family and kids. Nails were protruding out of base of doors thereby injuring kids and tearing clothes. One of the power switch of room towards balcony side was totally open and sparking beneath our head while sleeping. Just by placing beds and minimal furniture one can earn money but not reviews. We felt as if we were Guinea pigs for trial of this listing. One expects some salt  & sugar in any kitchen if not oil or any drink or milk. No instructions for wifi, no instructions to operate old style shades without them inside of house is visible to all without curtains. Searching key was one hour job and laundry place too.

We stayed 5 nights at this place and loved it. Great location, within walking distance to a lot of things and tons of shops and restaurants nearby - but tucked away enough that it is very quiet at night so you can get good sleep. Very easy to check in and out, Tania replied our messages very quickly, and everything was super clean. The weather was very hot during our stay, but there is a fan and it is not too bad if you open the windows. I would definitely stay here again :)
Great place! Easy to find and really pretty area.

Our stay at EMA House was absolutely wonderful! From the moment we arrived, the check-in process was seamless, thanks to the warm and welcoming staff member who greeted us. She was incredibly helpful in explaining how to use various appliances, such as the heater, dishwasher, and washing machine, ensuring we felt right at home. On our last day, I needed a vacuum to pack my sweaters, and the team went above and beyond to accommodate my request. Even though I felt like I was inconveniencing the housekeeping staff, they were incredibly kind and thoughtful, making the process effortless for me. The apartment itself was spotless, well-equipped with all the necessary amenities, and conveniently located just a few minutes’ walk from the tram. I highly recommend EMA House for anyone looking for a comfortable and hassle-free stay in the area. We truly appreciated their attention to detail and exceptional hospitality!
Close to shops, transportation which I loved.  Great communication Thank You 😊
Upstairs neighbor noise midnight to 2 am every night really left this place to be desired.

Very minimal and lacking. The host expected us to bring/buy our own bathroom soap, laundry detergent, nespresso pods. I would've appreciated at least a heads up in the check-in instructions that I'd need to prepare these ahead of time. It was frustrating for us to scramble to buy shampoo/body soap ourselves late at night and not be able to use the washer/dryer (which we explicitly filtered for when selecting this Airbnb). There was also hair on the dish sponge (would've expected a new one between each guest). Overall felt very cheap. Check-in times are a bit constrained so check your travel plans first. No flexibility with leaving luggage at the doorway after checkout.  Location is great and the apartment is very spacious. But unfortunately would not recommend.

Very disappointing experience and poor communication. I made this booking last minute, the evening before arrival, and informed the host within 20 minutes of booking that my flight would land at 22:40. It then became clear that the host did not want to allow check-in after 22:00 unless I paid an extra 25 CHF, even though this was only about one hour later. I was understandably worried about being left outside late at night and immediately asked to cancel the reservation. The host repeatedly read my messages without responding, or replied much later with vague and unclear answers. Despite knowing I would not be staying, the host kept my money. Given that this was a last-minute booking for the very next day, it clearly suited the host to keep the reservation rather than release it, as it was unlikely to be rebooked so late. Overall, the lack of communication, inflexibility, and unfair handling of the situation made this extremely stressful. I would not recommend this host, especially for
Great view!! We enjoyed every moment we stayed home. Watching the view of the city and mountain was one of our fun activity. And very easy smooth communication with Dimi as well. Highly recommended!

Unfortunately the apartment is inaccurately described. The apartment is a big studio and not an apartment with a separate bedroom. We had a baby with us and were counting on a separate room to put her to sleep.  After describing the inaccuracy and requested for a refund, Johannes tried to argue that he was considerate by purchasing us a crib (which I had to add money for), letting us stay “despite the listing explicitly stating that the apartment isn't suitable for children and babies” (I didn’t ask for an exception, he just approved our stay request) and by letting us check in after 11pm since our flight got delayed.  Johannes indeed made accommodations for us, but those weren’t relevant to the big inconvenience and injustice in having less bedroom than we thought we booked. I didn’t really appreciate his communication style after raising the problem and Airbnb ended up refunding me, The apartment is clean and modern but its on a noisy road so if it’s hot don’t count on the window
nothing could beat this location for a first time in Zurich as it's right in the middle of the old town
Defect location and value for money. Neighbours not to friendly, accused us of being loud when we were all sick in bed with food poisoning.  Avoid Kennedy’s Irish bar!!

Great location. Beautiful apartment. Very clean and comfortable (extremely comfortable beds). It is a climb to the apartment, but the description is very clear about that. Hyesook was very responsive and a lovely host. Highly recommend it to anyone looking to stay in Zurich- such easy access to train station and bus lines.

This listing is described as an apartment, but it did not feel like one. The space resembled a converted motel conference room, and the layout felt awkward and uncomfortable. The setup did not match the photos in the listing. Upon entering, there was a strong musty, damp odor throughout the space. The smell appeared to be coming from an adjacent room or closet next to the smaller bed, which was left open. When I looked inside, there was visible mold in that area. The room was cluttered and did not appear to have been thoroughly cleaned. The main heater was not functioning, which made it difficult to ventilate the space during winter to reduce the odor. The bedding was also not adequate for cold weather; the sheets and blankets were extremely thin and did not provide sufficient warmth. I was also given only one bath towel per person (for a 2.5 week stay). Many surfaces were dusty or dirty, and the kitchen items (utensils, pots, and pans) would need to be washed before use.

We chose this Airbnb because we loved all the windows and beautiful view of the garden. We were EXTREMELY DISAPPOINTED upon arrival to find the black out shutters in  the living room area in the down position and INOPERABLE‼️ all the other shutters in the rest of the house work fine.  And the other huge shocking revelation was at 7 AM the Start up time for construction crew outside the bedroom windows with constant hammering and drilling extremely loud.😖😖😖 They took a one hour lunch break so you get a little relief from 12 to 1 pm and then they worked till  3 pm, so from 7 AM to 3 PM constant drilling and hammering.  I find it to be rather strange that nobody mentioned this in their reviews. I would’ve given this apartment five stars had it not been for these problems.  I stay in Airbnb’s all over the world and this is the only one I’ve ever stayed in that had zero kitchen amenities, no coffee pods no tea, there was also no OIL as  listed in the description. The hot water is minimal

The apartment was clean and in a very convenient location right in front of a tram stop. It was also pleasant enough, and the host gave us a better apartment than that advertised. That said there were a lot of basics missing - for example, we ran out of toilet paper, there was no soap, or any of the usual pleasantries of an Airbnb property - soap, tissues, salt and pepper in the kitchen. The major issue however was that the host did not warn us of the works ongoing in the building.
