We intended to work from the apartment during one of the days, but this was impossible due to the extremely loud drilling just next door. I'm not sure I would revisit.

PLEASE READ BEFORE BOOKING. We informed the host that we would be arriving early for check-in, to which he replied that we could check in at any time. However, upon arrival, the keys (as another reviewer had mentioned) were not in the lockbox as described. We messaged the host, who did not respond for 2 hours. After a long day of travel we were forced to wait in the streets. After contacting Airbnb’s customer service, we finally got ahold of the host. He informed us that the reason the keys weren’t in the lockbox was because the cleaning person was in the apartment when we arrived.  When we finally got access to the Airbnb, not only were there five flights of stairs that were completely unmentioned in the listing, but the apartment had not be cleaned whatsoever. Toilet unflushed, musky smell, towels on the floor, bed unmade, couch a mess. And supposedly the reason we had to wait for two hours was because there was a cleaning service?  We got a refund and stayed elsewhere.

Want to start off by saying, Peter was a wonderful house attendant. He was attentive, responsive and willing to help me & my family with any request. Something we found strange was that we had to give a $1000 deposit in cash which was not paid via the Airbnb official app. Other than Peter and his hospitality, the house needs improvement. From the moment you walk in your told, “you can’t sit on that chair it’s over 100years old”, “be careful with the floor it’s government protected and needs to be treated with care”, “be careful with the lamp it’s 150 years old” not exactly a “warm welcome” after a long day of travel. The fact that we couldn’t sit down anywhere or touch anything made our stay feel unwelcome and cold. Additionally the house had many steps and floors with no elevator.  Back to the layout of the house- you walk-in past a couple of stairs and you reach the living area which is spacious. On the first floor you have an office room which is too old to even be in, living space, toilet and kitchen. We had an awful experience with the kitchen. The previous guests hired a chef that cooked a fish that stunk the entire space. The countertops were not clean and the lingering smell of fish made it impossible to be in the kitchen. The smell stayed throughout the entire trip.  The second floor had a master bedroom, bath, a room with a full bed and a massive walk in closet. The third floor had a third bedroom with a full bed, a mini living area with a TV and couch, and a bedroom with full bed. This floor also had a library with a pull out couch that should not be considered an extra room because the mattress is so thin all you felt were the springs.  Overall the stay was pleasant but not worth the price and we found the pictures to be deceiving.

The location is great and close to the train and bus station. The view is great. However, the fact that he lives there and his personal stuff are everywhere was so weird and made us feel uncomfortable. Also the flat isn’t professionally cleaned which is not ideal. He is responsive but sometimes he is aggressive with his responses and attitude
we have been their guests for multiple years and never been disappointed. you know exactly what you are buying into. see you again soon
The flat was fine and the owner replied quickly.

Wonderful host, very helpful from booking to check out. Eddie went above and beyond to ensure that we had a good stay! Comfortable home, clean and well stocked; loved the decor, super hospitality and communication. Walkable to all we needed. Highly recommend!

Marcs place gets the job done, the place is run down and needs maintenance. The window won't lock shut so it pops open randomly, the bathroom sink leaks all over the floor, it says that the washer and dryer is available to use on the listing but it's not.  I brought up a few of the issues to Marc who told me to "go downstairs on the first floor and find the property managers number to have the problems fixed and see if the landlord could give you a card for laundry". There was no ownership responsibility with Marc at all and he pushes the problems of the apartment onto his guests.
The apartment is large and airy with a view. There is a Coop in the same building and the tram to central Zurich is right in front of building. It is also short walk to hiking trails or to the river.

Good apartment in a convenient central location.  Very close to the lake and transport.  There is a bit of noise from the street, but that's probably to be expected given the central location. Plenty of space for a family of 4. Compared to others in Switzerland the furniture is a bit tired, and the kitchen is small, but I'd stay here again if coming to Zurich.
Nice place for a studio but a bit noisy.

Take your own coffe maker and tepot for hot water. There is no towels also in the room. Also its laud on the streets drunk and stoned people make a lot of noise.  The scream they party a lot of night clubs are near by. Terrible
Hard time to get in, the external door does not open -, little apartment, no Air conditioning. The host was not responsive to calls only messages.

We enjoyed our visit enormously and enjoyed the convenience of the apartment to Zurich and the local area. The apartment was clean, well furnished met our full expectations. However, our apartment was on the ground floor on the side of a busy street that meant it was noisy at night. There is nothing that could be done about this but it was our only negative.   4/ 5

I had a very unpleasnt stay.  - First starting at the check in, there was a constrcution at the entracne. I kept moving back and forth looking for the flat until I found out that the entrace is behind the construction.  - As soon as I opened the door of the flat, I could smell a very bad smell. Later on I found some strange liquid in the trash bag wish I assume was causing the smell. - Also for the most important thing "the noise", which I asked Bahri about first thing when I requested renting the place. In his reponse and I quote he wrote " yes it‘s indeed quite calm but there is a street in front of the building. In case the window is closed it‘s totally fine and you don‘t hear anything. " The reality is, it is extremely loud when the window is closed, you hear everything tram, motor bikes cars everything. I had to sleep with earplugs every single night.  Early morning, starting between 5 and 6,  the street is never quite.  - The internet is very slow.  Overall this stay was terrible
The house is very comfortable，especially the bed

A nice host that we did not meet in person but through messages. The only thing that bothered us is the incorrect check out time that is different than what is written in the description, we had to check out by 9 AM. But that’s about it and everything else is Ok.

I’ve been staying there for 2 months, super nice and helpful staff, great location not that far from Altstatten train station and shopping center. The rooms were clean and comfortable, I can only reccomend!

The place was in a decent location as it was walkable to shops & restaurants. The inside was as described,  pretty plain & simple. We found it terribly noisy at night (perhaps the weekend?) loud nightclub music until 3am. Some of the sheets had stains. Bathroom was not adequately cleaned from prior usage & we had inadequate bath towels for 5 people.

Negatives:  - Coffee machine was not working upon arrival - Host stopped replying to us after we let them know - WiFi was very inconsistent so we had to use phone hotspot instead  - There was no bathtub as listed, only shower with mold at the bottom. Very problematic when traveling with a baby - Temperature was consistently 23-24 degrees in apartment, even when 16 outside. We couldn’t sleep with windows open due to Airbnb being on a very noisy road - Someone (host?)  was renovating the apartment upstairs from our Airbnb at 21:00, using power tools . We had to ask them to stop due to sleeping baby. Even then they begged to continue making noise for another ten minutes  - Floor was not clean upon arrival. Long hair was everywhere  Positives:  - We called them ahead of our arrival and got early check-in, thank you! - Except for the noisy road, the Airbnb is located in a great location close to good restaurants and cafes
Great alt location if you are looking for a place that is quiet but near the city, the house is within 10-15 minutes walk from train station, bus, tram stops and grocery stores.
Not again. Poor apartment condition , issues not solved.

Katrin’s space is a nicely decorated three bedroom, one bathroom apartment. She shares the space with two roommates. The apartment is well equipped with modern appliances such as a washer/dryer, and it is a 10-minute walk from the metro station which easily connects you to Zurich HB and the old town. We had some miscommunication with  check-in, but when Katrin realized the issue, she returned to the apartment to open the door for us. The price and location make this a good option in Zurich for budget travelers.
In a quiet area and walkable to the water, restaurants, amenities etc.
Dimiter‘s place was perfect for our short stay in Zurich. Very clean and comfortable. I would book it again.
Lovely place.   App-based locks and missing physical key left for some anxiety about getting in and out.  For summer stays, place needs air conditioning
Frederich was a warm and responsive host. He was easy to communicate with and assisted me very promptly when needed. I can recommend a stay with Frederich.
picture is a different look from reality of the building image.
Alessandro was very cooperative and accommodating. The flat is very nice and comfortable. We had everything we needed. The surroundings a bit noisy but the windows double glazed

Had a great 1 night stay. Was right in the heart of old town. Check in instructions were easy to follow. Very spacious. A few mild things: - there are 3 steep flights of stairs with no elevator. Can be tough if you have heavy luggage or unable to climb stairs - the floors are very very creaky and are unlevel in some areas. - Because it's right in the old town, it can be noisy at night These didn't bother us, but may bother some guests.
Nice apartment in the middle of Zürich
No AC , the road noise in the night

I really wanted to enjoy our stay, but unfortunately it fell short of expectations. The biggest issue was cleanliness—the bed sheets were visibly dirty when we arrived, which immediately made us uncomfortable. The parking situation was also very frustrating, with limited spaces and no clear guidance, making it difficult to find a place to park. On top of that, the neighbors were rude, which made it hard to relax and enjoy the property. While the Airbnb itself had potential, these issues significantly impacted our experience. I hope the host addresses the cleanliness concerns and provides better information about parking, but based on our stay, I can’t recommend this property.

Our 2 night stay at Frank's place was fine. It seems he airbnbs many apartments in Zurich because some of the apartment instructions and responses to questions we asked were not relevant to the building.  For the high price, it was surprisingly plain and understocked. There was 1 roll of toilet paper for 8 people, and not enough kitchen towels for dish drying - considering there is no dishwasher.  Additionally we struggled to print our city parking permit due to lack of prior communication around parking causing a pre-christmas printing scramble.

Our stay at this Airbnb was unfortunately not what we expected. The entrance is directly between a restaurant’s seating area, and as we brought in our five suitcases and tried to unlock the door, servers were walking around us to reach the kitchen. Inside, we had to climb three extremely steep flights of very narrow stairs, with no landing at the top, making it difficult and unsafe with luggage. The listing is also inaccurate: it is not 2 full baths and 3 bedrooms, but 1.5 baths, 2 real bedrooms, and an upstairs space that feels more like storage. There is no air conditioning, and although we asked for a fan, the host only replied the next day to say he didn’t have one. The apartment is extremely noisy, and closing the windows makes the rooms even hotter. The balconies were nice, and the location is central—close to the train station and not far from the airport, but overall, the heat, noise, unsafe stairs, and inaccurate listing made this a disappointing stay.

Sofia was extremely responsive, very friendly and always guest focussed. The room and the apartment overall especially the bathroom is small. The neighborhood is great, really in the middle of the old town but can also be very noisy.

Isabelle's home is beautiful.  i especially enjoyed the garden where I could sit in the sunshine sipping a glass of wine while I read my book.  very peaceful.   The room and bathroom were both lovely and very clean.  Thank you Isabelle!

Stylish, yes; sterile in a non surgical way, yes! There is a kitchen and a mocha coffee pot, but no complimentary coffee, not even for one day. There is no extra light bulbs in case one is burnt. Bring your own shampoo, conditioner and body wash. There is only a tiny bar of soap. One table light has no plug to be used     The modem is right on top of one of the night table. There are no blackout curtains and the only one that is thick enough does not even cover the glass door. The place is spacious yes, and a great bathtub, but the fact that you have to bring your own bubble bath bottle does not worth the value. If these amenities would have been included in this place, then it would have deserved 5 stars.

Read the reviews before booking.  Pros: - Convenient, near the bridge and near Coop. 8 minutes walk from Zurich HB - Clean, even though the bathroom and toilet are shared, they are very clean Cons - No fan or aircon for the summer, was really hot. If you close the window, there's no ventilation, if you open the window you can hear the shouting up till 4am. They do provide ear plugs. Trust me, you need it. - Walls are crazy thin and there was this other tentant who was CRAZILY BANGING on the door at 2am. That I think woke everyone up. - I had other booking made at the same accommodation booked at the end of June (end of my trip), but it got cancelled just about 2weeks before.  Host just stated as maintenance issue, which left me with no choice but to book way more expensive accommodation.

The place is great, very well located, near the train station, very secure, checkin and checkout was fast and easy. The comunication with the host was greate, he was very fast replying and very kind. I would stay there again.
Perfect location - perfect host! Can strongly recommend Tania and her properties.

No question, this was our worst AirBnB experience ever in 12+ years of bookings. Bedbugs in the pillows left my husband with welts on his face and hands our first morning there, followed by an allergic reaction and two weeks to heal, not to mention spending endless hours after our visit laundering all our clothing, and cleaning everything that went with us on the trip. As we alerted the host to this and various additional issues (see below), she did not apologize or take responsibility: it was all just taken as information we were providing her with vs a total failure to provide a hospitable experience for paying guests. Her response to the bed bugs report was an appalling, “Thanks for the information,” and a long explanation of how this is not her fault, not an issues of cleanliness (despite myriad cleanliness issues in the kitchen), likely the fault of a previous guest, and on and on. No apology. No offer of a refund. A truly stunning response to a completely unacceptable experience.  The other issues with the flat obviously pale in comparison but are worth enumerating, presuming the bedbug issue ever gets resolved. This was a zero hospitality experience from start to finish. Pots we wanted to use to make dinner were found in the cabinet with food residue still on them. The coffeemaker’s water reservoir had mildew + discarded coffee pods from previous visitors and uncleaned layers of residue in the discard bin. The oven did not work; we alerted the host; she did not offer to fix it and implied it was our error. We spent our own time fixing it: it was not our error but a malfunction that a repair person should have attended to. The washing machine listed as an amenity with the flat is not actually accessible to renters without making an appointment with the host and going to her office (not on-site) to collect an access key. The bathroom is in dire need of an update: I barely wanted to use the shower it is so old and unpleasant. The kitchen has - literally - nothing to offer besides salt and pepper: no olive oil, no small pack of sugar, no couple of coffee pods for your first morning, none of the usual AirBnB “welcome and feel at home” touches we encounter elsewhere almost universally, certainly in places rented at this price (and which would cost the host next to nothing). The decor is in the style of late ’80’s mismatched Ikea. All in all, the entire place reeked of, “I am in this to make money while doing as little as humanly possible to get it.”  Given what Switzerland has to offer in terms of cleanliness and hospitality, we cannot recommend that anyone stay with this host.  Oh - except there is an elevator. There’s that.
The room is very clean and tidy. Streahinja prepare the some snacks in the apartment. But the parking lot is difficult to find. There are some limited parking areas we cannot to park.

The apt is exactly as advertised. However, we had a very unfortunate incident where we have been accused to have lost the apt key and were pushed to pay 1k for the replacement of the locker which was not need at the end. I, fully pregnant, was staying with my husband and a small child in the apt and since we were given only one key we used the locker for storage as both of us are working. The key was removed by another airbnb guest as we later found out which lead to the situation: me alone in the cold (0 degrees) with my baby waiting for the key service which did not arrive until 2 hours later. However, this was nothing in compare to how I was treated over the phone by the apt manager - I will spare the details. It was already late in the evening and my baby was crying for nearly two hours straight being exhausted. This did not prevent the manager to shout at me over the phone without even one moment of sympathy. After this incident we moved out one knight earlier.

Big room and good bed, we had a nice sleep while staying there. The room is located near many restaurants that have good reviews on google, also walkable from Zurich HB station, but we used tram to get there which is easier. ***Not recommend for woman with heavy 26”-28” luggages since there is no lift and narrow stairs****

The apartment has a great location and was very clean. However, there were no big fans or air conditioning, and it was extremely hot during our stay in June, which made it difficult to sleep at night. Also, it's on the second floor with no elevator, so guests with heavy luggage should be aware. Overall, it was a good stay.
Incredible apartment, right by the train, we will stay again!

The experience with the apartment was awful. The apartment was quite dirty, and the worst part was that all the sheets and towels had lots of hair on them from previous guests. In addition, there is a bar downstairs, and there were drunk people shouting all night. The apartment was very poorly soundproofed, and it was impossible to sleep until they finally left at almost 5 a.m. NOT RECOMMENDED
Affordable studio with everything we needed for our Zurich weekend! Convenient and walkable location from the train station.
It was nice location walkable easy to get bus and train  Felt we are at our home

Host is unreasonable and deceptive. I stayed with the host for 20 nights and paid over 3K of which 500CHF in cleaning fees!  I cleaned the entire apartment from start to end— And upon checkout the host wanted me to pay an additional 200CHF for a little dust in a corner. Host. By far worst host I ever experienced. I had to was all cushions, sheets and towels because it was all dank. But the absolute most disgusting part was the hosts condescending nature and how rude she feels she has to to be with whoever she wants.  She absolutely takes advantage of her position and is shady and manipulative—Also the ‘host’ over uses exclamation points.
The apartment is well furnished and tidy. The neighborhood was really quite and near the city center.

The apartment itself was fine — the location was great, access was easy, and communication with the host was smooth. But unfortunately, my stay was very disappointing because there was no hot water throughout my entire stay, which is a basic need when renting a place. 😥Importantly, the issue did not start on the day of my arrival — the host admitted it had happened earlier but didn’t inform me. Had I known, I could have made other arrangements! Additionally, the bed linens were dirty — full of crumbs and cat hair. I reported this to Airbnb with photographic evidence, I have allergies, so it caused me a lot of discomfort and required taking medication:( Due to these serious issues, I had to contact Airbnb support to request a refund. Staying for three days in cold weather without hot water is absolutely unacceptable🙅🏻‍♀️🙅🏻‍♀️

Very clean little apartment, had everything to feel right at home. Very convenient location as well with transport links to the city, or it was just about a 40 minute walk. Would definitely recommend!
Good place, but it is way smaller than the pictures. It is not walking distance to the tourist areas, but it is close enough.

100% do not recommend to stay here. We’ve got not properly cleaned room with dust and dirty bad sheets (old blood stains or something). We asked to switch it and they didn’t do that. Also the person who manages the Airbnb account is based in Dubai and doesn’t give you any help with some apartment issues. She just gives a general info about the place. In the place there’s only a security man who keeps a key. When we come, he wasn’t aware about our reservation (but it already was paid and approved by host).

Norell place was a small, cute place located about 1 mile from some of Zurich's main attractions. Her place was perfect for an extended stay and offered a great kitchen, laundry and all the necessities I could need for 8 days. Norell was extremely helpful.

As other reviews have said, the place lacks basic needs such as soap in the shower area, no cold air conditioner OR even a fan, you will be awfully hot in the room. The bed mattress is old, uncomfortable (sagging in the middle), the pillows are terrible. The bathroom is very dark, the old light bulb is not bright at all. The checkout reservation said 1pm but the host will message you to leave at 12pm instead, stealing one hour from your paid time. The neighborhood seems dangerous, there's graffiti everywhere. Also, since there's no air circulating, you will have to open the windows and all the neighbors seem to smoke and you will smell like cigarette all the time. There's a lot of noise from neighbors. There is no lock-box inside for valuables. There is no microwave oven. The TV is useless, there is no cable, zero channels. This place is worth a quarter of what was paid. The price was way too much for the value received. There are no blackout curtains, you will sleep with all the light outside. The shower drain is clogged. There are visible cockroach traps everywhere, giving you a hint of how nasty this place really is. It is a very old, uncomfortable dangerous place in my opinion. Overall the place is very overrated.

The stay was ok except the fact that Pietro was a little territorial about his kitchen!  He would hover around till the time I finished cooking. It became really uncomfortable using the kitchen after a point! If you need a kitchen, as I did, I wouldnt suggest the place.
Jaybee’s place was just as depicted in the app. Very cozy with a balcony, TV, microwave and counter top oven. The place is also situated near public transport and riverside park.

The place is ideal for families or groups of friends. It is a bit pricey but it saves you from having to deal with Swiss rules about separating garbage, not doing laundry on Sundays or having neighbors that complain about flushing the toilet during the night. It is very close (5 min walk, 1 stop by bus) to Oerlikon train station where you can go to most places in Switzerland or go to the city center in only 5 mins. There are a lot of shops nearby, which is very convenient. The building has an elevator, which is helpful if you travel with a lot of suitcases. The best features for me where that the kitchen was well equipped (eating out everyday in Zurich is super expensive) and the check-in is done through a safe box so you don’t have to worry about being there at a specific time, specially if you’re arriving by plane. Anna was very helpful, responsive and nice. The place might look small but it’s average by swiss standards. It is enough for 4 people, perfect for 2.  I highly recommend it, specially if you’re looking for location and convenience and prefer to pay a little extra instead of worrying about learning complicated Swiss house rules.
The flat and the room were really nice, welcoming and well located. This, and Francesco's lovely roommate made me feel like home!

The apartment is well located and although small, the space is quite well arranged. The one significant problem I encountered was that it is very well insulated, but not very well ventilated, so it became very warm inside even when the weather was not especially hot. Sleeping with the balcony door open made it bearable but I think this would become quite unpleasant in summer weather.

Good location ,but so noisy at night  and lack of air condition is the major issue. You can not open the window because of noise and without opening the window due to lack of AC it is hard to be comfortable.
I was there with my father. He absolutely loved the place, is full of beautiful plants and the apparment was spotless. we really enjoy our time there
Great place to stay. Very walkable for going into Old Town, and the place had a great view.

I was staying at this property for 9 days from 25/2-6/3 and sadly this flat didn’t meet my standards or expectations . It’s completely unmodernized  with creaky floors , very bad soundproofing, a lot of appliances didn’t work , especially essentials like oven. Very dirty communal washing machine and the dryer . Very dated kitchen and the bathroom . Over all very disappointing stay , the flat isn’t worth what I paid for. The only good thing is location.
Eric is a boss and let us stay in a proper Airbnb

Please be careful about the apartment. There is only 1 bath and 1 wc. The listing is misrepresented as having 2 baths. Tania considers wash basins as baths. There is only 1 bath and 1 wc meant for 8 people. When complained at checkin the host doesnt respond for 2 days leaving you in trouble

This is a nice place - but we faced issues with the flat on arrival. There was some hair on the bed, dust on the floor and the toilets had not been flushed (there was urine around the toilet basin). As a result we left the place immediately upon arrival to check into a hotel.  Note as well we didn’t know there would be no air conditioning (and during the summer, Zurich can reach 30-34C temperatures.  We asked for the funds we paid to be returned since we didn’t stay in the flat, but unfortunately the host was not willing to return the funds we paid.
The location was great for our needs. Lots of space for four travelers. Trains, trams, and buses are all close.

The apartment is located in the dodgy end of town and it and the room were not very clean. The living area had a smell and was quite hot, the bathroom was messy with clothes piled on the drying machine, and the room itself was dusty. It was nice to have a double bed but the mattress does not have a protector and is stained and has hair on it. One of the main reasons I booked this place was because it had a washer/dryer but the owner did not inform in any way that the dryer was not working, so when I discovered this at 9pm I had to hang my clothes on the bed and in the wardrobe because the clothes hanger on the balcony is tiny and they were still wet the next day when I had to check out. I know Zurich is expensive but the price for what was provided here is not acceptable in my opinion. It's worth spending a bit more for a clean hotel room and private space instead.
Everything is ok, just the kitchen basin problem. Thanks for everything...

exactly as shown in the pictures and clean.  close proximity to the city center, anywhere you want to go is easily walkable (aside from getting to/from the airport, i didn’t use public transportation once).  beware of the slope on the ceiling of the shower, if you’re tall you’ll basically have to stand in place.  do note that there is no A/C so if you are unlucky to get a heat wave, it could be quite uncomfortable as you are on the top floor.
mattress with no cot, no wifi, location close to public transport trams, small room and little difficult to find the key to get in.

We stayed only 2 nights but paid for eight because of Health Issues  There is mold in the Bathroom and place was not satisfactory sanitized  We could not get a response probably because of the Holydays Waste of money, not worth what we paid for
Location is everything about this place. You can walk to everything in old town and Rafa is an incredible host!

Alex is one of the nicest and kindest persons you ever come across. It was the first time for me to stay in somebody’s private space, but Alex went out of her way to make me feel at home. Would stay at her place anytime again.

This list is deceptive and should not be on Airbnb. The apartment is extremely small, not to mention poorly ventilated (no fan despite one being mentioned, no AC, windows on one side which provide no breeze at all). Also, the apartment is very poorly lit to the point that there are no ceiling light fixtures and the lamps did not seem to work.

Don't be fooled by the wide angle pictures like me. The place is tiny. It's not worth be price for a day, definitely not if you need it longer term. Finding the place was a pain at night with no lights. They have a locker box that is no where to be seen. The address I received was incorrect. The instructions don't mention the apartment number. SHORT STAY: The bed is missing some slats and you feel them every time you turn to that side of the bed. The lobby has a very heavy smell of cigarettes and there's on overall cheap feeling to the place. FOR LONG-TERM STAYS: In theory it has all the amenities, but everything seems to like a reject from the flea market that never sold. The pots are de-shaped and have permanent stains on them. So do the utensils. It feels like they never bothered to check / clean things after the last guest left. The bathroom is tiny and you have to shift around before you can close the door (and I'm a slim person.) The shower has no door or curtain so the entire thing gets wet after every shower. The water might get to the bedroom if you're not careful. Won't return. Won't recommend. Will strongly and vehemently discourage!

value wise this place is great. It has all you need in a great location but it wasnt a “5 star experience”. We got the wrong key and although the host responded very quickly, it still took 1h to get someone to bring us the right key. The sink was a bit clogged which made it hard to use properly and the toilet didnt always flush very well. The shower head was broken as well which meant water flew everywhere. For the rest everything was very clean and exactly as seen on the pictures, definitely worth the stay for a great price.
Everything you could ask for in a prime location, communicative host!

First of all, I was really disappointed in the fact that Sebastian was aware that there were two guests staying at his AirB&B from the initial contact, and only the day before check-in he sent us a message asking for additional funds for a second guest to stay. This blind-sighted us, as the additional fee wasn't outlined in his listing description and throughout our conversations leading up to the day before check-in. When addressed, he was very rude and unaccommodating and we were left with no choice but to pay the additional "guest fee" as we were left stranded with no international service to be able to voice our concerns with AirB&B appropriately and in a timely manner. Secondly, upon arrival we found out that he actually provided the wrong building address in his listing, which caused us a lot of distress as we were lugging our luggage around in the rain to find the apartment building. Once we identified the building, which was in a separate message, got inside, we found all of his personal belongings were scattered about, which he indicated "just to ignore". There was also an infestation of fruit flies, which we also addressed with him, and he wasn't accommodating to this issue, which left us with an uncomfortable stay. The bathtub was clogged and caused disgusting, dirty water to build up around our feet to our ankles during showers and he didn't provide a shower curtain which had us having to constantly clean the water that splashed out. Additionally, the "second bed" sofa located in the living room, wasn't connected securely, and kept falling apart in the middle of the night, which disrupted our sleep. While, Sebastian was responding to these issues, he wanted to do them offline (off the AirB&B platform) which I was not comfortable with. As wonderful as the location is, I would not recommend staying with Sebastian.

This was quite a basic stay. The location is very convenient, only taking about 10 to 15 minutes to get into the city. However, when we arrived there was a puddle of water from the radiator and when we used the washing machine the grey water was not plumbed in, resulting in all of going on the bathroom floor.
Wonderful apartment in a great neighborhood. Very close to the tram/buses. the apartment was clean and had a lovely balcony. I would highly recommend staying again in the future.

It is well located apartment, matching the photos and description. If travelling from UE, plug in adapters are needed. Checkout was done unproperly, overlaping the next guests arrival while I wasn't checkout yet. Awkward situation that ruined the perspective of my stay.
Very, very spacious for gathering with a group of 10.
The place definitely do not look like the place really is. In addition it is a very small unit

I don’t understand the reason which he wants that you clean his “apartament”, and do what the person in charge of cleaning should do,  he was a little rude, his “apartment” don’t have elevator and he won’t help… Anyway, his price about his “apartament”  is too much for what it really is. But, when the people have hurry might pay any price.

Tania was a very accommodating and communicative host.  When our first apartment option did not work out, she offered us 2 other options or a full refund, all of which were very acceptable - we opted for one of her other apartments.   The apartment we selected was very clean and neat and had all the basic amenities.  Waldmanmstrasse 8 was perfectly situated, central to everything - the University, restaurants, stores, a good grocery, walking distance to the central train station and 2 blocks to the tram. The most important thing was that Tania helped to make everything work out and our stay was very enjoyable. The best recommendation I can make is to say I would work with Tania again.

The good: location. You can't beat staying right on the river.  The bad: location. Open your window and cigarette smoke fills your room from the smokers' cafe below.  The real problem we had was when we arrived to meet with our host, there was no one around. Messages through Airbnb, a text and an email went unanswered. This is after we were asked to contact the host if we would be late. 35 minutes with no communication is a long time to wait and wonder if you have a place to stay. Had I received a message that the host was running late, that would have been fine. It was the not knowing that was the problem. We even knocked on an apartment door and asked if they knew Blanca. Despite the fact that our apartment turned out to be next door, the woman who answered had never heard of a Blanca.

No clear instructions on check in, which is inside a shop, not communicated. The gentleman who showed me to the room was very polite. The kitchenette is a wooden board with a sink and a microwave. The bed was pretty uncomfortable. I was spoken to very rudely when told to check out at 11, as if the staff assumed I wasn’t going to check out at that time. I felt awkward using the toilet before I left, it was like I wasn’t wanted there and had overstayed my welcome. Staff saw me leaving, didn’t offer to help with my heavy luggage and didn’t even say goodbye. Not worth the money.
There was some smell in the flat which could not be removed even with the windows open the whole time.
Beautiful apartment and a very helpful host! Definitely worth it.

Check-in was smooth and the location was convenient, with easy access to the tram. However, the overall stay was disappointing.  We also noticed spider webs in several corners, and basic amenities like shampoo were not provided. For the price paid, we expected at least the essentials to be in place.
Ordinary location. It was very difficult to find parking. I lived on the fifth floor without an elevator, a very tiring experience

Comfortable enough apartment in great location,  unfortunately the price was raised by 15% a few hours before check in because I mentioned we might be 2 people at some point. So, 15% increase went to 1 extra towel, and 1 extra blanket because none of the blankets were big enough for 2 people. All in all great apartment, but considering the linens and towels were old and uncomfortable, the price increase was disappointing and strange.

I had a very bad experience with this host, especially due to his rude and uncooperative behavior. The pictures on the listing look good, but in reality the apartment is very old and poorly maintained. The washroom was not in good condition, and the overall facilities did not match what was advertised. For the price I paid for a 2-day booking, it felt like a complete waste of money. I would not recommend this place to anyone.
Lovely apartment, well stocked, and close to public transportation making it easy to see the city.

the place was neat with great view and potential, but not well set up with minimal furnishings (bed, sofa, table/chairs and couple floor lamps, literally nothing else). no window coverings so got light early (said would put some up so might want to check if now there) since lots of windows and skylight over bed. smoke detector was missing, had problems with WiFi being too weak but that was finally resolved. floors were coming apart (gaps in photos) and tall weeds on terrace. lots of children in building which were loud late. many reviews posted were not for this location.

Great place :) so quiet and peaceful area of Zurich. The price is worth it! Great attention and communication from the host and the place is so clean and well maintained, I’ll definitely come back when I return to Zurich
Very cozy room in Zurich, 2 mins to the train station, very convenient;)

The room perfectly fits one person,  women only makes me feel safe. Room looks perfect, small but all needed facilities are included. 2 things that can be improved are checkin and cleaning. Host sent the wrong password, but host didn’t respond me for 1 day after I messaged.  I waited outside for 1 hour before I figured out the correct password myself.  As for cleaning, I hang the tag outside before 11am but the room was not cleaned. Hope this can be improved.  Over all it’s a quite good place to stay and close to the center. Recommend!

Booked the place for my wife and her niece.  I must note that Michael doesn't offer any flexibility while checking in, 3 pm is 3 pm! Also you must not expect him to give you recommendations on what to do. I would suggest him to revise that in his listing. He will ask you to refer to Trip Advisor!  He gave  a wrong code of the Key safe, which made the two ladies  struggle with it for over 45 minutes. That was an inconvenience!
Overall, ok, but I would not recommend staying here for more than one night. Very busy nightlife location and bed linen was very old and used. Very uncomfortable night’s sleep.

It was the biggest number of rules and demands from the host that I faced in my Airbnb history.    The list of expectations from the guests does not match the quality of services provided. The first day we came it was a huge late night party next door. From time to time groups of people walk outside making a noise during the late hours. The floor down there is a reconstruction of apartment. It is noisy routine and the dust covers all the stairs down to the first floor. The environment of the apartment very ascetic. There is no a single decoration. Even broken hangers tight to the frame by a rope. The are no channels to watch on TV. No iron. The laundry room in the basement is dusty. The molded bathroom, tab clog, distorted toilet seat - it is owner's attitude toward the guests who are required to wash and place back all the dishes. It feels that the place is running by company and hospitality is not their priority.

Very spacious, really conveniently located right by main train station (5 minute walk or less). Very comfortable beds and bedding, stylish space. We used to live in Zurich and this is a gigantic flat. Four really large bedrooms and large kitchen/dining/lounge area. Washing machine and rack for clothes drying in apartment. The only bizarre thing is the location of the toilet outside the flat down 5 stairs. There is a sink and shower in the apartment but the toilet is in a room off the stairwell. It is private, not shared with anyone else, just an odd quirk of the building and a non-issue during the day but slightly annoying if you get up often at night to use the bathroom. That wouldn’t stop me from staying here again. It’s a great place!

If there was only one word to describe this property it would be "seedy".  On entering the property we had to climb over a number of bikes dropped in the lobby.  The advertised lift did not go to the floor where the apartment was, so suitcases had to be hauled up or down the stairs.  Opening the front door, we were assailed by a musty smell.  There were no white sparkling walls as shown in the ad.  The property looked like it had been used as a student flophouse for a decade.  The floors were very dark and the walls grubby looking.  The worst parts were the shower and toilet.  Bore no resemblance to the photos.  The shower had a glass/metal 3 leaved door that left a very narrow opening, not a curtain as shown.  The toilet was virtually inaccessible, with a sink in front to the left and water pipes to the right. I am a larger person and was not able to use the toilet at all (not so big that I have ever had this problem before).  We left immediately and had to check in to a hotel.

We booked this apartment because it was advertised as non-smoking, but unfortunately the space had a very strong cigarette odor throughout the unit and even in the building hallways. The smell was overwhelming, and despite following the host’s instructions to try to reduce it, it did not go away. This was especially concerning because we specifically chose a non-smoking property for health reasons. In addition, the flat was extremely noisy at night. One side faces a busy street and restaurant patio, while the other side faces a restaurant courtyard. Patrons were outside late into the night, which made it difficult to sleep. Between the cigarette smoke and the constant noise, this was not the comfortable stay we expected, especially at this price point. The location itself is convenient, but if you are sensitive to smoke or noise, I would recommend looking elsewhere.

This was the worst Airbnb experience I've ever had. The room was much smaller than advertised, dirty, smelly, and had an inclined floor. The cleaning staff was rude and unprofessional, and they tried to enter our apartment late at night, likely with a key. We felt unsafe, had to call the police, and ended up booking an expensive hotel last minute. I wouldn’t recommend this listing to anyone.

Lots of rules. Lots of possible surcharges. Not a great location. Small room with the stiffest ikea mattress. Host is communicative so I think he thinks he means well, so I hope this feedback is taken constructively.
This light bright, two bedroom apartment was perfect for our family and centrally located with great access to the river, the lake, and numerous restaurants and shops.

For a few nights this place would be fine, if your here to party for example, then it's prime location.  Any longer however and the noise on the street and the shady people is a real turn off.  The flat itself is modern and functioning so this is not an insult to the host itself but think it's fair to say the outlook from the flat and all that entails was grim and depressing.

My stay was ok, manageable.  Place is very close to Zurich central - that is good thing about it. But in my stay i faced  - Only one bathroom functional - Kitchen  sync got blocked and had to wait fo rwater to go  - my time wasted - the apartement infrastructure allow either hot water or kitchen gas stove to work at a time - No lift to apartment -  I have to carry all my luggage to 2nd floor etc.

We were extremely comfortable and it felt like home for four weeks. Location was very central and was steps from a tram stop that made it easy to access The Opera House area, haute banhoff (HB), Kruetsplatz, and Stadlehofen. Also very convenient to groceries and pharmacy. We would consider staying there again.
rooms temperature is uncomfortable, too hot with no way to cool it. ongoing construction on the road next to the hotel, very noisy and very ugly vew
Great spacious apartment in a great location close to Zurich. Supermarkets, restaurants and bars a short walk from the apartment along with the public transport.

We enjoyed our time at this quiet, peaceful, and serene guest home. It was great to be just a few minutes walk to the train. Perhaps most appreciated was all of the helpful communication with our amazing host - before and during our trip to Zurich. I can’t wait to make it back someday.

Great location for Theatre 11.  Nice spacious flat with large windows that open and a small balcony.  Very loud noise from the street. The apartment was quite dirty.  It hadn't been vacuumed or dusted. There was long hair throughout, especially in the bathroom and shower.

Charles and Karina were the perfect hosts...Karina came to meet me at the central station, they were meticulous in explaining the accomodation and the surrounding area, and nothing was too much trouble.  I often stay in this sort of accomodation, but Charles' place is exceptional!
I had a great stay at the place. The environment is quiet and peaceful. I have a good rest.

Unfortunately, my stay was not very comfortable. The cleanliness did not meet my expectations – the bathroom had an unpleasant smell, and the room itself could have been cleaner (there were hairs on the bed and the floor wasn’t spotless). Since I arrived quite late in the evening, I stayed, but otherwise I might have considered leaving. With some improvements in cleaning standards, the experience could be much better.
It was not a nice stay. The bar below was playing loader music up to 3am and the blackout was not enough with too much light getting in the room.

We were not happy with the service, there was lots and lots of flies in the room we couldnt sleep at night. We told them to change our room or do something about it the first night nothing was done and got told the next day it will be sorted but wasnt. The next night same issue.  The room was extermely hot exactly like a sauna no airconditining, just a fan was ridiculus.  Overall customer service was bad.
behaviour isn't good. she is not co-operative.

This is a good place but be aware that the tram line runs behind the apartment complex. Will be noisy through the day. The convenience of the tram being nearby is also an inconvenience due to noise. There is an apartment hotel behind which throws a lot of light through the night so you will need to close your blinds thus reducing air flow in summer. Next time I would ask for a fan in summer!

Toilettes such as hand soap ran out and no shower gel in the bathroom despite included in listing. We rented the place and should have the freedom to open the windows and blinds as we like. Privacy is a basic right and should be respected at all times. We do not appreciate being pried on and playing housekeeping.

We really needed a place with air conditioning for our health. We messaged asking if the AC worked. It did not keep up with the heat and was worse than being outside. It was over 90 degrees inside for over 24hours. In my opinion, they lied about the AC working and overcharged greatly for this location and dangerous conditions. There were swarms of flies in every room as well. Otherwise a nice place, but not during the summer. I would avoid this place unless you are coming in spring, fall, or winter. Do not come in summer.

the whole place needs to get things fixed before asking people to come. it's just bad when people feel like it's a bait and switch. the house js advertised as if it's a rare find. I have stayed in many many it is a very rare occasion where I showed up at the place and refused to check-in that's how bad it is. The room was not ready and there are used sheets in the bed when the room was shown to be and I have seen what the maids did to clean and get the room ready for me in 2 minutes  I refused to sleep on that bed as I felt it was not clean at all or in any way ready for someone to sleep during Covid.  the showers are shared and are like 10 doors down and I was told the wifi is not strong I need to sit near the restrooms on a couch in common area to get wifi.  this is not what was advertised. it's bad. and my first bad review I thought again to see if I should even review. I think people should know how bad this place is before they show up. the parking is a joke it's non existing.  the entrance looked like a dumpster and they said they are doing renovation so can't enter thru main entrance so has to be taken thru the backdoor. please avoid this place if you can find better place. I lost €160 because I don't want to stay but I am glad I did not stay in the place

The flat is on 4 th floor...we had to carry our luggage by hand ..no lift in the building.... neighbour started complaining about noise of our luggage being dragged to the flat . The lock was not visible at night and it took 20 min to open the lock and get the keys ...the hot top was difficult to start ...the sofa cum bed was difficult to install and neighbours complained when it made noise ...the flat floor makes noise even when one walks normally on it
Nice apartment, but it’s around bars so it could get noisy at night.

Overall, the apartment was clean, but I had several issues that made my stay unpleasant and below expectations. The washer and dryer unfortunately did not work for us and gave error messages. Since this was a short stay, we were mostly out and did not have time to arrange for maintenance or wait around in the apartment. In the bathroom, the condition was disappointing. The plastic sheeting in the bathtub drapes down and extends across about half of the floor space, which makes it very difficult to stand without constantly bumping into it or hitting the wall. This setup feels cramped and unhygienic. Additionally, the shower head is not functional: the lower part sprays like a jet while the rest only drips down, this made it very hard to shower properly. The host is responsive, which was good. They also mentioned that this home is under construction, which is not listed anywhere in the listing. I was hoping for a higher level of quality and functionality based on the images and price.
Very aesthetic apartment. Walkable to Zurich lake and Coop. Highly recommended.

We booked the place as our flight got cancelled  On staying for a night we thought we should have booked other days in Zurich as well at this place  This is economical and central Place easily accessible by public’s transport

Unfortunately Duygu wasn't there when we arrived in Zurich. Her nanny welcomed us and she gave us the key of our room and another one to go inside Duygu's apartment (which is near the room) and use the toilet. We always found the door locked except the last day, because she finally gave us the right key. In the room we had a kind of toilet that maybe was a chair or a tease, made with plastic bags. We spent our holiday searching for a toilet in the city and it was really nasty. We also found only one pillow and we were two; we tried to ask for another one, but we slept both nights with it.  Inadvisable.  If we had a key it would be more confortable.
Oh.... it was the worst in my life.. :(
Had a great stay, easy check in, very clean apartment, spacious and felt like home. Looking forward to staying next time !

We had an amazing stay here! Gi was always available when we needed her and we felt right at home in her apartment. It is a block away from the Zurich Binz stop, so we traveled into the center of the city very quickly.

I hate to break it but that was the worst experience I’ve ever had. It started with check-in - attached image with instructions was blurred and hard to read. When I asked some questions I got short rude response - “read the text”. Next thing is ambiguity of house rules. It’s only  said no smoking and no partying. We had a dinner at the kitchen and then one beer at the balcony.  Next day I’m getting a message that Sabine’s roommate isn’t ok with our behavior and want us to leave and I should respond immediately.  She said kitchen wasn’t clean although we cleaned everything, she said we were loud and partying - we talked with normal voice and went asleep at 22:20, is one beer at the balcony considered to be a party? and especially rude was this line ‘it’s rude to smash the doors in our culture’ - like it is ok in my culture. We accidentally smashed the door 3-4 times due to the draught and then adjusted to it. I couldn’t wait to leave this apartment
the place was just as described and close to transportation!

good:  reasonably priced, good location.  bad: have booked with many Superhosts in the past, level of service=superior.  This was complete opposite. Superhosts go the extra mile, through their communications, personal touches, amenities. There was nothing super about this host.  While it was stated there was no shampoo or body wash, it was not stated there was no facial tissue.    We had exactly 2 sets of towels for 2 days, While there was a washer and dryer, ( no detergent) the water was not turned on to the washer (we climbed around the back and figured it out), then the dryer simply would not dry the towels we had in for 4 hours on all different settings and they would not dry, instructions would have been great. I think its obvious when someone has 44 listings they are incapable of going the extra mile: 2 bottles of water, tissue, more towels & replying to a courtesy message about several issues would have changed all of this.  Pure business here, no love for guests!
It was a great place for my family of 4! Lots of space and great amenities and recommendations! 10/10 experience!
It was worth staying here and was very convenient and the location was good .

Me and my family are happy with the stay.  We are from Asian country and not used to the house/room without a fan or air-condition. Hence, we have contacted AAS Apartment to request for a fan, and they are so friendly and provided us with the fan next day. Also help to resolve our issues and concerns immediately. Thanks team.

I had a wonderful stay at Stefani and Alexander's Airbnb. The place was spotless, well-located, and made traveling to and from various attractions super easy. They were incredibly responsive and attentive. I Highly recommend for a clean, convenient, and comfortable stay!

We had a lovely stay at Sophie’s place! Her studio is cute and cozy; it has everything you may need in terms of bath and kitchen supplies.  The flat is located in a quiet area, however also very close to the town centre, so very walkable.  We would definitely recommend this place! :)
Great location for exploring Zurich and surrounding area. Just a short walk to the train station was perfect! Apartment was clean and comfortable for my family of four adults.

We had a great stay at Erich’s apartment.  It is as pictured and described; I believe Erich stays there during the week for work and lives elsewhere on the weekends, so it’s very well-equipped and has everything you might need.  Good location that is a bit quieter than the city center but an easy train ride away (we were able to walk to downtown in 30 mins).  Erich was very responsive and so helpful in giving us a mini-orientation upon arrival.  Thanks for a lovely stay!

Terrible Experience!!!! - The day before we were due to arrive I received an email from the large rental company  *HIT Rental AG "informing" me that we would not have exclusive use of the apartment and that other people would be entering the apartment that myself and young  children were staying in during our stay. There was no apology or optionality offered whatsoever. When I contacted airbnb they advised that this was in breach or their policies and that I could ask the host to cancel the reservation, losing our entire holiday flights, bookings, ZUrich cards, etc with no time to arrange alternative accomodation. This ruined our stay before we had even arrived and was extremely stressful for me as I was planning to do some work from the appartment but their message meant I would be in breach of my companies remote working and data security policies. The apartment was for us very, very expensive at around £700 for just three days stay, so this was totally unacceptable.  As for the apartment itself, it was dissapointing despite looking great on the photos - mostly clean apart from some rather grubby walls and ceilings, but the main issues were that it is a studio that has had an extra floor crammed in the roof and as others have mentioned the photos are deceptive - the roof is really really low, not for adults or kids over a few years old. The pictures showed a view of the river, but you would have to be craning your neck out the window to get a glimpse of this in reality. The location is pretty good, but even a normal conversation on the streets below with bars etc can be well heard in the flat so we were kept awake late at night so not really suitable for kids or anyone that wants a good nights sleep to then enjoy the city rested. To make matters worse, many of the windows have no curtains at all, whilst others have translucent thin blinds which block no lights, so the moment the suns up the apartment is bright...not what you need after been kept up late from the noise below on the narrow streets echoing up to the apartment.  The company that rents this property obviously has many many apartments across Switzerland and only really cares about profit over looking after guests (I didn't realize this when booking, thinking I was renting from "Stephanie" that would look after her apartment and guests).  Other points to note are that the TV is pointless unless you want to watch terrestrial German channels - Its not a smart TV so you can't even log into your subscription services such as disney, netflix etc. Also, we connected to the internet but it struggled to even load a basic page - I would rather there were no beds than no internet so this was an issue. You will struggle getting up the stairs with anything more than a rucksack by the way, and its on the top floor. Given the very expensive price of this converted studio apartment, my advice to others would be that the tram links are so good and cheap in Zurich that staying just a few stops further from this apartment is significantly better value, not to mention quieter, larger etc....and no need to wear a helmet in areas (i.e. low, low ceiling)! As mentioned, not sure why *HIT Rental AG thought it was okay to breach airbnb policies at very short notice without so much as an apology but this really ruined our experience before we had even arrived in Zurich. The company is called "HIT Rental AG" I add the * to denote that I think they should proberbly consider adding a certain letter to the start of their name to reflect their customer service.

Flat is in the red light district. And not for families. Lacking sanitary amenities.  Every room had some garbage in it.  The dishes were dirty not ran in the dishwasher.  Laundry was still running.  No soap in any of the bathrooms or kitchen sink. In general they did not prep the little things.   A covid mask under the bed.  Not well cleaned.  The first part. Yes no I asked that little teeny weenie pill. Overall not horrible but not our favorite place.

The apartment had a terrible smoking smell. You just can't get rid of it. You can't sleep properly, it was just a terrible experience. Besides, the building is not well isolated, so you pretty much listen everything.
The host helped us a lot in checking In and out. The room was spacious for two persons.

Everything was ok, until the hot water stopped working and it took them 24 hours to resolve. Then there was only hot water, so still could not shower or bath ourselves or our baby.  When we checked out the elevator was not working. Had to carry our baby, pram and suitcases down. I did request compensation and  they  offered me a voucher for my next stay! Unclear how many Airbnbs have repeated customers, and find their offer was not acceptable.

Not great for a family as there are stairs to access the elevator and it is tiny so we had to always remove the wheels of our pram (uppababy vista) and tilt it inside in order to be fit it in (just barely). We were given no flexibility on check-out even though we only needed 1h. The living room smells like smoke. It clearly states that it is a no-smoking apartment in the check in instructions, however, someone must have disrespected it in the past and the smell is still present. We asked for a baby cot which was confirmed and when we arrived, it wasn't there so we had to call and they were very responsive and came back to us within a few hours with a  cot. Unfortunately, they did not have a mattress and despite telling us it would be brought to the apartment the next day, it did not happen. There were a few things left under the couch (popcorn and paper tissue and dust) but otherwise the apartment was clean.

We were in Zurich for the street parade and booked Elisabet's airbnb. From the start, the hole communication was very friendly. The subsequent check-in was uncomplicated, independent of a specific time and easy. the apartment was clean. Thank you again for the little gifts. we would book Elisabeth's airbnb again at any time.

Slow response, not as listed on airbnb, no tea or coffee bags, no dish washing liquid/shower,very limited shower amenities, internet is not the great(poor connection) and rubbish bin was not cleaned .Poor response to complaint.Not coming back again.

We booked one of the apartments in the building last minute and appreciated the communication with Arno & Daniella, their willingness to accommodate our requests (like a late check-out), the cleanliness, decoration and location of our apartment, and its terrace. We'll be happy to return for future trips to Zurich.

A good, simple choice for a few days as there are convenient trams which is a plus! It is a nice location✅but there were a few issues -The instruction to get into the building was not clear. As a person who has travelled to multiple countries I never came across the entrance key being the same key as the apartment. Although convenient, it seems unsafe. Since it wasn’t stated we were confused & stuck for a bit. We got in thanks to the neighbours since Dimi didn’t respond quickly -The bathroom sink was clogged so we couldn’t use it, also there is a strange yellow stain on the door  -There is no window net so a lot of insects got in when we’d open it -The most questionable part is he asked us for five stars and to only criticise him privately instead of publicly in order to not impact his visibility. The whole point of the rating system is fairness & transparency. Seemed manipulative and I didn’t like that. For a bland and imperfect place it’s too prideful  Nevetherless 3/5 ⭐️it was fin
Good place but lift is not there for heavy lugguage
Noisy, not clean, not recommended for families as the apartment view is to a brothel.

Sarah’s place was amazing and we felt right at home. The unit was very close to the train station (2min walk) and there were a couple of supermarkets, cafes and other shop close by. The neighbourhood itself was very quiet and had plenty of options to explore like to take a hike in nature. Otherwise it took only 10min to downtown Zurich which was great.  The place itself was really cozy and modern. The interior design was impeccable. It had all the needed amenities to make it a great stay and relax away from the bustle of the city.  Sarah also was a great host, the whole process was super easy, communication without any issues and she was very helpful in answering any of our questions regarding our stay. We would definitely recommend this place for anyone looking for a place close to downtown while still staying in a quiet neighbourhood to shutdown. We would definitely come back if possible.
Practical apartment for a flexible long term stay. The location is great, cute neighbourhood, restaurants, cafes, grocery shopping all within 2 min walking distance. 7min walk down to the river.

Not as clean as the photos depicted, the walls need to be cleaned and there is a clutter of furniture not shown in the photos. I’ve stayed in many other airbnbs in the same neighborhood and of similar price this somehow did not match the caliber.

We as a family of four, rented this unit for 10 days and it was a wonderful stay. The unit was  spacious, clean and comfortable. Easy accessbility by public transport as it near to train station. Parking space also available for drivers upon request. The host, Miss Simone are very helpful and easy to reach by phone when needed. In general, it is worthy for every pennies we spend. Thanks for Miss. Simone to make our vacation as a memorable one. Thank you.

This apartment is in a great location and the host is fantastic when it comes to communication but we were slightly disappointed because we found the photos to be slightly deceiving. In the photos and the description it says there is a pull out sofa chair and when we arrived it was not present. It wasn’t that bad of a set back but just important to keep in mind before booking!
Peter is very kindful.The place is a woundful house.It has a big garden.Everything is fine.The tram station is nearby.Peter provides a lot of tea.My husband and I have an unforgetable memory.

Check in process was extremely smooth, walkable to old town and had a great view of the park across the street where the balcony overlooked. Shower was very small, but the vanity with double sinks was nice for a group of people.

**Disappointing stay—greatly contradicts previous positive reviews.** > While the room looks nice at a first glance, cleanliness was a major issue. It was dusty and dirty in many overlooked areas; for instance, the lamps were covered in a thick layer of dust as if they hadn’t been wiped down in years. > The bed was highly uncomfortable and unsanitary. The mattress is very old, mushy, and completely worn out. Worse, both the mattress and the mattress protector were covered in disgusting, highly visible stains. It looked so unwashed and unhygienic that we couldn't even sleep the first night until we took off the sheets and mattress protector to wash them ourselves. > Check-in was also a frustrating and stressful experience. As a tourist, it is difficult to predict an exact arrival time due to travel variables, but the host rigidly

We had a couple issues with our stay:  The apartment itself was quite loud. We could hear the neighbors through the walls listening to music, speaking, and walking about all throughout the day. I am not sure why so many people have said it was quiet for them because it was not during our 3 nights. I know the hosts can’t control that but it could bother others who are looking for quietness.  In addition, the shower head did not stay straight and turned toward the wall. We could not adjust it forward with many attempts. The hot water ran out quickly when trying to use the tub as well.  Lastly, keep in mind that extra towels cost extra when though you’re only given one for a long stay.

The studio is very very small, is not enougth space for more that 2 persons. I thing is just for 1 person. Andreas, don't say us nothing and we was very very unconfortable all the time. You are in the studio like if you are living in a train station. The noise is infernal an the trains are all time pasing by until 1:00am. You can close the windows but anyway you hear the trains. I would not recommend the studio to anyone.

The place is full of the host's items - clothes, accessories, candles, etc. Leaving very little space for us to keep our belongings. No proper sleeping pillow was provided. The refrigerator is filled with expired food, especially fruits and vegetables, which are left uncovered - unhygienic. Not worth the money; even a dormitory would be better at this price.

Great location. Clean apartment. Smaller than it shows on the pictures. We were staying there with my one year old baby. The elevator was way too small to fit the stroller in which was quite an issue. Tania wasn't very helpful with neither earlier check-in nor later check-out. She said the next guests are coming so we need to leave at 10am. Two days later we get a message , where Tania starts accusing us of damaging her wooden floor. As I was trying to explain to Tania that we did certainly not cause any damage during our stay, I've got quite few impolite answers to my messages, full of blame. As it turns out, that damage has been there since the floor was installed, she just wasn't aware of it.( Wich I find very strange to understand). So I would suggest to Tania to maybe check her apartment once in a while herself instead of only counting on her cleaning team.

Good place but very poor communication. We were promised a washing and dryer badge along with the accomodation but on requesting the badge were told that because the previous tenant didn’t return it, we couldn’t have it. On showing dissatisfaction, Tania offered a $100cfh refund which is not close enough to the time and money we spent on doing washing elsewhere. Very dissatisfied as travelling with two kids, we did washing almost regularly and spent a lot of money which we shouldn’t have. Not recommended if travelling with kids.

This is a decent location and the apartment is ok. It could definitely benefit from a refresh though. Furniture is stained, pictures on the wall crooked, none of the major appliances can actually be plugged in because all the adapter seem to have gone missing, and the host is not very responsive (took 2 days to respond to a simple “where is the ironing board” question. If you plan to work from here, the internet is unstable and cuts in and out.

Okay apartment by a well-connected tram/bus station (which also means noisy) with an unresponsive host! :) For example, the tap in the washroom doesn’t work or the coffee machine plug isn’t compatible with the wall socket but the host didn’t respond to my messages about those matters.

A comfortable apartment with very easy access to shops and quick connections into the city centre. Also a good base for hiking out to the hills overlooking Zurich and the lake. Cooking equipment is quite minimal (fine if you plan to eat out for your stay) but Antonio and Anna responded very promptly and positively to our request for a few more things. We'd definitely stay there again if we visited Zurich.

We had a great time at Rozalina's place. Her apartment is very spacious and centrally located. It was close to the lake, the tram, many nice restaurants and grocery stores. Rozalina was very responsive. Check-in and check-out was very easy. Highly recommended.

Sonya's place is very clean, It is nicely appointed, and has everything you need. As indicated, it is very small, and no more than two people should stay. It can also be quite loud.  If you would like to use the parking you will need to tell them in advance; a detail that was lost to us. this will cost you an extra 15 euros.  However, we were able to get it sorted out.  One of the things that was very apparent to me is that Sonia didn't seem to want us to stay in the apartment. We were reminded when to "leave", twice.  When she sent these messages,  the time to leave was highlighted and underlined. We certainly did not feel very welcome.  The apartment can also be quite warm. It's hard to shut off the heat.  taking care of the trash is a very complicated system. The language barrier didn't make it any easier. It was very hard for us to understand. I was afraid to ask Sonia what to do with it since when we asked about the parking situation we got chewed out. You see we hadn't asked before we booked. But again we didn't understand we needed to.  All in all we just felt as though we were constantly in trouble. It didn't feel relaxing, we just felt like we were homeless street people begging for a room.
Everything as described. The gym is great but unfortunately closes at 10pm. Everything as described.
This place is in a prime location in middle of old town Zurich. Walk everywhere. Could not be happier.

I had the most perfect stay at Fabian’s place and was surprised at how it was even better in real life than the photos. His space was completely clean, organized, well lit and well decorated. The kitchen had everything to cook actual meals and feel right at home. The bed was also very comfortable and overall I felt the intention in the space was conducive to feeling home away from home. Fabian was very responsive and communicative. He let me extend my stay last minute with ease. Also checking in and finding the space was super easy with his instructions. 10/10 recommend

The location of the flat is good, very close to the bus station. The landlord is very friendly and patiently to answer our questions. The flat is fully equipped. I think the real flat is better than the picture. If necessary, I'll book this flat again.

I am sure you are probably confused with the mixed reviews for this listing, I will add my piece to it. If your accommodation options are limited by your wallet, then manage your expectations. This place have multiple similar looking units as it is technically operating as a hotel using the 24h store on ground floor as it's lobby. This place doesn't have an elevator so if you have bulky heavy luggage that you are incapable of lifting up four floors up yourself, then you might want to reconsider booking this place. Kettle in the unit (#41) I was checked into was too dirty to use, other quality of life improvements that can be easily implemented but aren't are to provide hooks in the toilet and dishwashing equipment. There is, however complimentary coffee available from the machine in the 24h store. Recommended for specific target groups, otherwise pinch your wallet and look elsewhere to avoid gap in expectations just to leave a bad review thereafter.
I will stay with EMA again whenever I visit Zurich in the future!

Pietros place is really beautiful, clean, bright and placed in a very quiet neighborhood. Is far from the city center but with very easy access. Is just 25min on the tram and a bus stop  just outside. We really loved our stay and wish we could have spent more time there to know him and his fury friends a little bit more :) thanks for all the amenities and details Pietro!
Whole booking process went perfect with Lukasz and the apartment was clean
Thank you for everything and all the amenities! Will recommend!!

The room is very close to supermarkets and a very few minutes from the train station. In addition to that it is provided a convenient desk and a Wi-Fi connection suitable to remote working if necessary. The host is really quick into answering questions you may have
In the type of weather (summer) to have Fan or A/C is recommended to have in the rooms . As it was very hard to sleep as there was no wind also.
Really nice apartment - well decorated and appointed. The location is good for getting quickly into Central Zurich.

Negativ: Unfortunately, we had an issue as we had no warm/hot water in the apartment. We approached the host and he did not react for 12 hours. Also, the of 14 amenities listed four were missing ( essentials such as soap, shower gel, shampoo, toaster in kitchen). Also the pictures of the apartment did not match with reality. Especially the sofa was completely run down. Positiv: cleanliness of the apartment

Avoid at all costs. This host changed the check-in time between our booking and arrival.  When we arrived at the time on our reservation and his attached instructions we were told we were incorrect.  After sending screenshots and pointing out at least one other review noting the same issue he just said it had been changed “awhile ago” and made no effort to rectify the situation. Airbnb tried to mediate, and he completely ignored them.  Airbnb offered us a full refund,  butat nearly 10pm after he had ignored them all day. As our 4 year old was asleep we took 50% off to stay instead The host described the unit as having “no stairs” when multiple extremely steep flights must be climbed.  This is mentioned frequently in other reviews. Host listed AC. There was one portable unit that was not fully assembled or vented. After assembling/venting ourselves it worked for one room. Shower “stocked” with empty shampoo bottles with no caps. Kitchen dirty, visible hair and food in rugs.

Unfortunately, the apartment wasn’t reddy at check in time, as it was still being cleaned. I was told it would take another 1-2 hours. They found us another unit in the building on the ground floor, so I appreciate that, but we lost time as a result and made the afternoon stressful as we had plans in the evening and things were pushed back. I can’t speak to how this unit was as we had a different one. But the unit looked ok. The ground floor one was very noisy, even with the windows closed. Location was good.
Spotless place, very cozy with everything you need. Very close to the tram stop. And about 2 stops away from the main part of city.
