The space was decent but did not match the photos at all. There was no view of the lake or anything. It would of been a perfect stay if it matched the pictures but because it didn’t I feel cheated

This apartment, while small, met my needs well during my month long stay in Zürich.  Hosts Anna & Karina quickly responded to a few needs I had, even on weekends.  This was particularly impressive considering that the company that manages this apartment (HitRental) actually manages several properties and likely has many requests to attend to daily.  The apartment was very clean when I arrived, has a kitchen with most every tool you would need for cooking, excellent wifi, and free laundry facilities.  The bed was simple, but comfortable.  One of the best things about the apartment is that it is really close to some great public transportation options being within easy walking distance from multiple tram and bus stops, as well as the Zürich Oerlikon train station.  It is also really close to several grocery stores and some really good restaurants, bakeries, etc.  Finally, there is an amazing open-air market on Saturday mornings (I think Wednesday as well) where you can buy some wonder fruit and veggies not available in stores.  Overall this apartment was a great deal for what I paid, and I would have no issues with renting this apartment again. There are a few things to be prepared for when you rent this apartment.  The pantry is bare so you will need to purchase everything you need for cooking.  This includes things like salt, pepper, napkins/paper towels, etc.  The bed in the room is a double bed rather than a queen bed as listed in the description.  For a single individual in the apartment this is fine, but for a couple it is pretty small.  You get one set of towels per person and one set of bedding so be prepared to wash these things if you are staying longer than a week.  Laundry facilities are free (although you need to supply the soap) so you just need to make the time.  The apartment has only a single window and no air conditioning so if you rent it during the warm part of the year (as I did) you need to get creative to provide ventilation and cooling (e.g. opening the front door a bit to promote airflow via the cool hallways).  We bought an inexpensive fan which really helped (we left the fan so perhaps it will still be there for the next guests).  Finally, if you staying for an extended period consider inquiring about what it would cost for having someone to come in and clean the apartment once a week, or about getting access to cleaning supplies as there are none in the apartment.  I wanted a broom to sweep the floor and they supplied it to me quickly so just ask.

Very good location to stay in Zurich. Only issue was that  the unit was not ready when we arrived at 6:30 pm despite the advise of our estimated time of arrival. Had to return after 2 hours to have it cleaned. Chris was apologetic for the misunderstanding and said he would refund the cleaning fee. All in all a great place to stay.

The spot is nice, 15-30 meters from the lake. Nice view of the lake from the living room and from the top room. There is an access corridor to the lake and local simple restaurant and camping. Ysabel informed me by watsapp that she’ll go to travel one Day before at 6AM. She didn't welcome me and give no recommendations about the house that have 4 flours.  I had problems with the reinforced door because no handle outside for opening, no instructions, this happened 3 minutes after arriving. After 4 hours of car driving I get stocked outside without a jacket, no money, no food and water from 15h30 for like 2 hours, but then very nice neighbor had pity and invited me to wait inside his house. I get inside Ysabel house at almost 23h00. I eat at midnight and took my medicine (only one apple at 1PM in order to take my medicine).  And in the next days she harassed me for the bill of 1'200CHF for the locksmith, one of the messages was sent at 1 AM. There is no insurance AIRBNB for this and mines don't cover such accidents. AIRBNB mediates this now. Ysabel called me money lover and very bad person. She have a latino character, she's quickly excited and unpleasant.  Along with this She left the house dusty, thankfully my room was clean. I had only one towel for my body, no towel for hands. No instructions for Jacuzzi so I didn't know how to use it and I didn't use it as I was afraid to broke it.  Around and inside the house there are too much cumulated objects that create oppressed atmosphere. My breakfast was poor: defrosted brioche, butter, jam and tea (didn't eat the cheese as it gave me no appetite). The mattress is bad quality, I had back pain next day. I had the worst weekend ever!!! If you decide to go in spite my message be aware you should keep the key in your hand and don't let the key on the door as there is no options of opening from outside and the locksmith is very expensive in Zurich.
Very close to everything. Also very noisy on street. Impossible to sleep with noise. Not a location for families or children.

The unit is on the third floor and no lift. No washing machine or dryer. Wi-fi access needs to be explained better as it uses a dongle that is not obvious to most people. No response regarding issues after we accessed the property and tried to contact owner. Response was after we left the property.

Early luggage drop-off was appreciated, but the stay had serious cleanliness and amenity issues. At check-in there was no shampoo or shower gel, and most towels smelled strongly of cigarette smoke (only 1 out of 4 was usable). We had to buy toiletries and wash all towels ourselves. Airbnb apps proposed a cleaning fee refund, which the host initially refused and delayed. Only after 2 days and escalation to 2 agents did the host process the refund directly. Communication existed, but problem-solving was poor and created more hassle instead of solutions. Basic amenities and cleanliness should not be optional at this price point. He was kind to provide pasta and sauce, but I would rather have drinkable coffee pods in sufficient quantity. Two undrinkable pods for four guests over two nights is not adequate. Overall, Matthias  cleanliness, basic amenities, and problem resolution were below expectations I would not recommend this place unless these issues are fully resolved.

It was my worst stay. She claimed that we damaged her sink which we didn’t do. Then she asked us to cover this expense or leave. She wanted to throw me, my wife and 1 year old son to street for a damage obviously there before us. Absolutely ruined our stay… A couple of hours later, she said we can continue to stay if we’d like. We couldn’t change accommodation because of the high prices. We continued to stay there 2 days but we were on edge in case she would accuse us with anything else. I definetly would not recommend it.

We had a great stay in this lovely apartment. It was exactly as described and with lots of helpful extras around the apartment - including some things we had forgotten ourselves!  The beds were comfortable, plenty of towels for everyone and even some little chocolates which the kids loved!  Great area, very quiet but also accessible and right next to a tram stop which we used to get to and from the centre.

Great apartment right in downtown Zurich: 15 min walk from the HB, and an easy pleasant walk to all the highlights in downtown. The street is very quiet but is super close to major shopping and restaurants, restaurant at Hotel Bourbon is highly recommended. Great contemporary food! The apartment has an alcove with the best and a bedroom. Both beds are queen size. The sofa bed in the living room can sleep another 2 people. Terrace has an amazing view of the city. Dimi was very responsive and easy to deal with. Getting to the airport (family of 4) coat us 40 CHF. Surprisingly cheap.

The apartment has a perfect location (10-15 minute walk from main train station) and is very well-equipped (washing machine & dryer, dishwasher, microwave, full kitchen, etc.). Thierry was extremely responsive and the self checkin process is entirely smooth. Some of the furniture and bed clothes are quite tired-looking and stained, which was a bit unpleasant.  We did experience a problem with noise late at night. The worst was a Friday night rooftop party just across the courtyard that was broken up by police at 1 AM. Thierry was kind enough to give us a partial refund on this account. Two local bars on the ground floor were audible most nights when the windows were open (closing them was not an option in hot weather because the air conditioners require an open window to work). Wednesday was karaoke night...

The apartment we stayed in was not the apartment shown in the listing. It was about half the size with no living room space. If the same amount is being charged for the pictured apartment and the one we stayed in then I feel I was scammed and mislead. Had the pics of the apartment we stayed in have been shown in the listing I wouldn’t have booked.
It is very large well decorated apartment.  The tram is right out of the bedroom windows so not good for light sleepers.   Pack your own shampoo and shower gel.
The apartment is the most top notch Airbnb experience I’ve ever had. Everything is A+ and goes above and beyond.
Jörg was soo nice and the apartment was perfect! Already planning our next visit to Switzerland and will stay at the same place :)
Location was convenient to tram stop and 2 grocery stores.  Having access to a washer and dryer on the 1st floor was very helpful.

I booked a premiere room but they checked me into another normal one, which was different from it in the picture I saw on website. After two-days constantly arguing did they change my room. The staff of reception had a really bad attitude towards me who even refused my food delivery without notifying me. I had a very bad experience there and move out one week earlier. And they refused to give me a refund.

The house is tight but clean. It’s not a very big place but it’s fine, there’s no proper table for dinning in the house. Another problem is that the washing machine in the floor cannot work. I had to wash the clothes by myself for nearly three weeks. And no one came to fix this problem. This was really a horrible experience. Considered the price, I will not say that I am satisfied with this house.

Couldn't access the main building door despite downloading the Nuki app & following host's instructions. Code for the main door was invalid. Contacted host in Airbnb app & the 'emergency number' given (... 8888) but no response despite informing the host in advance of our check in time. Contacted Airbnb support. Found another number, one Billy - who claimed to be one of the hosts - answered. Billy admitted he was in Asia! After almost two hours struggling to get in, a tenant of the building let us in. We went to the apartment & found out the app only worked for the apartment door & not the building door. Informed Billy. Then only Billy informed us there's actually a physical key to the main door in case the app didn't work. By that time we were already heading to a hotel. Nobody in their right mind wants to stay in an apartment where they can't access the building. Request for refund has been met by total silence from the host despite giving all evidence.

Me and Daniela were on good terms on the first month or so. But as I got busy I needed space. she had expressed discomfort. I didn’t mind. I was shocked when she applied through Airbnb for me to move out prior to due date. I tried my best to find another accommodation asap. Upon moving out there was a confrontation, it was strange. It’s just too much for a relationship in between a host and a guest. I get a sense she’s addressed too much importance to the whole thing.  Some practical issues: 1: the strange behaviour the cat has around the food. The cat is anxious, always trying to get into the room when I eat/cook, making noise. This was not mentioned in our chat before the stay.  2. The noise in the building, crying baby.  3.the window of the room cannot be fully shield, hence the lack of privacy.  4. She’s gone into my room without asking at least once, took  pictures of me without consent, had me on a live chat with the next potential guest without consent. So, boundary issues!

great location, easy walk to train station, close to tram line.  furnishings, available materials, appliances are complete.  good setup with washer and drier. wish the listing gave the street address and not just the postal code.
Great experience. Very responsive and attentive host. Recommend it.

Here is my honest review. The arrival instructions were clear, although they appear to be a standard copy-and-paste message sent to all guests. Parking was surprisingly difficult and expensive, with very limited options besides blue-zone street parking or the Park Plaza garage. The biggest issue was the apartment itself. There was a strong and persistent marijuana smell coming from neighboring units throughout the day and night. Upon arrival, the apartment was not properly cleaned. The sofa had visible stains and a foul odor, and it took a long time for the management team to address the issue. We also arrived to find no hand towels, no soap, no shampoo, and virtually none of the basic amenities typically expected in an Airbnb. The management team enforces a long list of guest rules, yet the property felt very basic and not particularly family-friendly. Overall, we expected the cleanliness, organization, and hospitality Switzerland is known for, but unfortunately this property didn’t

Unfortunately, I was unable to stay due to an unexpected family emergency. As soon as I realised I would not be able to travel, I contacted the property through Airbnb to explain the situation and ask whether any alternative solution could be considered. I fully understand that my request was made one hour after the scheduled check-in time and that changing the reservation may not have been possible. However, what disappointed me was the complete lack of response. I was not asking for special treatment, only hoping for a reply and some guidance on whether any option might be available. What left me with a negative impression was not  the financial loss, but the feeling of being completely ignored. Even a brief response acknowledging my message and explaining that nothing could be done would have been appreciated. I sent a follow up message that remained without any response.

Location was good, place was clean and had the listed amenities. The windows didn't have a proper shade covering it, so it let all the light in. There were only two fixed lights that worked which were in the bathroom and a lot of the lamps provided didn't work. The bedroom was internal with no windows and no fresh air which made it difficult to sleep even with the fan provided. There was also no door to the bedroom so the light from the windows came through due to the lack of a proper shade.

We loved the apartment and the views and were able to make ourselves right at home. Ilan was very responsive to messages and eager to help when we needed information (eg how to get a parking pass, or where to print documents) and very understanding when we thought we might have to stay longer. We would definitely stay there again. Thanks Ilan 😊

Disappointed over this place: First of all, the map on AirBnb shows a totally different location. I can see other guests already wrote about this. Chris place is much further away from downtown Zürich and next to a highway and trainstation with lots of traficnoise and gasolinesmell if you open the balconydoor. And you have to look through all that to find the lakeview. Also, the appartmentbuilding in general, the furniture and equipment has poor quality. The bed is very soft and the madras cheap, The bathroomsink drains slowly, A very noisy ventilator in the kitchen was turned on and off during the day, there were no tea towles availbale to dry the dishes, all in all: not acceptable and not value for money.
Everything was like the description and the poctures. Communication was also very proactive and good. Thank you!

The place is located in the city center, next to a tram stop, and just a 5-minute walk from Zurich HB. However, there is no elevator, and the staircase is small, so it may take some time to go up at the first time. At night, there might be some noise and cigarette smoke from the bar on the first floor, especially on Fridays and Saturdays. The laundry facilities are located in the attic and can be booked using the sheet provided in the laundry room. Overall, Roger is very supportive, provides cleaning services every two weeks, and promptly fixes anything that breaks.
Did not meet expectations with amenities 3rd bed - Sofa bed is not worth the money paid for the room.

nice and clean place, not so much things to complain but it's not a private apartment, it's rental apartment company, I thought that Airbnb was not Booking. I think that it should be clarified in the description.
Very nice apartment! No reserved parking place if arriving by car but there is street parking.
everything ok, but there is no free parking..

The apartment was super beautiful, with really great interior design and amazing use of space - we were especially impressed with the compact but efficient kitchen, which pleased my tall partner as the work surfaces are at a more ergonomic height for taller people, while being fine for me, a short person! Lots of lovely thoughtful touches, and great communications at every point along the way, including some detective work to figure out where I could get milk on a Sunday!  We only stayed overnight, but it was such a nice stay we wished we had longer there. The tv is massive and great, with Netflix and similar. Bed is very comfy, and for me - someone who habitually sleeps with earplugs because I’m an incredibly light sleeper- I actually woke fewer times in the night than usual! So the tram noise is not at all intrusive if you use the earplugs that are provided! And the rest of the time it’s kind of atmospheric!  Overall, great stay! Thank you! We hope we can return some time!

From the first day we arrived, there were issues with the water pressure of the toilet. It was so weak not even a few pieces of toilet paper could be flushed down, and it required quite a bit of strength and finesse to press the button as well, needing a few specifically timed and strong pushes to achieve a small stream of water. We had to spend long hours outside in order to avoid the problem of not being able to flush, and while communication on the problem was efficient, it did not solve anything as the state of the toilet remained the same for the entirety of our stay, and I hope that the issue can be fixed before someone else stays with them. However, if being able to go to the toilet is not your biggest concern, the location was wonderful, very walkable from the apartment to the tram station.
If you want to find an affordable walkable apartment that also happens to be in the best food and hip area in Zurich this is your spot

This apartment is next to the open air bar so it will get noisy, especially on weekends because the bar doesn't close until 4am. Additionally, because the main entrance is next to the bar, people would puke by the main entrance. There was also human poop by the main entrance the day I checked in. The apartment is also currently undergoing construction which the host mentioned. During our stay, the people that lived below us were partying, so you could hear them. I notified the host about it.

It was just as described. There is no AC so we asked ahead of time for additional fan and one was provided so we had two running and it felt decent at night. Just know that there are clubs very close so if you leave the windows open you might hear it although we sleep with sound machines and we could sleep fine.
Nice place really good location. Could be a little bit cleaner
Great stay! Everything we needed! Awesome for young people
I book for three night they charge me a lot of money for one day

Despite contacting the host 13 hours before our planned 6-7 hours long drive to Zurich, the host did not respond to my request to make the apartment key available upon our arrival 2-4pm. Instead, the key had to be collected before noon on the arrival day, which happened to be the Easter Sunday. I canceled the reservation, as there was no assurance or confirmation to receive the key on arrival. I was also not keen to start our journey at 4-5am to arrive before noon. The host refused to refund any cancelation fees referring to the cancelation policy. I had to involve the Resolution Center. This is totally unacceptable and unprofessional not to make the apartment key available to the guest upon their arrival because of holidays or other personal reasons.

Spend with kids a few days back home in Zurich. Appartement is very well located and close to all hot spots. We discovered a broken window and have reported this accordingly. Host has imposed us to stay at home at certain day and time for fixing rather having checked with us beforehand if the proposed day/time would fit also our agenda. Endlessly ping-pong emails didn’t helped further to find a common agreement too and ultimately we had no other choice to accommodate the date/time. Maybe bad luck this time as we never came across such Airbnb experience over the past years. Communication is key!
Great place - very central, clean, spacious. Highly recommendable. Host very responsive.

We stayed at the apartment for a week. Arriving on the 25th of December, the flat had hardly been cleaned, so we needed to do that ourselves on Christmas. While I imagine this must have been a one-time thing, it was nevertheless not much appreciated. Thierry could not find anyone to clean it in the spontaneously but we found an arrangement afterwards to make up for the unhappy circumstances. The apartment itself is quite recent and the view is nice. It is in a calm neighbor but we’ll connected to the city centre nevertheless. However, it did not seem that well maintained. The water boiler could not be used as someone seemed to have burnt milk in there at some point. The dishwasher was missing the door to be well integrated into the kitchen which itself would just be a minor issue but the actual door then was too light and always jumped back up while putting the dishes in. The bathtub’s drain was congested. This had apparently happened recently before our arrival. While it may have happened just before, no one seemed to bother to fix that for us during 7-day trip. It was not ideal to have all the hair coming up again while taking a shower or bathing pour kids.
This place was situated near very convenient public transport as well as great supermarkets. The neighborhood is nice and calm. Check in and out was super easy!

We were a bit disappointed walking into this place, there was no space for us to unpack our belongings, the kitchen was very small with not enough fridge space for our things. The owners things were everywhere so it was a bit uncomfortable for a 3 day stay. It wasn't all that clean. Communication was great. Location was around 5 min walk to tram stop then a 10 or so min ride into centre.

Tania is very prompt in responding to any query. She gave a phone number where you could call if required. However, she doesn't like communicating through whats app which is easiest, fastest and simplest way of communication in any emergency.

A very nice and clean apartment. Nice view and good location, however the connection to the city is not 24 hours a day. The apartment is very nice and ample, and has all you need. Only the cleaning service channeled through Blueground was not reliable - they cancelled twice and when they finally came, they did not do a great job. But all in all it was a great place to live and Blueground was a great owner.
The host was extremely responsive and friendly. They took personal care and were interested in my experience throughout the stay.

Lovely apartment but there were problems. The owner is attempting to charge for a cane chair which was damaged before we took occupancy. The charge is for more than a full set of new chairs. I will continue to refuse to pay for this damage.

as we entered the apartment, we found many cockroaches. the rooms didn't look like the photos. part of the kitchen didn't have tiles and it wasn't reported on the ad. we also didn't succeed to cook because the stove was broken. bad experience

Christine is an amazing host! Thoughtful and flexible with times. She responded immediately to any inquiry and recommended a very sweet sightseeing place nearby. I would stay at her place again. The house is very clean. However one thing is inaccurate and was slightly surprising to me: the shower room is separated by only one curtain from the room next to it, which is currently occupied by another tenant. Another small thing, from my room I could hear almost anything the person next door was doing.

A nice location, but it definitely was not enough space for 4 adults as listed. The whole apartment was very small (studio size) and the room with the bunk beds was the size of a closet. The pictures were a bit deceiving. Not great air circulation either so it was a hot sleep. If you are a family with one or two kids, I’d say it’s big enough for a night or two. But it was ldefinitely not big enough for our group unfortunately. I wouldn’t really say it was worth the price for one night as half of us weren’t comfortable.

Giancarlo’s place was in a great part of Zürich, near lots of shops, restaurants, and accessible to transportation. The place itself did not look as new as photos. Also, the dishwasher smelled awful and several dishes that were in the cupboard had dried and crusty food on them. A little disappointed that there were no coffee pods for our stay like the other Airbnb‘s we had stayed had. Nor were there any salt and pepper and other basic amenities.

the place was good for the week we stayed, about 20m on the tram to city center. David was very accommodating and allow us to arrive before the check in time and check out late. we had a bit of problem with the hot water but it was sorted. overall I would stay there again
Do it. You‘ll not be disapointed. Great location very cosy „room“.

Disappointing Stay – Not as Described We were surprised to find that the property does not have an elevator, which was not mentioned in the listing. We had to carry four large suitcases up to the third floor (not the second, as stated), which was exhausting and inconvenient. The neighbor downstairs was extremely noisy, often making loud sounds until early morning, making it very difficult to sleep. Noise insulation is poor, and the broken steel blinds and thin curtains do nothing to help – both need urgent replacement. Inside the unit, there’s a strong, unpleasant odor that lingers. The place clearly needs better maintenance. The shower is a safety hazard – there’s no slip mat, and the water temperature fluctuates wildly from freezing to scalding, which could easily lead to burns. Overall, this place is not suitable for travelers with luggage or anyone sensitive to noise and hygiene. Definitely not recommended unless improvements are made.

Not a convenient location.  On 3rd floor with no elevator.   Light burnt out in stairwell and building is very dirty.  Not clear check-in process and host was unresponsive; photo should be provided of lockbox. Room was okay but pillows and bedding were below average quality.  I would not recommend this place.

Very pleasant loft decorated with style including its terrasse. The flat corresponds to its description. One simple observation: there is no blind/curtain on the windows (roof and wall) and it can be difficult for those who are sensitive to daylight.

Many eateries and a few big chain supermarkets near the area. It is also very convenient to travel around with the train station nearby the place. Hyesook is also very helpful, telling us the good eats and where to buy cheaper groceries. Her place is also sparkly clean, very nice and cosy. We enjoyed our stay and will come back to this Airbnb if we are back in Switzerland ☺️

I stayed from July 3–9 with my two teenage kids. The apartment is spacious and well located — 25 mins walk to the high street/Zurich station, or 10 mins by tram which is next to the apartment. The host (Aurther) was responsive but we faced the following issues -  1) After specifically checking with him before booking, fridge/freezer were not working on arrival - Aurther replaced the freezer but we were without a fridge for a day.  2) Stove exhaust didn’t work 3) Odd bathroom setup (1 toilet with no shower, 1 shower with no toilet) 4) No door lock on bathroom doors, no towel rails or hooks 5) No wardrobes in any bedroom 6) One bedroom had no door and a broken light 7) No vacuum cleaner/no bin bags/no soap 8) Tiny shower curtain that doesn’t cover the tub 9) Low-quality bedding, and a dirty sofa.  10) Wifi was unstable This place needs furnishing / refurbishment to match the premium price. Aurther was friendly/responsive but overall, the apartment's condition was disappointing.

the place seems very unsafe especially with children. no ventilation . garbage thrown everywhere around the area. booked for 2 nights , had to find another place on second night . was scared to stay . host not considerate about the repeated request for partial refund , even though we informed them on first day we will not stay next day. place required a lot of maintainence.

Overall, I would recommend this place. The host was polite and responded quickly, which made the stay smooth and pleasant. The living environment was generally fine, though please note that the building has no elevator, which might not be convenient for travelers with large luggage. Also, no extra daily supplies such as shower gel or additional rubbish bags were provided. The nearby church rings its bells regularly, so light sleepers may want to take note.

Ladies, check out the review before mine to confirm that Men Live Here! It is not as advertised for ladies only. I was sharing one bathroom with at least 2 other men during my stay. Another issue was a privacy issue when the host attached an Airtag to the apartment key. I was notified by my iPhone that an unknown device was tracking my location and traveling everywhere with me. When I told the host I could not be tracked due to privacy issues with my occupation as a psychotherapist she punished me by taking away the use of the bicycle included in the Airbnb. I did not get the room I reserved (check other reviews for this same complaint). This was important because the room I was given, though larger, had 3 doors leading out of it. It was sandwiched between other guests and the noise through the doors sounds like it's in the room. Also the desk was placed in front of the window where there were no electrical plugs within 20' and blocked the window from opening. Not worth it!

I believe I was the first person to stay at this place, so feel compelled to write a review. The location is really good - middle of old town, full of action, short distance from lake and restaurants. A bit noisy but ok. I feel the host has put this listing in a hurry without getting it adequately ready for the guests. - this apartment has major trip hazard because of uneven levels in living room, kitchen, bedroom and the bed. My family members tripped and fell several times, hurting themselves. - refrigerator wasn’t running and smelling - there was half roll of toilet paper. We had to go and buy - no code to lock box given. Keys needed to be picked from downstairs restaurant (owned by host), where folks couldn’t not find it. And when they did, they gave us a wrong one for the building door. We got stranded outside on return - had to ring bells of other residents to get the building door open. - one bed room had no lights. Missing bulbs. - and top it of all, host was 100% unresponsi

The room was hot the entire time and the fan did nothing to relieve this. It was incredible loud outside. There were prostitutes walking up and down the street. There was broken glass everywhere on the sidewalk. You could see into the “opaque” glass bathroom walls and could see when each other went to the restroom. We did not feel safe walking anywhere in the neighborhood. The bathroom was not cleaned very well. The toilet was leaking and the tv wouldn’t work at all. Would not recommend to someone in the future.

Good location, but I would not recommend staying for more than a night. The place appeared very lived-in, with expired food left in the fridge and other signs of extended occupancy. It did not meet my expectations, though it might be suitable for others.

Clautilde's place is very close to train station. Round the place, there are lots of restaurants.  Walking distance to city viewpoints. The floor looks need to be upgraded. The air conditioner exhaust hose must be hung by the window when it is running which is very inconvenient.  Other than that, everything looks fine.

They never picked up the call when I was unable to locate the place. Later they informed about a different number, but I’m not sure why they didn’t provide the guest the correct number. The staff/lady was impatient while checking in. Most importantly, their bathroom stinks, bad smell as if it was cleaned properly. During all my stay I had to bear that terrible smell.
Stunning location looking at the lake in a super modern building.  Great park/beach and boardwalk across the street.  Easy transit options as well.  Lovely hosts.

Although not in center of tourist area it is well situated for Tram 2 and 4 with a stop a block away. Apartment was big and well equipped.  No air conditioning so confirm that owner provides fans during summer months.  It was unusually hot during out stay. Not typical for Zurich.

The apartment was a cozy and safe place to stay. The space felt warm and inviting, with plenty of comfortable furnishings and thoughtful details throughout. I felt secure and at-ease during my entire visit, thanks to the building's solid construction and reliable security features. Overall, it was an excellent place to relax and unwind.

If I could rate Christos’s apartment a 10/5 I would in a heartbeat. Close to central Zurich with an easy to access parking space in case you are renting a car. Extremely clean, comfortable apartment with a great view of the sky in the backyard. Relaxing stay with heated floors throughout, towel heaters, and comfortable bedding. Christos himself is an extremely pleasant person, responsive on Airbnb messages, and even congratulated me and my wife in person on our wedding and honeymoon. Provided tea, coffee, chocolate, pretzel sticks, and sparkling water was a very nice touch. State of the art appliances with brand new cookware would make longer term stays feel just like home as well!

I had a very pleasant stay at Alexandra’s apartment. She is a welcoming, polite, and thoughtful host who genuinely cares about her guests’ comfort. The apartment itself is beautiful, and my room was clean and well maintained. Initially, there was no desk in the room, but Alexandra was very accommodating and kindly rearranged some furniture to provide one, which I really appreciated. The kitchen table can occasionally be a bit cluttered, though this did not particularly bother me. Overall, I can certainly recommend staying here. The apartment’s short distance to Balgrist, Schulthess, and the Children’s Hospital makes it especially convenient for anyone working at one of these hospitals during their stay in Zurich. As this is a shared living space, it’s important for guests to be mindful that they are living with the host. Respecting the cleanliness of the apartment and being considerate and communicative will help ensure a comfortable experience for everyone.

Having been to the area before I made my way easily to reach Yvette’s place, which was about 20-mins by tram from Zurich HB. Everything looked so stylish, Yvette even provided her own brand shampoo or so. Definitely a decent place to stay if you want to avoid the noise in the old city of Zurich. What made a plus was it was only 5 mins talking to the lake.

The property listing did not mention that the homeowner also lived in the house. The kitchen was dirty, the refrigerator had a bad smell, the trash bins were full, and the dishcloth had clearly not been washed for days. We did not explore the other areas of the house because the homeowner stayed inside the property the entire time. We only remained in the bedroom and did not have access to the other spaces as described in the listing.

Bed is very hard, like difficult to sleep on. Room is empty except for the bed. Bathroom is usable but small and no real privacy. Area is not great, thought it would be more downtown, however we were probably 20+ minutes of walking from ANYTHING

The best thing was the tram which stops right by the house every 5/10 minutes. Easy to get to the airport and the city center. All the amenities we needed for a short stay (3 nights) were there. As the apartment is in an old building project - we sometimes heard upstairs or downstairs neighbors, but it wasn’t too bad. Worth the price (compared to other places in the city).

There was no hot water. The host knew this before we checked in but did not inform us about the problem. He refused any compensation, we had to involve AirBnb customer service. There is no ceiling light in the place. Some small lamps are cluttered around the room but only one of them worked. The host was impolite and rude when we requested compensation. I would avoid this host.
Location is Ok, overall is quite a plesant stay.

I don’t recommend this apartment. It is situated on a very busy corner street, where trams , bars and cafes carry excess noise pollution. Trams ring in your ears every five minutes.  On one night , the restaurant directly opposite,  had patrons who were excessively intoxicated and singing until 4am in the morning. There is no privacy, for example- the open windows expose you to every in the street - and because it’s level with a rooftop , people watch your every move. I had my curtains around constantly. Absolutely nothing comfortable about this apartment- it’s all image - nothing else and if you wish travel and rest - this is not the place . Sofa bed was uncomfortable- couldn’t sit on like a regular couch . “The balcony view “ is of the tram line . And other people’s rooms .  Not a good place to stay .
Patrick is a very responsive and helpful host. His apartment is fully equipped and spacious. Only inconvenience is the location not being super central.

Swiss Stays looks polished on the surface, but the reality was incredibly disappointing. It became obvious very quickly that guest communication is handled almost entirely by AI generated responses until issues escalate badly enough for an actual person to step in.   Every concern was met with scripted, robotic replies instead of genuine customer service. The apartment itself had multiple serious issues. There was an ant infestation throughout the unit, the back balcony was covered in green algae moss and clearly hadn’t been properly maintained in a long time, and the “extra bed” was basically unusable garbage. To top it all off, the WiFi never worked because the bill apparently hadn’t even been paid. I already know they’ll post some polished response claiming they “tried to resolve everything.”   That’s just simply not true.  Not once was I ever offered the option to leave and move to another property  as that is what i offer guests as a host when conflict can’t be solved.   SHAME

It was central enough that I walked everywhere. However, I asked about luggage storage and was told no problem. Different story on the day as they have limited space, its a first come first served situation, not something that was communicated to me.
I needed to stay somewhere near Zurich HB and this place was about a 10 min walk. I didn’t spend a lot of time there as I was out most of the day but it was convenient!
Unfortunately, I have to give a rating of 4 instead of 5 due to the kettle not working. But all the rest was top level !

One of the worst stays we’ve ever had.  The moment we walked in, we were hit by an overwhelming stench of synthetic perfume — we had to boil vinegar just to make the air breathable.  The AC was useless against the heat, and the bed was so sunken we slept in a pit.  The shower alternated between scalding hot and freezing cold due to faulty plumbing.  We paid CHF 265 per night, plus CHF 35/day for parking in a space the host rents monthly for CHF 150 — blatant overcharging.  After one unbearable night, we checked out early, but the host refused any refund.  Tellingly, when we mentioned we’d left our Airbnb, the hotel across the street immediately guessed the address: “Ah, Badenerstrasse 414?”  Clearly, this place has a reputation — and not a good one. Avoid at all costs.

We originally booked a separate place with Tania and we were offered this listing due to flood damage on the other. Great location and Tania was really helpful with our questions when we arrived. There was some noise from the upstairs apartment (footsteps etc) but these tended to stop before we went to sleep.

Not bad but certainly not great. Host needs to go check her own property. The freezer was so frozen it could not open. Probably not defrosted in years. We spent a lot of money to buy food to make in oven and oven was broken. Host’s response is we should order uber foods. What about all the food we had that we now wasted?  Coffee machine also faulty. The instructions for washing machine and dryer did not match the options on the machine. The pull out sleeper couch is very uncomfortable. Location is good and host had a facility to leave luggage due to our late flight out, which helped.

It was a little basic in terms of amenities including small worn towels, shower door needs maintenance  and no AC which was required as room gets hot and stuffy ..might choose a hotel next time for the same price

Place has lots of bright sunlight and has all the features you would want in terms of equipment. Location for us was away from the main city. We found some old empty bottles lying around under the sofa beds (from previous guests) and the towels weren't properly cleaned. So overall experience was not so great.
A beautiful well located apartment, very well presented with space and comfort, I would recommend highly

Overall a decent stay! Apartment is quaint and fits the description. The host is very responsive and all basic amenities are there. The elevator in the building is also a plus. The only two downsides were the bed (not that comfy) and a smell, I assume from the heating.
Worst stay I had in 5 years of AirBnB. I'm shocked AirBnB lets hosts like this on the platform. My lawyer will deal with the situation

We stayed at this apartment for a few days and overall had a decent experience. The place was clean, spacious, and in a great location—walking distance to the train station, bus, and tram stops. Communication with the host was quick and helpful. There was a small check-in issue due to unclear info about the parking fee, so we didn’t receive the entry code until we asked, but it was sorted in minutes. The apartment sits above restaurants, making it noisy on weekends if windows are open. Storage is limited: no dressers or hooks, and only two small cupboards outside the bedrooms. For five guests, this wasn’t ideal—especially in winter. One bathroom also made mornings tricky. The shower didn’t drain well, and the hair dryer was useless. The kitchen had limited pots, pans, and only three glasses—not enough for five. Overall, a clean and well-located apartment, but it needs practical improvements for comfort and convenience.

our experience was not so great. we had to climb 4 floors with all the luggage and with kid it was even harder. the hand and the overhead shower did not work and the kitchen cutlery also was not sufficient

The day before our trip we were basically forced into paying a $300 additional fee bc they claim when we booked the room (as a couple) we didn’t specify the guest number. When we searched for a stay in Zurich our setting was set on “2 guests.”When we questioned why there is suddenly a price difference for 2 people (1 couple in a room) this was the response:  “Well there are many Airbnb’s and hotels promoting single stays and you had the option to select for one or more guests from the beginning and our rates are still unbeatable in this is the most expensive area of Europe. If you don’t agree you can contact Airbnb -Chris” The day right before check in, we were pressured into paying an additional $300; if not we’d be forced to cancel and find somewhere else to stay. Despite the additional $300 charge for the “extra person”, we were only given a SINGLE towel per Person for the entire stay Shower head is broken Mattress is lopsided and uneven  All dishes and utensils were dirty

Kitchen floor was sticky and stained, ceiling lights were broken, saw cockroach in one of the drawers, not a very clean apartment. The location itself was fine for family, but the apartment was not maintained well.

The apartment is ideally located, close to all amenities. Every room was well equipped and spotlessly clean—apart from the cutlery, which I flagged to the host; they immediately offered to re-wash it. Check-in was slightly delayed because the gate code provided was incorrect, but otherwise the stay went smoothly and the host was quick to answer all my questions. The flat has a real home-from-home feel, and the balcony is definitely the star feature.
Was a very nice apartment and host was easily contactable and very nice. Recommend highly !!

- Unit was not ready past check-in time.  - Moved to another unit because the unit was not ready, but the other unit was not clean either. Oily and dusty floors, smelly unit.  - Miscommunication between the host and the cleaner. Messed up. - No responses after sending a few questions prior to stay. No communication about check-out process.
The door does not close and you cannot lock it. The heat is constantly on, even if you turn off the radiator in your room.

This room is in 4 floor ( ground floor, floor 1, floor 2, floor 3) with no elevator. I did not recommend for any lady with a big luggage . In addition, the main door is very very difficult to open. You need to push it very hard to open the main door.

Old building that will be demolished (according to the host). Nevertheless is more or less as seen in the photos. Broken blinds, missing amenities, and kind of dirty. Still in a good area near the tram and the universities.
Great location close to transportation, the lake, and multiple stores

The host is friendly and responsive. The Zurich guide he provided was helpful. We had to check out before our stay ended as the apartment was just too hot. There’s a small fan and the host provided an extra one but the hot temperature and lack of air circulation made it very unbearable especially for our little kid who had heat rash throughout the night.

Residential area near the lake (10min walk). The tram is in front of the flat, there is a food shop "Coop" at 50m2 and a Pharmacy,  restaurants/bars nearby. The flat correspond to the pictures. Our check-in was a bit chaotique. We arrived on Friday at 3pm check-in time and Tania was not there but the keys were in the box located outside the building. The keybox wasn't locked and the key for the next guests coming 2days later was in the same unlocked box. I informed Tania and she was unpleasant.The bins in the kitchen were not thrown away and the entier flat smelled very bad. The dishwasher had not been emptied. The lids of the pots and pans were dirty. In the bathtub we found its hairs and dirt. I informed Tania and a cleaning lady came and she was very rude and impolite. One of the bedrooms is noisy, you clearly hear the noise of the tram tracks as of 5am...   Shame that we had an unpleasant experience even if the flat is nice. We will not come back nor recommend.

The apartment was clean and spacious, but very dated, and the furnishings could use some updating. Location was very noisy, but it is a city, so there's not much you can do about that. But we had some issues with marijuana smell from neighbors and someone outside in the park all night singing loudly and playing loud music from about 2-5am. We ended up leaving a day early. Cher was very nice and responsive, but we just needed somewhere a little less noisy. It was an affordable option for the city, and if it were colder the noise may not have been as much of an issue. But in three summer it was too hot to close the windows unfortunately.

A very great location for the reasonable price. Calm neighbourhood. The food store just across the street. 15min to reach the city center by public transport. Small kitchen and bathroom. But we liked big and comfortable bedrooms.
Cozy place and it’s convenient to use public transportation to everywhere..

We stayed for about a week between 2 apartments, place is close to everything’s and bang for the bucks, We thought everything went well, but to realise later after checkout that the host requested for extra 450$s for damages, not sure which direction that’s gonna go with Air BNB as one of the damages listed was referred as oil spill for a small oily footprint on the floor. And funny thing is we only stayed on this apartment for 2 nights and checked out early due to early flights.
The house is very nice.  But Zurich is very hot this week, we are hard to fall asleep due to no air condition, but most house in Zurich are no air condition.
Simple but nice place. Very friendly and helpful host! Super location, right by the lake and 10min from town center! Had a great stay! Would stay there again in a heartbeat!
As per other comments, we’ll equipped studio but very light and noisy at night which disrupted sleep for 3 nights in a row, possibly due to the tobacco shop downstairs and nightclub next door
Quiet neighbourhood. Grocery stores and train station very close by. The flat is small but has everything that one needs (kitchen, desk, ...).
The price was really good Guyz were friendly The room was nice Good location While the bath was dirty Generally, I recommend this place 🙌
Everything was smooth - from reservation - check in to check out. Prompt answers to my emails. Room was spotless. Couldn't have been better.
basic apartment to spend a night or two in the centre of Zurich - it had all the functional things needed to stay overnight.  close to public transport and Zurich HB
Had a lovely time,  the flat is beautiful and has everything you need for a long stay.

Alberto's place is centrally located which is wonderful. And it is accurately displayed online. However, it is right across from bars and a library courtyard where teenagers like to hang out late into the night. Got quite loud. It was difficult for me to sleep. We were also disappointed that we were not able to get a second key even though we paid 25% more for having a second person.  It made our time more difficult as my husband and I were constantly having to arrange our schedules to let each other in and out of the apartment. Overall, this was not a good fit for us and we wish Alberto would've have helped us more with this request--or given a discount for the inconvenience. There was also an issue with double-booking such that a stranger came to knock on the door when I was by myself one morning and asked for proof of my right to be there. I was uncomfortable with this situation. Alberto did not give me a head's up. Unfortunately, I cannot recommend this apartment.
We loved staying here! So close to the tram which connects you to the airport and the rest of Zurich but not noisy. Perfect spot if you're visiting ETH.

A grand apartment for a solo traveler to stay for 5 nights.  All mod cons, great shower, only issue was I found the mattress a bit uncomfortable, but that would vary.  Tram into town is very close and it’s a very walkable city. Shops close by for groceries
Nice place to stay on a temporary basis

I would highly recommend staying elsewhere. Claudia is a nightmare to deal with, she will accuse you of “leaving garbage” when there is no information on where to take the garbage out to, oh and it’s not like you can ask someone else in the building since immediately when we got there all the other tenants in the building made it very clear we were not welcome. Also don’t expect shampoo or body wash, we checked everyone, there was nothing even though it says it was supplied. I have stayed at many Airbnb’s and never have I been in a worse airbnb. The room is tiny, it’s smaller than a hotel room, and you don’t even get basic necessities like body wash. The shower also floods the entire bathroom. Really I would stay anywhere else in Zurich but here.
10 minutes from oldtown and the place is right next to the tram and bus station also grocery coop and migros just outside the door

I'm really not one to leave a bad review, but this company/person put me in a really terrible position. I've recently moved to Switzerland with my small dog and knowing how difficult the housing and Airbnb situation is, I booked an apartment more than 2 months in advance with my dog included in the reservation. The reservation was for 40ish days to give me a suitable time to get my paperwork in order and search for a permanent accommodation. TWO days before my flight, I get a message from Chris that the place I booked actually doesn't allow dogs and he could offer me instead 10 days in a significantly smaller place. At this point there were really not other options around the same price, I took his offer and additionally had to find a place for the 30 days. This ended up costing me thousands extra for the cheapest last-minute place. We had been in communication the weeks leading up to the reservation and the last-minute cancellation was unprofessional, and as someone already making an expensive international move, cost me money I really didn't have and had diligently planned on my side so it would not happen.

The host has unlawfully required me to send my ID. After contacting Airbnb, I was informed not to go along with it. The host canceled the booking because I did not agree to the sending of my documents. I stayed on the street, without any accomodation for the night. Watch out for this offer.

These apartments are located in close to proximity to Zürich central station. This central location is convenient; however, the bar downstairs is very audible on the first floor and we requested a transfer to a higher floor for our second night which was granted and much more quiet. The design is as shown in the pictures. Unfortunately, several details prefer form over function. For example, wooden floors in the kitchen which were already damaged by water prior to our arrival. The bathrooms have insufficient space for toiletries, bad light at the mirrors for make up and one shower drain was clogged leading to a water spill. Some of the bedroom doors did not fully close and had to be blocked by chairs. Some carpets and couches had stains when we arrived. The apartments are packed with modern gadgets. Some make use actually more complicated, however. For example, you have to contact "James" to remotely adjust the temperature inside the apartment. You have no direct control over it. Even though Zürich is a very expensive city, the pricing of these apartments is still significantly too high given the downsides mentioned above.
Close to a tram station and a train station, very convenient!

Overall I'd give Stefani's place 3/5. The flat itself was clean, and had decent facilities with fans for the hot season. However, we had very squeaky fans that made a lot of noise (which they fixed on Day 2/3) , only one remote controlling the fans so we couldn't control both individually (again fixed on day 2/3). Our biggest complaint was the noise. There was major construction across the street for which we were only notified a few days prior to coming in. This was major construction so obviously they knew well in advance - we. ouldvw been warned but this locked us in. Further, right across the street was a gambling den that was noisy until very late hours of the night. Again, not a new fixture. This really soured the entire experience.  There is a train station 2 mins away which was nice.  Would we stay here again ? no.
The apartment was clean, quiet, and very conveniently located by the train. It is not in the main part of town, but still walkable to many nearby bars and restaurants. Would stay here again!
Great location!  Very clean, warm apartment with many amenities nearby. Would definitely stay here again on our next trip to Zurich!

The building is located on a hill, where no taxis/Uber drives through. It's not ventilated well, so you always smell something. There is no AC, so be mindful if you book it during summer time (it was hot during the night, and we only had a small fan). There was no toiletry in the unit, even not a simple shampoo / shower gel. The guy is so rigid, shows no flexibility / support. The instructions for green waste disposals were not clear, and his answers made it even more complicated. I'd not recommend this place.
In a very convenient location with a Tram stop right out on the street. There is also a grocery store across the road. Easy access to the city center.
Rossana’s place was clean, comfortable, and very conveniently located! We would stay here again!

Host is an old lady that she needs someone to take care for her place, she will be walking in and out of the rented unit without permission and you will have ZERO privacy. She walks into your rented place everyday many times and open all the windows so all your stuff are exposed, and so she can spy on you, and obviously your bags are out for thieves to see. She will hand you a long list of housekeeping tasks that mandates you to stay at the room to complete, and she will shower you with messages on your cellphone, what’s app, airbnb app, etc like a maniac. With no understanding that people travel to mind their own business not to take care of her room.  Despite not spending much time in the room during my stay, max total 10 hrs during about 5 days, she asked for more money claiming there’s a second person (renting an entire place- hence walking in and out of rented space). She will start selling you larger place and sending you non stops messages which turns your travel into hell.
Had a great stay. Friedrich and team were super responsive. Place was spacious and clean.
The place was great, highly recommend. Super close to the 31 line that will take you anywhere you want to go in Zurich. Elisabeth is very pleasant and met with us directly at check in

I love the concept of small rooms with shared spaces, including microwave, and espresso machine, and anything else you need in the shared space.  Very nice staff, very clean, great communication, great atmosphere, and you cannot do better with the location, right in the heart of the old town. Great experience overall. The only downside is because of the location, there was some party noise at night, but the ear plugs that the hotel provides for free were super effective :) I slept very well. Also, super comfy and nice bed! Ideal for singles. I would def go back again!

I stayed for two weeks and was very disappointed by the poor condition of the appartement. I found eggshells on the bathroom floor, the bathroom sink was uncleaned, and there was old food left in the fridge. It made me seriously questioned if the bedsheet and towels had even been changed. When I alerted the owner, she sent a video from her cleaner to "prove" it was clean, implying I was lying (I sent photos as proof). There were notable differences between the video and the actual state of the room; for instance, the blanket was positioned differently and there were dishes on the drying rack not seen on the video. I gained nothing from reporting this and didn't even asked for a refund, yet my concerns were dismissed.  The location is convenient (near Wiedikon station, shops and restaurants) but a bit noisy at night (cars and people). Because of the hygiene and the host's defensive attitude, I would only recommend for a very short stay.

This host was unresponsive did not provide access instructions and I had to contact Airbnb after traveling for 24 hours to even get in this house. I’ve seen reviews recently of others having this issue as well.  Due to his unresponsiveness and our inability to get in to the house on time, I would not recommend renting from this individual.
Good host. The place was just as described and Lazhar was responsive and helpful.

The apartment is quite spacious and very clean. The location was very convenient as well.  However, I was surprised how bare bone the apartment was. Nothing was provided in the kitchen, not even a salt shaker! There was one bath towel per guest provided, even though we stayed for four days.  And no toiletries with exception of a tiny disposable bar of soap.  We were disappointed by this lack of hospitality.

Location, size of the unit and wifi, are great but this is not set up for a long stay so I will not return. There were issues immediately on arrival: no clean bath towels, no trash bags. Host was not quite responsive: did not seem to see these as priority issues. A day later, the host refunded some money but gave no guidance so I ended up buying some trash liners to use in the unit and relying on colleagues to get the official Zurich trash bags. This was made worse because I had to buy many other things to make my 3-week stay possible: dish soap, hand soap (as another review noted, the one in the bathroom was watered down), paper towels, even a light bulb (one of the bedside lamps was missing it altogether). These are not things that should need to be solved after check in, especially for long stays. Minor things - like a freezer that has never been de-iced so it's pretty unusable, dirty pots, personal items left visible and disorganized, all add up to a disappointing stay.

This was the most terrible part of our Switzerland journey.  After reaching this place , Jung soo came  She welcomed us in a nice manner. She got Disappointed as we were having a three yr old child but later she said ok, She is fine with him and gave 20 Frank's as excess fess she had charged. She said it was an early checkin she had not cleaned her apparent  But said she will do it after our return fromRhine falls tour. But when we returned a party was going on . The rooms were untidy. Everything was messy. Lot of her shoes inside and outside the apparent. Refrigerator was full of her stuffs. After party her friends also came up and stayed for about half an hour. Most disgusting thing is that she offered the left over cake to eat. In between she wrote a big message to us that she was disappointed as we took 20 franks but we didn't reply to the msg as our tour would have spoiled. She finally asked us to pay back the 20 franks and we did. She even requested to sleep in the adjacent room we said yes she can But as she had rented the apparent , no frnds of her allowed in the apparent for security reasons. Airbnb guarantees Jungsoo but not her friends. The cake episode was just enough to show that how she bothers about the guests!!! There was left food in the kitchen  We have  pics of her shoes, refrigerator , toilet having dust bin in a place where a person can hardly stand. So much to write but big no for Indians As she wrote that : In your country ( India) A child can go without a reservation but not in Switzerland. She has no right to generalize the things . She has no right to comment on our " country "  The worst part of our Switzerland trip . All other 3 host were just wonderful  Tricia in Lucerne  Philip in Interlaken  Arnold in Gstadd...

Our first airbnb upon arrival and everything was great. Tania is indeed a super host and reply me almost immediately everytime. The apartment was clean and equiped with almost everything you need. Excellent!
Michal met me when I arrived and gave me a tour of the airbnb. Well deserving of the Superhost badge, everything is organized and run as smoothly as a hotel.

Pros: Modern apartment in city center with coop migros tram stop nearby. Has a refrigerator and microwave as well although it’s not listed as amenities.  Cons: Inconsiderate host. Elevator was not functional and property was on 4th floor. She knew about it. But chose not to inform at all till we complained. Her response further were inconsiderate. No money back. No help offered to carry luggage/ change accommodation etc. we had small kids and stroller with us as well.
location was good, place dirty especially a sticky floor, noisy place

The apartment is small but has everything you need (to cook, towels, hair dryer ...) It is far from the center but less than 15 minutes from Zurich if you take the train.  The only bad thing is the cost to get to the apartment but it is worth it!
There is no AC in this apartment, it smills very bad and you have to carry your luggage one floor to get to the elevator
Shelley's place was very close to a big Migros supermarket and a team station. It's very convenient.
Lovely and very clean apartment. The location is super convenient specialty if you have children

Price is convenient but the cleanness of the apartment is not good. Linens and pillow was smelling bad, I barely slept. Toilets are in same condition. I would not recommend unless you are looking for budget wise.
Nice room with external private bathroom in a well located flat (at walking distance from oerlikon train station). Very nice family.

Well positioned, especially if you are going to a concert at Letzigrund stadium, supplied with essentials and thought about guests in smallest details (even new toothbrushes in case you forgot yours).
The place is well located , but the men where together with the women , not good and people Were loud in the evening , I had to wake up early to catch a flight , and people Were talking

Stay away from this host!!! We followed all the house rules for check-in and check-out but the host apparently had some of his asking or requirements that were NOT in the house rules before and after our booking. The host NEVER communicated with us about that and those asks were NOT written in the rules nor communicated to us.  Afterward, the host will find a way to claim from Airbnb that his unwritten or unspoken request caused damage.  Run and stay away from this place!! Host tries to find a way to milk you for existing damages

The apartment was nice, neat and concise. Checking in and out went smoothly. It's well located in a private area with shops and restaurants. It was nice to be able to conveniently get to an fro on the #11 Tram.
Air conditioning was not good Definitely a very expensive property that should have had better ac for the price

The flat is about five minutes away from the tram station and around twenty minutes from the city centre.  It’s a large apartment in an old building. Some parts of the flat have been renovated, but others, such as the blinds, are quite old and don’t close properly, allowing the sun to come inside the flat at 5 am.  The cleaning wasn’t good enough: the two tables in the living room weren’t cleaned at all, and some corners seemed as if they hadn’t been cleaned in a while. Additionally, we found two cockroaches in the bedroom.  The coffee machine was broken, and the flat didn’t have a washing machine, which we missed as we were staying for eight days. We also miss a closet or at least some hangers to be able to hang the clothes. On the day we left, we went for a walk early in the morning. When we returned at 9:30 am (checkout is at 11 am!), two women were cleaning the flat despite the fact that we had not yet checked out, all our suitcases were on the floor, and it was clear that we were

Silvia’s house is absolutely gorgeous.  However I booked for three adults with a two year old and she advised that she’d been told four “guests”.  It wasn’t until I asked about a cot she advised that she became aware we had a child. This property should not be listed when booking accommodation for children, let alone a toddler.  The stairs have banisters, however the struts are wire and the bottom floor (there are 3), has nothing at all.  The back yard also has a set of stairs going down to another area that even an adult could fall down into if they didn’t know it was there.  The back yard is also only fenced on two sides, the other with small bushes leading to an open area.  In the end we were unable to stay there because it we felt it unsafe for our toddler - and Silvia’s many displayed personal items.  I did ask for a partial refund but was refused.  We also believe that Silvia would’ve been staying on site for the duration of our stay which was unexpected.

Excellent location, basic room with no special amenities. Theres a hot top for heating pans but the drawers for possible clothes have doors falling off, the fridge has mold, the bathroom was good but shower was weirdly dangerous to get into. I wouldn't even care about most of this but the price was Zurich expensive. The redeeming quality is that youre literally in the dead center of town, with a slightly cheaper option than nearby hotels. Overall not a great place to stay but if you just care about location, solid choice.

Unfortunately we could not stay more than one night during a five night booking. Upon arrival we realized all Sebastian had was a small desk fan in the middle of summer. We understand Switzerland doesn’t have AC but at least try and make your guests comfortable. We went to get ice for a drink and the ice tray clearly had never been cleaned. We cleaned it and had to put it outside due to the smell. Then when we were going to bed we realized there were no pillow cases for the extra pillows. The pillows were all very yellow so we used one of the owners shirts as a pillow case. The towels were incredibly scratchy and generally felt more like a single bachelors pad than any of the descriptions sent. We had to book a new place and Sebastian said the only way to even give me a cleaning fee back was if I left a good review. How unfortunate, wasted $1,500+ on this place and had to pay $1,400 for a new Airbnb. So unless you’re 20 or younger I would suggest finding a more suitable place to stay.

Not worth the price. The loft is not at all like what you see on the photos. It’s basically a large (empty) room with a glass door and no curtains. The kitchenette is a fridge with a coffee machine. Everything is cheap, just modern looking, but it is lacking functionality and attention to detail. There are no hooks to hang towels, shower head is not adjustable, it is plastic and wobbly and it hits the wall, the window blinds are metal, slow and falling apart on the edges. The bed was good. Working area is non existing. There is a tiny awkwardly narrow desk and a not comfortable enough chair that is not a working chair. The view of the balcony is onto a tram station. Breakfast is not included. Parking is payed, even when you manage to get it. Overall, totally not worth it, just get a less modern looking place for the same price and you will have a much more quality for your money.

You are very close to a beer garden that is on lake Zurich. It is also right off of a tram stop and a few blocks from a grocery store. It has everything you need and is quite spacious and clean. I found the messages I sent to Marie to be answered quite quickly. I wouldn’t hesitate to recomend my grandmother to stay here!! And I would stay there again too.
Good place, kind of small but had everything needed for a short teip

In addition to the general conditions which are fine, the host changes our rooms (from Apt. 7 to Apr. 10) up to 5th floor without proper notification.  Make things worse, the lift is broken so we had to carry all the luggage  up to the higher floor.

Very good and friendly host. Always willing to engage with you. All his information were accurate with regard to reaching the apartment, tips regarding moving around and eating out and many other things.  Room is a part of two bedroom apartment. One bedroom is with him and other bedroom is given to the guest. Good size common living room and kitchen. A private sit out and a very large garden which we hardly used. If you are looking for privacy then it is not for you unless unless you want to remain locked in the room.  Rolland cooked some great and lavish breakfast. He also gave us some great fruits when we were going for sightseeing.

Frank’s place did not feel like anyone is living there…it was not hospitable. It had been very warm in Zurich before we arrived and it was very hot when we arrived…I wish that they would have anticipated that a fan/fans were needed for our stay as there was no air conditioning.   I informed our host of how miserable we were when we checked in.  They informed us that they would send fans by noon the next day. The bedrooms are upstairs and the heat was unbearable the first night and when opening the windows there was the loud traffic noises on the busy street below..we were very tired and were not able to get much sleep. The fans arrived the next afternoon but pretty much useless…the heat continued and that night we still needed to open windows only to receive LOUD street/rail construction wake up at 3:30AM(I have video of this event) HORRIBLE MISERABLE NIGHT … also there was only one bathroom with bath/shower upstairs … the one downstairs only had a toilet and sink…Would not return

If you are in doubt - just book it, because everything about this place is excellent. Grazina is an outstandingly warm person, outgoing, friendly and thoughful. She made me feel at home the instant I arrived and throughout the entire stay made sure to check whether anything could make my experience better and offered her knowledge of local transport, the city, local customs and traditions. Everything was sparkling clean. Communication was excellent: response time is nearly instant. The place is on a private road in a very quiet location, yet very close to the centre and to the local shops and takeaways. Even for someone like me, who is extra-sensitive to any noise, this was perfect. It is on the edge of a large green area with pine trees and the air is crispy clean. Wi-fi was excellent: very strong uninterrupted signal. The kitchenette had absolutely everything I needed for cooking: from utensils and cutlery to plates, bowls, snacks dishes, coffee and tea cups, spare coffee machine capsules, champagne and wine glasses, etc. The chest of drawers had local guide leaflets and even a pair of flip flops and shoe tongues, which I didn't need, but it was very thoughtful. The space is very stylish and well thought out. Worth noting the mattress was very comfortable.
the bathroom is smaller than a cupboard the geyser doesn’t work, the beds are shit

This is a no frills apartment and you’re constantly reminded of this when there.  AI slop art stapled to the wall  No hand/small towels provided.  Posting advertised a wireless charger but there wasn’t one so we had to go buy a converter.  Included travel wifi was nice.  Loud sounds all times of day/night.  Sad looking room but in a convenient location.  I’d say you get what you pay for but it’s not cheap either so 🤷‍♀️

Nice place with everything you need. The parking lot that we rented was a big hassle! Already during our 2nd night there was somebody else on it :( We announced it and City Stay gave us another one. The 3rd night all parking lots were full and we had to find a public one! Knowing that the Zurich Police is very keen on parking frauds we were not very happy. Especially because we payed extra for the parking space!!! Unfortunately City Stay didn't refund the money until now :(
Beautiful apartment very nice host very responsive and very helpful and caring . I would love to book the same place if I visit ZÜRICH again 🙏🏼

The apartment itself was fine, but the overall experience was disappointing due to the check-in process and communication. We arrived slightly before the official check-in time and asked if early access was possible, but were told it would require an additional fee. While this is understandable, the situation was not handled very flexibly, even though we were already nearby. At the official check-in time, there was still a delay and we had to wait outside, which was inconvenient after traveling. Communication also felt impersonal and at times came across as distrustful, particularly regarding the key handling. The most frustrating part was after check-out: we accidentally left some belongings inside and informed the host immediately, explaining that we had a train to catch. Despite this, we were asked to wait around 40 minutes and were not allowed quick access to retrieve our items, so we ultimately had to leave them. Host suggested to buy the things from airport ultimately 🤔
Great location. Super clean. Good spot to stay.
I really liked the apartment!  Very cozy apartment.  Great location, quiet area, great view, transport nearby.  Friendly landlords, quick communication.  I will probably come back. Dainis
I had a wonderful stay in this beautiful and immaculate apartment.  It’s located in a peaceful neighbourhood and within walking distance of the centre of town.

Everything was more or less fine, but due to a few issues it was not very good. The instructions on arrival were not really clear. I spend 15 minutes looking for the key. And the room was not very clean: It was dusty and I found a used tissue in the closet. There was peculiar smell in the room (fungi?) and the fridge smelled very bad. Also, the microwave and the oven didn't work. This caused a rather disappointing cold meal.

The airbnb wasn’t ready when we arrived and they were still cleaning from the previous group and I had to ask a few times for fresh towels. The host came to serve a light breakfast of coffee and treats stayed to join us. We felt uncomfortable that the host wanted to take photos with us and my friend’s child.
The place was absolutely spectacular. Unfortunately, the weather didn’t let us fully enjoy the views, but that doesn’t take away anything from the overall experience.

Ornella is a wonderful and generous host. The apartment was very enjoyable and quickly felt like home. I really enjoyed the opulent sofa and the ‘50s/‘60s furnishings. The view is gorgeous and the location combines the best of both worlds…a minute to the tram, a quick walk into the city even without public trans. and great walks through mountainous woods, jogs along the river, all at the doorstep. I will definitely return.

Vanessa’s place was a perfect stay , cozy and clean . Communication with vanessa was great she helped reaching the apartment and  sent the exact location wish was perfect !! She took care of everything in details .. staying in Vanessa’s place is highly recommend..Thank you Vanessa!❤️

at a temperature of 34 degrees outside, we didn't even have air conditioning parking was extra 20/day.  the apartment has too many conditions than facilities.  In my opinion not worth the money ( 500/day)  All  respect for Jordane she did the job properly.
