Excellent spot in Zurich's old town. If you're looking to use Zurich as a central location to travel to other parts of Switzerland, this room cannot be beat for the value and location!
Worked out well.  Close to River and transportation,
Great place to stay. It is a bit far from the train station but there’s a tram that takes you right out front. Can be noisy at night
It was an amazing stay..very near to public transport and no complaints..would love to come back again..
If in Zurich with family, must stay. Take advantage of airport pickup service.

Good location and lovely setting, but the apartment is overpriced for its state and amenities, and the unreliable wifi. Many things/furniture in the apt. are/is old and slightly broken. Subas' parents often seemed overwhelmed and annoyed and lacked professionalism, as if they were bothered by my presence. The fridge was broken upon my arrival and they told me they will replace it after my stay (with six weeks still left on my lease). I suspect they didn't want to spend the money on a new fridge. They also asked me to sign their own contract which I later learned was illegal according to Airbnb T+Cs. At the end of my stay, Subas' father asked if everything went OK, and when I raised a few of the points above, he told me to stop talking, pack my bags and leave (one hour before the official check-out time). I did not feel welcome.

I stayed here for two nights. The room was clean, and the basics were fine, but a few things really took away from the experience. The TV had no sound, which was frustrating. I could change the channels, but the remote’s battery was dead, so I had to do it manually. Also, there was no air conditioning, and the room got really hot, especially at night. We could not open the window because it was raining.  Overall, the stay was okay, but I expected a bit more comfort for the price. A few small improvements would go a long way. :)) Other than that i'd stay here again.
The treatment of Karina and HITrental has been unbeatable, as the accommodation did not meet my expectations and quickly solved the problem.
Everything was good, but it is a bit hot during the summertime.

We had a great stay at Liene's place in Zürich. Communication and check-in/out went smooth and we got great recommendations for nearby places fit for a family with a young child. Definitely recommended!

A serious breach of privacy overshadowed our stay. The day before checkout, while we were asleep inside the apartment, a cleaner entered using her own key without knocking or contacting us and told us we needed to pack our belongings and leave because new guests were arriving. When she called management, Christian also insisted we had to leave despite our reservation being valid until the following day. It was only after we showed proof of our booking that they admitted their mistake. To make matters worse, Christian called a staff member “stupid” and referred to me as “ridiculous” for being upset about the situation. Entering an occupied property without permission and attempting to remove paying guests before verifying a reservation is unacceptable. The entire experience was unprofessional, unsettling, and left us feeling unsafe. 1000 characters cannot simply write the insanely rude and unsettling experience be provided.
Really good option for couple nights in Zurich.

The building across the small street is a hostel filled with people that spilled out onto the outside lawn at night and they played loud music and were arguing while drinking and drunk. We had to open the window to the unit because the temperature in the room was 25 Celsius as the AC was not working.

this was an amazing spot, very beautiful view of the surroundings from the apartment, very clean, and was in a very calm and peaceful neighborhood. Although checking in has too many steps, but they do a good job of providing the instructions. They are really responsive and a great host. Very much recommend this place.

Aurel’s place is in a great location with a bus and tram terminal within walking distance. As well, there is also several grocery stores within a walkable distance. The kitchen is large and there is lots of fridge/ freezer space!
This is the second time we have stayed in this location and it is clean, clutter free. It is exactly what we needed while in town for business

The location is nice, directly at the foot of the Uetliberg. The place itself is quite old and rundown. When I arrived it was a rainy day and it had a very musty smell, which made the whole stay not the most comfortable.

Petra was very responsive to my all my queries. the place is nice and cosy. beds are little on the small side, not so comfortable. there was no light working when we arrived late evening which made it difficult to locate things. other than that it's a decent place to stay.

The space just felt cold and not maintained. The beds were so uncomfortable, and I literally didn’t sleep the entire time. There were stains all over the floors and  fabric chairs. It felt like a prison in there. It was not worth the cost at all.

We made a reservation for 2 people for just one night.  Once we reached the location the access was facilitated by the fact that everything was explained to us before checking in. The apartment is also located in the city centre making it easier to reach any location.  However, once we arrived we noticed that the building was located next to a construction site. Due to this factor we were woken up by the noise at already 7:30 in the morning. The host could have had at least communicated this inconvenience to us before arrival. The apartment despite being functional and well located has also its own leaks: -The lights in the bathroom were not working, we had to take a few lights from the sleeping area and put them into the bathroom.  -The bathtub wasn’t working properly due to the mixer tap that was already broken.  -The bed was hard and uncomfortable to sleep on.  -The smell inside the apartment , which forced us to open the windows for most of our stay.

If I cochlear give this place a 0 star I would. The first day there was ants in my room. The maintenance came and vacuum a lil and sprayed. The next day I found bed in my bed! The told me maintenance would come and did handle the bed situation until my very last day. I called for maintenance on Monday again for the beds, the host told me they would send maintenance and keep me updated. Leaving me to sleep with these beds not offering another bed or anything. Maintenance then shows up the next day, almost 24 hours later, while I’m not in my hotel room with all my personal belongs put in the open. Just for them to say they reported no bugs. Despite me sending pictures! And I had already cleaned it cause I wasn’t going to sleep on bugs. The front of the door code didn’t work leaving me and other guests upset and locked out when they never came to fix, just keep giving different codes to try. DO NOT STAY HERE! It’s not worth it !

Summary:  Humid, small room at ground level, smells bad all the time, from wakening up till falling asleep, caused by constant humidity. If you have breathing problems, don NOT go for this place !  I suppose the landlord is used to this smell. It made me feel uncomfortable. In detail:  - This is an old house with some electric cables hanging loose. The landlord put instructions all over the place so you won't forget what is to be done, what is allowed or not.  - The room is small  (2m30 x 2m80 ?) and very humid. There is a constant, unpleasant typical smell of humidity. You're not allowed to put things against the wall because moisture comes very quickly. 1 old chair, a table (+- 40 cm in diameter), no closed wardrobe, just an open Ikea rack, no hangers. - 'Kitchen' : a dark, humid space, with a very small window ( 40 x 20 cm). When you are in that space, you need to turn on the light. 'Bathroom' : concrete bottom. 'Take only brief showers' ....I cannot recommend this place.

Although we had some communication issues during check-in, he was polite and helpful when I met him. Location was good, in beatiful neighbourhood. It is approximately 20 minutes from the main train station. The building is located in a very nice complex.
location was perfect  but no personal welcome feeling.  In all other places we've stayed, there was always coffee and tea options, and shampoo.  This place had nothing.
Highly recommanded. Flexiable with check in and check out.

We had a great stay. No issues and located near little shopping mall, train station and public buses. Downtown can be reached in 15 minutes. Very quite appartments, updated and modern. Questions were answered fast andf we fell like at home. We will definately consider to stay next time as well. Thanks.
I accidentally booked two apartments at the same time. I never ended up staying at this apartment. Tania would not give me a partial refund or even the cleaning fee and was extremely rude about it.
very convenient and near Zurich bahnhof and have many tourist attractions, shops and restaurants around. however it might get a little noisy at night due to the nearby restaurants/bars.

Good location on a quiet, walkable street. Close to public transit, the Altstadt and the lake. Unfortunately, the check-in process was rather disorganized. We were unable to check in before 3PM, but when we did arrive at 15 past 3, cleaning staff was still in the apartment. They needed another half hour to complete the apartment.  The apartment itself is fine, but unfortunately a bit unclean. Most of the dishes were dirty when we arrived and the cutlery was sticky. There are some visible stains and damages around the place.

Host asked for my number so we could communicate for check in. Few hours before check in, informed me that the apartment had an issue and I could no longer stay there. The host suggested a much larger place - this one, and to cover the difference by direct payment. I contacted Airbnb, which was useless - they asked me to cancel the booking and make another one, which was impossible as we were just about to take off and I would be flying internationally. Airbnb told me that the host had a different number so they couldn't contact the host.  Finally the host created a new booking and although the place was fantastic, it was much bigger (and more expensive) that what I needed. Airbnb finally contacted me two days later to ask how I was.  it was a cumbersome experience and I didn't need the extra stress.

The apartment had an awful smell and the pictures on line did no justice for what we found. For this price we expected at least two normal sized towels and two duvets. Where i come from we get much more for our money.
The host was extremely patient and always replied quickly whenever we had questions. It made our stay smooth and worry-free. Thank you so much!
Modern apartment and quiet location. Close to many transport options and well appointed. Communication was very prompt and Michael is a fantastic host. Can certainly recommend.
Beautiful place and best location in Zurich next to Zurich HB which is about 15mn walk.
The location was very peaceful and accessible to bus stations! Enjoyed our stay!

This is a very nice and clean apt in a great location. But there were some issues: When we were there (28 and 29 of May 2017) the weather was hot and the lack of a fan or air conditioning in the apt made it very uncomfortable. We had to open the windows but bugs swarmed in and made it more uncomfortable. Bug bites are all over our bodies. Also on the morning of 30 May construction work started at 7:00 am on the floor above with a very loud noise because evidently they were doing work on the flooring. This loud, unbearable noise woke us up and made it totally impossible for us to sleep.

Mixed review.  I travel to Zurich monthly for work. Overall this flat is not worth the asking price and I wouldn't return. Cleaning fee not justified. Communication was  highly impersonal (though admittedly quick, which I appreciated).  Upon booking there was a generic message requesting my documents, followed by lengthy template directions for all modes of transportation arriving from the airport, followed by a generic message telling me that if I didn't follow the rules I could be "expelled" from the property. On the back of front door is a message with a warning that I needed to leave the place clean -- including washing and putting away the dishes -- or else risk an additional 100 CHF fee?  Then after I checked in, nothing. Not one word. I stayed here for 8 days. No note to ask if I was comfortable, needed anything. This felt like Airbnb hosting at its laziest.

Hello, Had a bad experience with the radiators as they were not working for a day and the temperature outside was -2°C and infant were freezing inside the house, one of the bathroom shower was having cold water until the day i checked out, One of the clothes rack (Heated) was not working until i checked out, On the second 2day of my stay the lift/elevator stopped working which was sorted in about 3-5hrs time frame where in half of my day was wasted. By paying 650/Euro per night i was not rewarded any compensation. Additional heater provided after 24hrs. House is nicely done and right in the city center 1min walking to bahnhofstrasse. Thanks

Do not rent this apartment!  The apartment was a total disaster.  Nothing had been cleaned including the shower, floors, frig, dishes, cooking utensils etc. There was literally rotting food in the frig, cooking utensils with leftover food on them, a microwave with crumbs / spills, a dish rack with red mold / dirt, a washing machine with black residue etc. The shower  was not cleaned at all with the bathroom floor full of other people's hair.  We would guess that the apartment hadn't been cleaned properly in 6 months or more.  This is the message that we sent to EMA House: As mentioned on numerous occasions - on the phone, in person and via the airbnb site and WhatsUp,  we are very disappointed that the apartment was in a horrible state when we arrived and that little was done to correct the situation. After we waited approximately 1.5  hours, two people came and did a bit more surface cleaning. After that we never heard from you. We are very disappointed that you did not respond to our verbal and written messages  regarding the time we spent to clean the apartment ourselves since even after the two people cleaned some, the apartment was unlivable. We sent pictures and messages.  We also asked to have clean, fresh items including soap, towels, bath mat and sheets and the permanently flickering light bulb fixed /replaced.  You confirmed to us in writing that the apartment is in very bad shape and was completely dirty - Adam who let us into the apartment took pictures, we also sent pictures both before and after the people "cleaned" . You also confirmed that you did not respond to our requests for help.  Overall a very disappointing experience considering the expensive positioning of the apartment and the expectation that any airbnb apartment should, at a bare minimum, be clean.

Central location  Smaller than imagined from pictures  Located close to strip club and night club Below was an off licence open to 2.30am On Friday and Saturday  When clubs emptied people accumulated outside off licence and we were kept awake until 3am At 6am the street cleaners came to remove bottles and then use a cleaning vehicle to wash street below Sadly not a peaceful weekend stay
It's okay, but watch out for the lack of elevators and narrow stairs. Not worth the costly rate, but ok for crashing for a night if you have the money.

This was hands down one of the best airbnbs I've ever had the pleasure to stay at. And I've stayed at A LOT! Its beautiful, the location is perfect, we felt like a local, and they made us feel at home. Thank you ♥️

The apartment has a great location, an easy check-in process, and is quite spacious, which we appreciated. Unfortunately, several aspects affected our stay. The bathroom was not properly cleaned upon arrival, the sink drained poorly, and we experienced a lack of hot water for about 24 hours. The kitchen was poorly equipped and the oven was not working. There were no extra blankets or pillows, and only one trash bag was provided for a 7-night stay. Additionally, although a washer and dryer were advertised, we had to go to the host’s office to collect a card to use them, which was inconvenient. A space heater promised for the second bedroom was never delivered. Overall, the apartment feels worn and not well maintained.
Good convenient flat, a bit noisy with the windows open which was necessary with the heat

The only good part of this Airbnb was the location. The studio was in office building. During the night heater stopped working and room got cold. The kitchen was too small and it didn't have a sink, usable for cooking. Studio was poorly maintained in every aspect. There were many stains on the mattress, they flip it open side down in order to hide the worst side. It was very gross and it looks like it should have been replaced a long time ago. Only discovered it on last night, because sheets keep coming off mattress. Duvet was not proper size and kept on following off Comforter. Pillows, sheets and mattress are all poor quality products. I found hair through out apartment different length and color. The couch didn't have a proper cover for the cushions, they just put a blanket for it. There was visual damage throughout studio the walls, furniture, countertop and TV. Also some of outlets and shower nozzle didn’t properly work. I just had an unpleasant time.
Really great location with lots of natural light in the living room and kitchen space. Anna was super communicative and we enjoyed our stay!
Great place to stay. The host responds very quickly and arranged everything perfectly. Clean, comfortable apartment and a smooth experience overall.
The vent to the main bathroom  Has a weird smell Coming form the vent very unpleasant/ also the ceiling in the main room I has a piece collapsing

James was excellent.  When the washing machine was out of order James offered me another unit - but too far from where I needed to be.   He did handled it very well. But this unit is not comfortable.   It is a really “pretty” place, but “designed by a man” might be a good description: bench mostly covered with appliances and  wine (for sale) frig space also, block-out blinds that don’t block out light at night, no long hanging space, no clothes drawers - even had to take linen out of the only useable shelf and put it on the floor to have even minimal clothes cupboard space.      And don’t try to use the loo quietly at night; couldn’t be turned off and made a long slow groan as the lid lifted and the seat heated even in summer!     TV remote worked for on and off, but nothing else. The window covers to fit around the portable aircon unit tubes were unusable, ripped off the walls.  In the ritzy part of town, and looks ritzy (except for the aircon) if that floats your boat!

An old and a bit shabby, but clean and spacious apartment. The only negative surprise was the 4th floor and no lift. Parking was easy to find on the street, but the city of Zurich hasn't made it easy to get the permit so it is recommended to check the process in advance. There is also a bus stop cross the street.

The location was pretty nice, the place is big and cozy. I felt great and enjoyed Zürich a lot. close to public transport, close to the lake and Chinese Garden. everything was great. Kay was so generous and kind. Thanks a lot.
Rosi has been a very kind and hospitable host. Well maintained and clean spa facilities. We enjoyed our stay.
Very convenient, in the center of the best neighborhood, one tram stop away from the opera. Great location for Zurich.

Toilet is not in the room. I had to walk two flights of stairs to use a shared toilet. This was not clear based on description. Room has very little natural lighting. The bed was insanely uncomfortable and I woke up with terrible back pain. While the location was great, I would NOT stay here again and would absolutely not recommend. Felt much more like a hostel than the description eluded to. Disappointing.

The location of this apartment is good as it is right next to a tram stop. However, It is not great value for the price. The beds are small, it is very nosy, additional guests beyond two people need to sleep on a fold out couch in the living room and the price goes up considerably. We were given one towel and no spare bedding for our entire week-long stay. Generally the apartment is run down and shabby (the shower broke on the day we arrived).
A tidy and convenience apartment in Zurich. The main railway station is nearby the apartment.

Well, we stayed for 6 days and needed a wash and dryer and internet and none was available unfortunately. THERE ARE NO WASH AND DRYER IN the apartment nor in the building available for use. It was a hassle to wash our clothes, we had kids too so we needed badly!!They gave us access to another building near by but we had to leave the building. WiFi was not connected. Took us a while to fix WiFi with no success. Stayed without the WiFi for all 6 days!! :( Lights in the apartment were very bad too. Rooms had only little lamps to light the Rooms and All plugs were tuned off when we came in. We had to figure it out all the plugs connection.

The apartment was as described, location close to the shops, tram stop and walking distance to the lake. Many restaurants and bars around, sometimes too noisy as the apartment is right above the restaurant.

We had a very disappointing experience with this property and unfortunately had to leave just a few hours after arriving. The house was extremely hot, poorly ventilated, and uncomfortable. Although the listing mentioned “fans,” there was only one fan for a 4-story house, which is completely inadequate. We tried to speak with the host, but he laughed off our concerns and said it would cool down later — not helpful when you’re traveling with elderly family members and the indoor temperature is unbearable. To make matters worse, the bathroom and shower areas only had curtains instead of doors, which was never mentioned in the listing. This is a serious privacy issue, especially for families. We had no choice but to find a last-minute hotel, which was expensive and stressful. The host was not cooperative and showed no willingness to help resolve the issues. Airbnb support was involved, but unfortunately the resolution did not reflect the seriousness of our experience. Not recommended!
Great location but the bathroom ceiling had mold and when we arrived there were fruit flies because of rotten flowers and fruits left out

Great apartment - everything was as described and super easy check-in. Super close to the bus stop so easy to get around everywhere. Overall was neat and tidy - could do with more of a deep clean but nothing that we were too bothered about.

My partner arrived alone at 3pm to find the key missing from the lockbox. The host said the previous guest lost it, but failed to mention he hadn’t left and may still have had access. While she was napping, alone and without a secure key, that guest entered intoxicated and demanded she leave. She had barricaded the door due to feeling unsafe, but he forced his way in. Only intervention from someone nearby stopped it from escalating. The host then blamed her for not having the key. Staff even debated whether to help because she was “only here for 2 days.” We had to book another place that night. The host promised a refund but didn’t follow through, and we had to go through Airbnb support. There’s also no car access, requiring a walk downhill at night if issues arise. Nice view, but not worth it. Not safe, especially for solo female travelers.
Bunch of drunk people yelling all night. Couldn’t sleep, had to leave windows opened due to lack of AC.

No elevator. This should be very clear to other guest because if you have large luggage’s as we had it’s painful depending on the floor. Smells from other people’s apartments and it came into our room. Room also had a smell when we first came in. Toilet seat looked dirty. It wasn’t cleaned correctly. Had spots all over it. The price I paid for a 1 bed with 1 bathroom it would be better at a hotel for same price. Basically it was a hotel and The only difference it had the tiniest kitchen which was a tiny sink and tiny stove top. We didn’t cook so we regretted not opting for a hotel and avoid the smell and no elevator. Internet was horrible and it eventually stopped working and they never fixed it.

Exactly how it looks in the photos and literally a 30 second walk from the nearest train station. 15-20 walk into Zurich town centre, I would definitely recommend and for the price I think you will struggle to find better.
The ceiling of two-bedroom is kinda of low. It is difficult to place a single bed because you cannot stand upright there .

We reserved the apartment for five nights as it was available online. Alice (the owner) rejected and replied that it was only possible for four. This was inconvenient, but we found an option for the fifth day in another place and booked this one for 4. Alice nicely agreed to lower the price slightly due to the inconvenience. Upon arrival, it turned out that it was actually possible for five days. We decided against another place (losing money) to save time moving, and paid extra for the fifth night. However, Alice decided that the initial price reduction was no longer valid and that we weren't making her earning more by adding a fifth night, but only she was providing a service to us. We don't see here a consistency, only a lack of experience in hospitality sphere. The apartment is authentic, but if it's rented out, there's no need for so much symbolism; everyone is different. It would be better to have a kettle in the kitchen so you don't have to boil water in a saucepan.

Received a many pages long guide (which is really a rulebook) from the host.  It specifically said that a cumbersome key retrieval is necessary if the host isn't home. When communicating about the check-in with him, he mentioned he would be home, so we didn't retrieve the key. He didn't respond to our messages when we arrived, so the check in process was very stressful.  The biggest issue we had was after check in with the host's communication. He didn't greet or or show us around the place -- and given the heft rulebook we were very unsure what we could use and couldn't use. At one point, the bathroom key disappeared. We messaged the host asking about it and only got told many hours later that he had accidentally taken it away.  While the apartment is immaculate, and the apartment is decent value for Zurich, the lack of communication from the host and the massive rulebook made us feel like we had to tip-toe around the house. Perhaps we caught Michael at a busy time for him.    Other cons include no lock on the bedroom door, and no fan despite the sweltering heat.

The bathroom is dated, parts of the walls mouldy. The bath is in a bad condition -  parts of the interior of the enamel have peeled off or disintegrated.  There are stains on the floor under the toilet.  The balcony is tiny and can sit only 2 people at the table.  The balcony and bedroom overlook a railway line ( not used for passengers but trains pulls in and out occasionally for repairs.  The above information is not mentioned on the website or evident from the photos.

Host is very rude when we had problem getting into the apt because instructions of check in is very confusing. She told us to refer to pictures but never sent pictures. When we tried to contact her, she refused to pick up calls and her language was aggressive in messages. No instructions on the wifi and only replied the next day for wifi. She also sent tons of messages to warn you of extra charges if you don't put back cups after washing them. Not the most relaxing stay with this host. The apt was ok clean, but beds are really small and not comfortable. The patio is nice. Location is acceptable.
Very convenient spot to stay in Zurich, right next to the tram going to the centre, and near the lake - recommended

I don't recommend anyone to book this listing!  I stayed only 10 minutes and left to a hotel it was dirty and smelled bad,  linen was dirty had stain and kitchen was dirty the host is not considerant at all when I spoke to her she was just shouting and not listening  very bad experience.
We had to book last minute and the host was very accommodating!

The apartment is located very close to orelikon station which makes it convenient but it’s very very loud, you can hear trains passing by. So if you need a quiet place, I highly do not recommend. The apartment is relatively small but it’s modern and clean . The bed is extremely uncomfortable unfortunately.

Pros: Very easily accessible as it is only a 5 minute walk from the main railway station and there is also tram stations right outside the hotel which is in front of the river. Lots of restaurants and shopping around. Cons: The room was so small for the price paid but it is Switzerland so can’t really complain much. If you have big luggages, it won’t fit in the room. The area is really loud at night in Fridays and weekends and drunk people screaming outside.  Overall, good stay!

The place might be OK for some people, but for our family with two kids (a toddler and a baby) it was not . Messaging with the host at the time of the booking was slow. The checkin went smoothly (a very responsive person met us there). But the place was extremely dirty (the worst Airbnb I’ve stayed in). The floor was awful! Maybe Suisses wear their outer shoes inside, but we don’t, and I would expect a perfectly clean floor for my crawling baby to play. Instead, I had to buy some clothes from the local store and manually clean the floor in the living room. It was very very dirty! Also, there were many stains on the walls and doors in every room. We were staying at the apartment for one week and the host has provided only one garbage bag for our stay. Kitchen dishes were only 6 pieces of each type, so we had to wash them after every meal. The place is right next to the train railways and there was a constant noise from the passing trains (even at night)!

The location of the airbnb was excellent. It was in the middle of a great area of shops and restaurants. The apartment is small, which was to be expected based on the description and photos. The bathroom light did not function reliably, and there was no soap of any sort in the apartment. No hand soap and no dish soap, despite the house rules asking that dishes be washed after use. I reached out to the host about these items, and he offered to bring a technician for the light, but his only response about the soap was to say when he was there prior to our checkin there was soap. It was a very hot couple of days in Zurich, and this apartment has no air conditioning. I knew that upon booking, but I was surprised there was no fan. We had to leave the windows open our entire stay, which made the apartment buggy and loud from street noise and church chimes. Overall it was not a great experience.

Great place, but poor host experience. I needed to modify my booking due to visa constraints and reached out within the free cancellation window, but the host’s slow response meant the free window had closed by the time they replied. When I asked to shorten my stay by 1 night due to the visa constraints, they refused, explicitly citing a desire to maximize earnings. They suggested that I cancel the booking but this would mean that I lose 50% of the full Airbnb cost - an amount they would get to keep.  Since they refused to modify, I asked them to cancel the entire booking on their end and issue a full refund because their delayed response caused the window to lapse, but they again refused — claiming the ‘owner’ wouldn’t allow it, which made no sense given they are listed as the host and control the bookings. Even after Airbnb intervened, they remained adamant. I ended up paying for a night I never stayed. I’ve never dealt with a host this inconsiderate, and left feeling cheated.

The apartment is super nice and had everything we needed. It's also close to public transport, so you can reach the city center easily. Only the traffic noise was a bit disturbing at night, especially because we couldn't sleep with closed windows because of the heat. Other than that, it was a very good experience and Stylianos was a very friendly host!
Really good host, location and size of room. Kitchen and bathroom a bit dirty.

The house is quite smelly when we checked in, felt like it is left unaccommodated for long time.  The 2 bed rooms on street side are noisy even when we closed the window and even at midnight. Bathroom has nothing even hand washing liquid.  We feel the house is not cozy at all :(  Bright side is that the house is very close to station.  I know Zurich is expensive but I feel this stay is not value for money… sorry.
Vita was very responsive to our needs. Even recommended good restaurants.

It was a late checkin. Host did very little to ensure we were comfortable. We had to ask for everything, pillows, blanket, water, keys, etc. It was not bad but not a great experience either. Would not recommend staying there.
Nice apartment with car park. Very flexible and nice host. Thank you for hosting me.

The Airbnb was ok, but we want to let people know of things that weren’t obvious in the listing. We stayed here for just one night. We had a late train in and upon arriving home, the water boiler was not turned on. We had to wait an hour for the water to heat up. Then the host told us that in Switzerland quiet hours also means no showering after 10PM, and told us we could “maybe” take a quick shower if really needed. I know this is standard for Switzerland but for the average tourist we wouldn’t assume showers are too loud for quiet hours. Also, the water boiler has a limited capacity, so if you really had 6+ people in this Airbnb you have to wait for water to heat up again.

The location is really great and the apartment is clean and cozy. But I need to share a bad experience we had. There was a problem with our check-in. The host gave us the keys to the wrong apartment. Up until then, we thought it was okay, as mistakes happen. We had to wait 3 hours to get into the accommodation. The problem is that the host said he was on his way to give us the key, but the cleaning lady, who showed up, solved the problem and told us she had only been notified 30 minutes before. This was very stressful. To compensate, I asked the host if we could check out 2 hours later, but he said it wasn't possible because other guests were arriving. I thought that was unfair. To be clear, I have nothing against them and I really recommend the apartment, but I just wanted to share this information to ensure that future guests don't go through the same situation.

This was singularly the worst Airbnb experience I’ve had.  The owner was friendly and communicative.  The apartment was quirky and ultimately adequate.  But the neighborhood wrecked our week in Zurich.  My husband and I arrived with our two children onto this dingy street only to find out it’s directly across the street from Red Lips, a strip club, which we were not aware of and weren’t thrilled about, but, ok, life goes on.  The rear windows of the apartment look down on a restaurant loading dock and are mostly covered with trash.  Around 11pm, a party started on one of the rooftops with really loud music - this continued until around 2am.  We had all the windows wide open, simply because Zurich was suffering from a record heatwave (there are no air conditioners, no fans, so a tiny breeze is the best you’ll get on a 4th floor walk-up apartment).  At 11:30pm, we endured some guy in an apartment downstairs getting into a domestic dispute with his girlfriend or wife, including screams, yelling and things breaking.  That's not mentioning more street noise occurring at 2 or 3 with people yelling not caring anyone else. At 5am, the street noise started again with trucks and noise of bottles being thrown out and we were woken up.  My husband left the apartment by 7am to go to work and stepped in poo that had been left on the front steps of the apartment building.  There were many prostitutes walking around looking for business at that hour of the morning.   This was our first night.   At this point, we realized that if we stayed here, we weren’t going to sleep all week.  And we felt really misled about the noise level.  To give you an idea, we measured the audio level in the apartment’s living room from a nearby bar at 85dB at 10pm at night using an app on my phone when one of the bars was playing music.  There is absolutely no way to sleep with this going on.  The description of this apartment borders on misrepresentation because it does not convey that it is almost impossible to sleep in this apartment during the summer, which is the primary function of the apartment.  We communicated with Stefan who referred us to the description of the apartment and the code words that he used: “lively” is supposed to mean unacceptably noisy at all hours of the night.  “Hipster” means strip clubs, bars and prostitutes, I guess.  I am highly disappointed because it was clear from the beginning too, that I was coming to stay at the apartment with my two young children, and my friend and her young daughter who flew from Paris to meet us.  Speaking of the apartment, it’s passable but not amazing.  It’s quirky all around, but the basics work alright.  The master bedroom can probably accommodate people no taller than 5’ 8” or 1 m 70 cm tall.  If you’re just a little bit taller, you’ll either end up with your ankles hanging off the bed--which was my case--or you’ll just rotate 90°--which is what I eventually had to do--and lay awake at night wondering when the noise will stop.  The refrigerator is in the hallway.  The kitchen is extremely awkward to cook in too. There are handmade decorations made of cardboard and papier mache in the bathroom, kitchen, bedroom, etc.  The headboard for the master bed are made of cardboard painted white.   We left the apartment exhausted from lack of quality sleep for 7 days straight and highly disappointed by the misleading nature of this description.  And I was upset that it was my first introduction to a city that has so much to offer.  The last morning, my friend who was sleeping in a room with her daughter just above a very noisy corner bar, was almost in tears because she had not slept all night because of noise. Upon arrival, on the kitchen counter top, I found three sets of ear plugs. Unusual, I thought. I now understand why they were there. Sadly, they didn't even work.
I stayed for a month. The apartment has all you need for living, gets lots of daylight and is well located.

This was my first ever Air BnB experience and it was more than a perfect a hotel rather i would say felt like home with all ameneties inside. Just felt it a little away to reach there with heavy luggages but the apartment was pretty good. Its well connected with Tram and Bus and have a lift service so it was easy to carry luggages.

There are no windows in one of the rooms and no central air, so its impossible to sleep without opening the doors to the center of the space and the other rooms as one cannot breathe. And then when you open the doors you are met with living next to an extremely loud traffic situation directly outside as the freeway starts and stops right outside the window. We did not enjoy our time here.

The location is excellent. The place is spacious, clean, and felt cozy. My only issue was with the key: having just one for everyone is risky (someone might forget to return it or lose it), and leaving it behind trash bins on the street is very inconvenient. It would be better to provide one key per room.

Very easy to navigate to and super close to the train station. Which helps a lot if you are carrying tons of luggage. They were kind enough to allow us to drop off our bags earlier, at a fee, so my family and I were able to travel hand-free. Overall this trip has been amazing!

This apartment was really nicely located and convenient for getting around the city, and generally comfortable, but there were a few drawbacks. To use the AC units you had to have the windows open to street noise and the restaurants across the courtyard started setting up their tables at 6am every day. The unit had a washer/dryer (one of the reasons we booked it for the middle of our 3 week Europe trip) but it wasn’t working for our entire stay and we didn’t receive a follow up about the scheduled technician who never showed up. The apartment is also operated by a rental company so you will have a $500 hold placed on your card, in addition to the Airbnb fees, that I assume they will charge for anything you take from the mini bar + “damages”. If we visited Zürich again I think we would probably opt for a hotel and avoid the hassle.

Large bedrooms, small kitchen but functional.  A bit tired.  Listing was not quite accurate but host helped sort the errors.  No or very minimal amenities so had to buy soap, tp, etc.  Easy access to tram and pleasant walk to the old town.
A nice place with a clean apartment. Lana prepared a lot of things I need. I will choose again if I have another short term visit to Zurich.

The place was dirty, untidy, furnished with low quality objects. Not recommended.  Toilet, shower, kitchen counter, coffee machine, kitchen utensils were dirty and unhygienic. There was Tupperware with old food leftover in the fridge. Towels, bed linen were smelling bad. Floor was dirty and walls and corners had cobwebs.  We were too busy when we arrived at the apartment and did not communicate the above to Caroline. Hopefully she ll be able to fix the issues soon.  We had interaction with host before arriving to the place and she was very helpful and responsive. No trouble on that front. Location of the apartment is close to Binz train station which was convenient.

We found the accommodation okay but was disappointed with arriving and having no welcome coffee or tea supplies, no lights in the ceiling in the bedroom making it dark, the third bedroom is an internal bedroom with no windows or light and too hot and dark. It felt more like a 2 bed and study so feel we overpaid.  Not enough bin bags. The duvets were all single even for the master bedroom and were thin and the pillows were small and uncomfortable and the bunk beds were uncomfortable too. Communication was slow with our host due to being in Colombia and it having a 6 hour delay. We would not book this place again I’m afraid.

Stayed for 2 days, very near to the tram station. The place was clean and spacious. But I won't stay again at Pablo's place on my next trip to Zurich, he sent me some harsh messages without consulting his internal team and he needs to be polite with guests.

When we arrived, the place smelled fresh and brand new which impressed us.  However, most of the essentials we needed for cooking were barely available.  In addition, there was a lack of communication as some of our important questions went unanswered by the host which was frustrating for us.

Unfortunately the host demonstrated dishonest behaviour: first allowing to leave part of pot with stewed lamb (which I could not fully take due to small container) but then trying to charge for it. People with such attitude should not be hosting!
Basic apartment and clean but paper thin walls, noisy neighbours and no fan. We were there during a hot week, and needed a fan.
The key was not in the box when we arrived.

Jaybees place looks lovely but seconds after we arrived, at just gone midnight, a guy knocked-on the door and asked for a laundry pass. The massive fold out bed blocks window plug sockets, and the side of the double bed (which is against the wall so getting in is already restricted), meaning you have to swing your legs over the top of the fold out bed to get in the double bed, also leaving you sharing one plug socket above the bed for lamps and phones. The fold out bed is not comfortable to sit on as it’s deep, so either your legs are dangling off the edge or you have no back rest and are sitting on the edge. The apartment would be lovely for long term living minus the fold out bed because theirs loads of storage, however for short term stays there’s no surfaces for unpacking packing cases etc. The bin lid falls off every time you try to open it so we used a bag. We opened and left open a double cupboard behind the bed to create open storage for our cases. Overall a little awkward.

This was a very quaint apartment within walking distance to tons of things. In general the apartment was well stocked and the host was responsive and friendly. Because the apartment was so new it had a lingering construction smell, however, upon opening windows this was alleviated. The apartment was very clean and spacious for a small family. For the price it was a great deal. Would definitely book again!
It’s a very boor hotel with nothing  To connect to Wi-Fi you must have a Swiss no  And The room has the worst mattress , pillows and dirty duvet .
We will go and still choose to stay with them

Probably the most thoroughly cleaned Airbnb I’ve ever stayed at. Loved it! I really hate it when you get into an apartment and feel like everything needs a deep clean. This was spotless! Only downside was the stairs to the apartment. We had someone who can walk on stairs but it’s difficult for him, so he had a hard time because there weren’t handrails and the step were very old and misshapen.

Unfortunately I can't write a positive view about this apartment. The obvious positive parts about this apartment I CAN say is that it was very clean and well located to the centre. However, I instantly got turned off when I arrive to the apartment to find a thick manual with a long list of rules, and ridiculous fines of 150-300 CHF for not following them. They threaten a fine of 150CHF if you simply leave a few dirty dishes. I understand it's a responsibility of being clean as a guest, but the whole point of AirBnB is to have a genuine authentic warm experience. I don't need to check into a place with a company posting warnings around.  Additional to that, I contacted Anna many times in regards to best spots to park our car both before we arrived and whilst there. It took her almost 2 days to get back to me, which she just gave me the same information which was given in that ridiculous impersonal manual. The parking she advised was also 90CHF a day. We then found out independently you can park on the street all day by buying parking online. So useless for information. I also never met anyone at all for anything over the entire experience. If you want a totally impersonal, generically clinical and poorly communicated stay then this is your place.

I arrived a day early. The hosts were very accommodating, letting us in within minutes, which was great. The bed is fine, the linens clean, the Wifi works, the water pressure/temp is good. But I would not choose to stay there again, until it has a serious renovation. It was dank and smelly. Opening the windows didn't help much. Many things are old and falling apart. The dishwasher is broken and can't be used. The fridge is a disaster - the freezer doesn't work and it drips LOTS of water all over the insides, soaking your food in nasty water. The coffeemaker is falling apart, and the microwave is too far from the outlet unless you slide it over the stove. You can't plug them both in simultaneously. (A ten Euro power strip would solve both problems). If you have poor balance, the shower could kill you as the inside floor is so narrow. It's very poorly lit, and there is no vent. At a better price this could be three stars. But at nearly $230/night? That's just nuts.
Good place, clean but some dirty dishes left behind

Excellent central location to explore Zurich in a very walkable, safe, and central area.  We were traveling with our two children and the apt was a perfect spot to spread out with them and had everything we needed to make the place feel like our home.  Would highly recommend to anyone that wants their own space in Zurich without the fuss of hotels.

There were a lot of ants. Due to the vague pre-information, the accommodation was supposed to prepare a crib, but it wasn't prepared. My husband and I ended up sleeping on the floor with our 0-year-old baby on a mattress, but there were so many ants that we got bitten and couldn't sleep. The surrounding street noise was also loud, so it's not a good accommodation to stay with a baby. I chose a place with a microwave because I wanted to make baby food, but it was my wrong choice. My husband and baby suffered, and we ended up staying at another accommodation for one of the two nights. I'm just sad that my trip to Zurich was ruined.

Erik’s place in the heart of Zurich felt exactly like home. The space and ambience of the home was clean, spacious and great company to have around the host (Eric).  Will be a regular visitor whenever I’m in Zurich!

DONT GO THERE.. It seems that the reviews are fake. I am planning to have Airbnb verify.  Worst Airbnb that we have ever stayed in.  It has limited parking so we were told that they'll find one for us.. why should it be that way if the listing says parking in amenities.  When we reached there, the lift was not working and our apartment was on second floor. My parents have difficulty climbing steps so they put them in a different apartment. As soon as we were done thanking them  for it, we discovered hundreds of flying insects in the kitchen, and we that we found that out at 9 pm. They put in smelly bug spray and it was terrible.. simply ruined our evening and further plans for night out in city.  When we went to our second floor apartment, there were many ants in bathroom and bathtub,  some flying insects, spider webs.  There were  no comforters, Beds were not made and were dirty.  People are nice but that doesn't compensate for your ruined plans. Absolutely unlivable place. Avoid at all cost.

Location was good, convenient check-in. Otherwise, the apartment 230 was smaller than expected. the amenities were quite bad- 1 plate for a family of 4, 2 bowls, 4 glasses of bad quality. 1 pan and 1 pot, kitchen was very poorly managed. When hosting 4 people, would have expected some more basic cutlery. Cleanliness was quite mid, bed sheets were not fully clean and the folding beds and sofas were very uncomfortable to even sit on, let alone sleep in.  Okay if you want good location and close to station, otherwise not value for money.

Arrived to find a dirty bathroom,  one used-up roll of toilet paper,  missing basic utensils -- no spoons or cutting knives, one water glass, no water cooker, no salt shaker or dish towels, paper towels, dish soap, tabs.  My requests for these surprised the host, as if they were outlandish.  The freezer was stuffed with old bags of ice, and couldnt close. Three of the four electric window shades were broken.  Worst,  the "king bed" sported a blanket for just one person.  My urgent request at 9pm either for a 2-person blanket, as is displayed on the site, or a second small blanket, was  treated with annoyed scepticism -- the Host told me to send photos, and then promised grandly a full night reimbursement  IF the blanket was indeed too small, making it clear he thought i was a deranged complainer.  I slept  under my coat.  The next afternoon, someone at last brought a blanket, and shrugged that a new housekeeper had "forgotten" the 2nd one, and to clean well.  No fault management!

Magalie was a wonderful host. The apartment is exactly as described: Very comfortable, clean and cozy. Its perfectly located in a quiet neighborhood and as close as you can get to the ETH Hönggerberg.  Thanks Magalie for hosting me (it wont be the last time I hope...)!
Modern spacious apartment in a walkable neighborhood in Zurich! Washer and dryer were a nice touch but bring your own detergent.
Excellent hotel clean and tidy But the heating was not efficient and the items for dental cleaning were missing

This place is fantastic! Walking distance to public transport and parking garages. Very secure. It has an elevator too!! Not very many green spaces to walk the dogs, but our pups were very happy in the space. The separate bedroom from the living room/kitchen area was perfect for downtime. There is street noise at night, but it was like a white noise machine and helped us get some of the best sleep we’ve had on this trip! We would definitely rent with Stephanie again!!
Still my favourite place to stay in Zurich

If you are looking for a place to work temporarily in the area, it would suffice. But if you are trying to see the sites of Zurich and connect to the main train station as we were, it was very inconvenient to have to take a 20 minute street car to the center part of town. It is located in a working class neighborhood with very limited offerings for restaurants, bakeries or coffee shops, let alone pubs or bars. The location is not a tourist appropriate one. It's too far from city center in an uninteresting neighborhood. The flat itself was clean but dreary. It had one electrical outlet in one bathroom hidden behind the mirror. The small bathroom had no power source and neither had a towel bar or hook. The tub/shower had about a 1 meter differential btw rim of tub and and bathroom floor, making it very awkward to get in and out. Possibly dangerous for someone older. The biggest challenges were the location and lack of power outlets.

My stay was fine. It started off by being told I could check in early only to find an empty key box. I waited around for an hour and he didn’t respond until I called him. The communication was the biggest issue. I would ask a question and receive a message that had nothing to do with my question. It was almost like he just had automated messages at certain times that he pressed send too. But that’s not very helpful, and authentic to me individually.  The location was good, except people were shouting till 5am one of the nights I was there, which made for no sleep for me. And there was tons of broken glass outside the building door the next morning. Coffee machine but no coffee pods.

It does not look as brand new as you see in the pics. The flat is located in an old building. You get shocked when you want to entre the flat as the entrance is not a good looking one and gives you a bad impression. The Fridge did not work. The neighbours talked and shouted absolutely loud and we could not sleep well. The bar down the flat which also makes lots of noises. Finally It was not a good experience at all and not thinking about booking it again and gave me a bad impression about airbnb specially as, it was my first time using it.

The apartment suited our needs and is in a nice neighbourhood, but it was dirty, needs maintenance, and Joy was not good at communicating.  The apartment was dirty. The cleaner left a dirt cloth in the sink. There was hair on the towel rail. The dishwasher was full of previous guests' crockery. The splashboards were dirty. The "clean" cutlery/knives in the drawer were dirty.  The apartment needs maintenance. Many lights were missing bulbs or didn't work. The coffee machine didn't work well (on and off). The kitchen is not well equipped (no bowls, broken knife, french press with no lid). The bath tap was missing a fixture. The beds/mattresses were hollowed out with age/people sleeping on them. The mattresses/pillows were old and stained (but linen was clean). The sofa cover was ripped. The wardrobe in the master bedroom had a fixture hanging off. Joy is not good at responding to messages. "Typical response time 11 hours" says it all. And I often had to ask many times to get a reply.
The main problem is the parking. Bad choice if fou have a car
Great location. Pretty noisy but the noise of the aircon drowns it out.
Nice quiet location, good communication with a very helpful host, clean and spacious apartment.

All was fine until a deeply unpleasant incident during check out. I was accused of smoking in Sigrid’s flat and leaving burn holes in the curtains. I reiterate again that I’ve never done so, whether in her house or at any other Airbnbs. I hope she checks and concludes that I’ve never smoked in her flat and that those aren’t burn holes in the curtains. There were beetles/ladybirds in the room that could’ve left stains on the curtains, I’ve asked her to bleach them and verify that I’m telling the truth but received no reply about that. Instead she mentioned  she’ll report this to Airbnb, which leaves me no choice but to detail this over a review here. It’s really unfortunate that things have ended as such, this could have been resolved in a better manner. This accusation has soured the holiday mood, I hope you understand that.

We loved our trip to Zurich and Mo's apartment!  4 of us stayed here, it was a little tight, but we're there to see the sights, not hang out in an apartment!  Mo was a gracious host. We met him just as scheduled and he spent some time with us telling us how to best get around town. There is a train and tram station a block away, so it's easy to get anywhere.  One minor detail, there is an apartment complex right across the way, and the noise echoes. That with the brakes of the trains from the train station down the block, It can be a *little* loud if you're a light sleeper. But with everything else so great, I wouldn't let that stop you from booking with Mo.
Nice small flat with quite central location.  Tram goes close to the apartment so it can be times bit noisy also inside the apartment.

This was a great place for us. EMA House upgraded us near the last moment for unexplained circumstances, but who am I to complain about that?  They were very communicative and we would stay here again.

This was the worst apartment I have ever stayed in, and honestly, it makes me reconsider booking through Airbnb again. The apartment smelled very bad from the moment we arrived and was not properly cleaned. It was described as a “luxury” apartment, but it was nowhere near that standard, in reality, it was in very poor condition. There was no heating during the night, and we were freezing. This was especially unacceptable as we were traveling with our 9-month-old baby. On top of that, the host was rude and even tried to charge us extra because we had our infant with us. Overall, a very disappointing and stressful experience.

Before I booked, I was hesitated due to the zero review. However, it was one of the best airbnb I ever been. Beautiful furnitures, clean flat, nice neighborhood, a supermarket nearby. Romain was very friendly and kind. Highly recommend!
Disappointing stay as I was cold and curtains were hanging off and tv didn’t work/ I reported the lack of heating but this was not fixed. I have requested a refund
You will get well maintained appartments, spacious and close to the restaurants, lake etc...

We are a family of six and chose this apartment mainly for its great location, close to the city center and many attractions. As the final stop of our European trip, we hoped for a smooth and relaxing stay. Unfortunately, our experience was more stressful than expected. After a nine-hour drive from France, we arrived expecting an early check-in that had been arranged in advance. However, there was a problem with the key handover, and we waited about two hours before entering the apartment. The apartment was comfortable, but we were disappointed that no coffee pods or laundry detergent were provided. Checkout was also stressful when I accidentally left my handbag inside. Communication was difficult due to a language barrier but was able to resolve too.  The location is the apartment’s strongest feature. However, the delayed check-in, checkout difficulties, and lack of basic supplies negatively affected our stay. This is the first low rating I have given after 20 trips in airbnb.

The towels and beds were very good and clean, and the location was pretty good.  However we were disappointed with the general state of the rooms. The shower was absolutely terrible. The general state of repair was not great. The floor was chipped in many places There were no curtains or covers on the windows. Also there was alot of noise from next door and the top hall stank of cannibis. I understand you can't do anything about noise from next door but the walls are paper thin - I was woken up on sunday morning at 5.20 am and could hear my neighbours snoring every night. The roof was in a bad state of repair, some of the boards were smashed, so we could not use it. It is also very difficult to access. Generally the apartment looks neglected, and our feeling is that it is not good value and very disapppointing. Honestly I would recommend total renovation - I have shared my review with the owner who has indicated that she does not share my opinion.
Decent place, as long as you're not claustrophobic (as is the case with all capsule hotels). Close to a tram stop that runs to central station

Very clean and modern family sized apartment. Kitchen is fully equipped. Nice and big terrace. Quick response from the team on airbnb chat. Washing machine and dryer available in the apartment. No Air conditioning but there is fans. Bedroom doors has no keys for locking them.
It was in the center place. Everything is so close. Noisy tho, but you are in the center close to bahnhof. The bathrooms could be cleaner but for this price it was okay.

We did not stay in the place and went to a hotel due to the location being close to bars and red light district of Zurich. If you are going with family you probably should not go there.  The host was nice enough to refund  one night after our objections to the location and not clear descriptions.

Thanks Rob for making us feel like at home. Great location, approx 10min to Center by tram which was rather close to the apartment. Rob was very flexible and let us check in and out in our preferred time. I will recommend.

I’m bald I only paid for the breakfast on day 1. It was €20 each & it was well below the standards we had experienced at the previous establishments. I paid the night before & in the morning my daughter didn’t feel well & chose not to eat. They refused to refund me & they were not even prepared to give me breakfast the next day as a swop for her breakfast. The lady behind the counter was aggressive & unfriendly !

This apartment is a complete disaster albeit the interior design looks funky and weird and from the 80s.  The mattresses are completly degraded, they squeak and they have a concave shape it gave us backpain.  There is sand on the bedsheets, the towels are all stained and unmatched. Buying a set of towels from ikea would set you back 50CHF.  Ants have taken over the kitchen.  Let us not talk about the floors, we had to vacuum the whole house.  Make sure to order your mattresses before coming.

Advantages: location is truly amazing, the view is great, not noisy, elevator, host was ready to help and kindly allowed us to check in a bit earlier. But from our earlier visit - we have found a strange man in our accommodation, who turned out to be a homeless man who just came in because the doors were open. This is something to do with security - lockers with keys inside would have solve this catastrophe… so this was not such a great experience from the very beginning.  Other than that - we were really disappointed with the quality of bed sheets (felt super nasty and overused), blankets were too thin - so we took one from sofa and uncovered the nastiest sofa we have ever seen - it had no upholstery, was full of someone else’s hairs, dirt.. Many things were broken, were really old, dirty and overused. I don’t think it such a big deal to buy new sheets and blankets at least, replace this little nasty sofa… We are really positive about any “adventures” but it was just toooo much..(

Frank’s place is as pictured. I’ve never been to Zurich before but this was definitely not the best part of the city to be in. There is no parking on site and I did not know this until arrival. There was no street parking available and we had a hard time finding a parking garage. The closest we found was a 15 minute walk and cost us extra money. It’s very inconvenient. There is no elevator in the building either so hauling luggage up and down is a workout, especially with a family. We talked with someone who lives in the building and the neighbors are upset about Airbnb guests parking in their spaces. It really should be made clear by the host that there is no parking included and that you cannot park in tenants spots even for loading and unloading. Fortunately for us one of the tenants allowed us to park in her spot to load up. Other than this issue there was a lot of noise the first night we arrived and someone rang our apt. Bell repeatedly.
Such a cozy stay, the studio is very well equipped, very clean and neat, location is quiet and nice as well, highly recommended!

Would not recommend for the price. I contacted the host ahead of time to specifically ask if they had a microwave and they said yes. It was not a microwave, it was a toaster oven and it was broken! I asked the host about it  not working not once but twice and both times they ignored my message. They ignored another message about a cleaning notice on the door getting into the apartment, and rudely responded to my trash questions. The bed was incredibly uncomfortable and the room was always extraordinarily hot. The soap in the bathroom was watered down, which is unacceptable for the price we paid. The bedside lamp on the left side was broken or needed a lightbulb. The only good things were the safety and location. Would recommend something else in old town Zürich.

Anka's place is very well positioned only 5 stops on the tram from the central station.  It is a spacious ground floor flat with a small study, a bedroom and a bathroom reserved for the guest.  It is a quiet, green and pleasant neighbourhood. Anka is a marvellous host and made me feel very at home.  I have stayed at many AirBnB locations, and definitely recommend staying here.

Sonia’s  place was very small but done exactly what we needed- a clean place to crash for the night. All appliances are there and kitchen it perfect for cooking. However we did have issues with the shower as the head could not be adjusted and the water also leaked all over the floors as the water was not draining efficiently, to avoid this we had to put the water pressure on very low. Other than that, it is an convenient place to stay for the night after landing in Zurich.
Max was really nice and I could not hope for anything more.

We wanted to love this place, as it is moderately affordable and a decent location in Zurich. The wifi didn’t work at all for us, not sure if other guests had this problem. It was a free network that we were able to connect to once, but signal was so bad we couldn’t again. We also asked if we were able to drop luggage early because we had a museum tour at 1. She said no and told us to pay to leave it in lockers at the main station. We tried to do this, but unfortunately every locker for big luggage was taken and I asked again if it is possible to just leave our luggage there a few hours early, again she refused and told me to be more patient. There was also very loud night construction happening during our stay. Overall, it is a nice roomy flat but with the noise, no wifi, no A/C, and without the opportunity to leave bags before check-in, we won’t be staying again.
This was a nice place a little ways out of the main city center. Not much to do around the area but it is close to the train station.

The location of the apartment is good however we were not satisfied with the apartment condition. It had a noticeable smell when we entered and the place though clean seemed old and poorly maintained. Definitely needs an upgrade for e.g very poor bathroom lighting, rugs were worn out and kitchen did not have a microwave or dishwasher. Also limited plug outlets do we had a hard time charging phones and devices..
The apartment is spacious, well furnished and very clean. Superb location, close to the city centre. Highly recommended if you plan to stay in Zurich for a short stay
I've been staying many times in his place. This is very convenient to me.

Andreas stay had its pros and cons. For pros, it was nice inside the room and the location was not far from the tram. For cons however, Andrea did not message me. Her husband Tony did, but I only heard from him one time and he did not respond when I asked a question or when I told him we had made it. This was disappointing as we shared the apartment with them and couldn’t do laundry unless they were home, which I never saw them. In addition, the WiFi had trouble connecting unless you were near the door/ bed, the lamp over the bed hangs very low and you may hit your head, the 6 flights of stairs are no joke, and on the weekends, it was very noisy outside late at night and sleeping with the windows open was necessary but loud. I probably would find somewhere else to stay based off the little communication.
The apartment was clean, new and perfectly located near the lake and the city. It had everything we needed! Thank you José-Luis

I booked this as my original booking cancelled so it was last minute...they location is amazing but there were no towels left (not even a hand towel) moldy food left in the fridge which had spread to the shelf ... PowerPoint was hanging off wall on kitchen ..all cabinets were locked so no where to hang clothes. bathroom was full of stuff so no where to put ours....single doona on a small bed...would never come back

Apartment itself is decent, nice views from the kitchen and you get major all necessities. You get Tram in just 3-4 minutes walk for all major connectivity. There is Migros supermarket near by, 2-3 mins walk. Rooms are spacious and lighting is good. However, it seems that host is not looking after this apartment much. When Dishwasher and TV were not working, they asked us about brand instead of providing immediate help. We researched on our own and started Dishwasher. TV was not working throughout our stay. Remote batteries were dead, we fixed that. Then also TV was just showing red right of power, never turned on, but host could never understand and fix the problem. Products like shower-gel and shampoo were not provided, which are basic necessities. Host said they do not provide it. We had to go out and buy them. Also when you have luggage you have to go to the back side of the apartment and drag your luggage to the building lift, because front lift on ground floor never worked.

We had a highly negative experience in this studio. Upon arrival, the bedsheets and bedding were clearly used and had a strong unpleasant odor. When we asked for fresh ones, the host's mother changed them but with a very bad attitude and insisting everything was clean. The worst part was the aggressive and intimidating behavior from the host's mother: she banged loudly on the door, shouted demanding entry, tried to access via the balcony, and repeatedly pressured us about leaving on the exact checkout date. This made us feel unsafe and threatened, especially when one of us was alone. Additionally, despite promises in messages and reviews to help with Zurich residence registration (Anmeldung), we waited 3 full weeks with multiple delays and excuses. The space is very small and overpriced compared to similar options in Zurich. Communication was difficult, and we felt misled. Not recommended for newcomers needing a welcoming and safe stay. We have reported these issues to Airbnb with
The appartment was fine, but I was shocked how loud the neighbours and the streets were. There was also a railway close to the appartment. I couldnt sleep for the first few nights.
Easy access from/to airport by train and to public transportation, food markets and restaurants.

I had a great stay at this apartment and felt at home right from the beginning. It’s a beautiful place set in a lovely neighborhood in Zurich. The hosts always responded quickly to any questions I had and were helpful. I can only recommend staying here!

Dimi’s place was just what we needed. It is in a very central location, very walkable. We walked to and from the train station, to the lake and the promenade by the river. The building is quiet and private with an elevator. It has a small balcony where we were able to have a drink at the end of our days and coffee in the mornings.
Excellent location and pleasant stay. Very clean and all the basic amenities are provided. They respond very quickly. It was worth every penny.

Overall, I had a good stay; the information in the listing matched the apartment. I thought the responses could have been faster and more accurate, but all my questions were answered. The apartment could have been cleaner; there was hair on the bed and in the bathroom. Also, the apartment had a musty smell; the pillows and sheets didn't smell good, they seemed used.
Very nice apartment, right next to the zoo. In a quiet neighborhood. The tram stop is close by.
absolutely an incredible experience. deff worth every penny and made a hell of a proposal location!!!

Wi was difficult to communicate with and had many unexplained requirements. She didn't explain her reasoning and caused confusion while trying to find her apartment and sent a friend who spoke little English to try and find us with the key. WI threatened to cancel the reservation because I was unable to understand her directions while we stood in the rain next to her building. After long hours and cancelled flights over 24hrs we were unable to shower after 10pm due to noise. Extremely unkind and not mentioned in the listing!

Very easy to get there from the central station, very clean and comfortable. Our stay was great thank to Dimi’s help.
Very good location! Just on the corner of storchen hotel Bed was comfortable, just sound isolation is not the best, but it is common for old buildings.
Great apartment - bright, clean, and just the right size. It has everything you need for a comfortable stay. Highly recommended!
A beautiful place, super well located, small but with everything you may need! the attention they gave us was Super, very detailed
Host was not there at checkin but explained by phone where to find things after I asked. location is very good

This was the worst hospitality experience I have ever had! The communication seems to be done by AI and there is no one to help on this site. Our room was dirty and have a very strong guest. Left the apartment at 1am as no one was supporting us and booked a hotel. My suggestion to airbnb is no remove these people from the platform - you are not supposed to run a business and particularly not in the hospitality industry

I'm afraid I will find it difficult to recommend Blanca's place to anyone. For me the main problem was the noise - it's a on a very busy street and the traffic noise is really bad. Of course, apartments in a city centre will always come with some noise, and I should have checked more thoroughly exactly where the apartment was perhaps, but I would have hoped that the room was away from the street, facing a courtyard perhaps, or that somewhere in the description it was stated that the apartment was on a main road. The apartment itself was fine although it wasn't spotless when I got it - crumbs in the fridge, dust on the shelves and the shower needs a new head on it and the rug looks filthy. It is clearly a rental only apartment and this I have a problem with - I thought the main purpose of Airbnb was for hosts to offer their homes to strangers, travellers, so that the guest gets the feeling of living in a home away from home rather than an impersonal hotel room. Blanca's apartment felt very cold and empty and in the end I only stayed 3 out of the 15 or so nights I booked for. I must add that Blanca and Chris were very sympathetic and did give me a small refund when in fact I should have got nothing back due to their strict cancellation policy. I don't normally write such detailed reviews and I hate to be so negative, it's only because my previous Airbnb experiences have been so great and this one was so disappointing. I'm sure it would suit some people but sadly this apartment was not for me.
A clearer instruction is demanded. It is not just about communication, but the host should do everything in her capacity to assist.
Once again, this apartment worked well for my needs in Zürich.

Sonja’s studio apartment was great for our 2 nights in Zurich. It is well priced compared to hotels in the area. It’s about a 20/25 minute walk to the main train station/town centre but it’s a straightforward walk. The apartment has the basics you need to make breakfast or a basic meal. The bed was very comfy and the shower was great. Thank you Sonja.

We stood in rain for an hour because there was no self check in.  There were no photos of outside steps to access apartment door and no mention of this in listing that apartment entrance was only accessible by steps. There are 2 small sets of stairs prior to reaching the elevator. Once elevator takes you to top floor, there is another set of steps to reach front door of apartment. I am disabled and use a rollator walker and had to use stairs with much difficulty while my daughter carried my rollator.  The cleanliness of apartment was very lacking. All of the coffee cups were dirty and the pillowcases and sheets smelled strongly of men's cologne.  The bright colored chairs in photos are no longer there. There are plain beige chairs there instead.  The Switzerland power adaptor provided didn't work.  The master bedroom bed sits very low to the floor and was difficult to get out of and uncomfortable.  There was construction noise outside apartment during the day.  I would not recommend.
Very nice place, good location, excellent cleaning services.

The only reason I am not giving this place a 1 star is its closeness to central station and affordability compared to other places.  We understood before booking it was going to be small, but the amenities don’t have to be trash, either. The bed was extremely uncomfortable and provided no support, and the bathroom light was flickering and stuttering so much it could give a non-epileptic person a seizure. The shower curtain also had clips missing, so the curtain would stick to you as you try to shower. Quite disappointed.

The apartment consists of one bedroom and one bathroom. Unfortunately, the heating system does not work properly. After contacting the host, I was told that the maximum temperature is limited to 24°C, which is not accurate or sufficient. At night, the apartment becomes extremely cold, and I noticed that after 9:00 PM the heating is shut off, including in the bathroom. The duvet provided is very small and inadequate even for one person. The location and nearby services are excellent, which is a big plus. However, the main downside of this apartment is the heating system.
Anna dan Karina's place is very strategic location. Close enough for explore allstadt area
