If you are looking for a comfortable, hip, conveniently located flat, you can't do better.  If you prefer your airbnb to be a sterile pretend hotel that nobody actually lives in, this is not that.  Thank you Roger, we loved our stay, and were sad to leave!

The property was poorly maintained. The stairs were unstable. Upon entering the room, I was hit with the strong smell of marijuana coming from the neighbor’s place. The check-in guy handed me earplugs and said, "It can get really loud at night."  The room was different from the one advertised, and it was a smelly with no wardrobe. When I told the host that the room wasn’t what I’d booked, he initially agreed to cancel it for free, but then changed his mind and said I needed to talk to Airbnb. When I contacted support, they tried to reach out to the host, but he deliberately ignored them. So, I sent him a message, and he replied “Don’t tell me what to do.” He then showed up at my door, knocked aggressively, and tried to force me to leave. The guy was literally trying to provoke me, stepping into my personal space and saying, “You have problem with me?  STAY AWAY from this property. The host is aggressive, unprofessional, and dangerous. Cancelled by Airbnb Support. Trip ruined.

Sorry, Ruxandra, the apartment needs a good cleaning, new linens, new bedding and towels. Dishes in the kitchen are dingy, and we had to wash them before use. Pillows are stained; linens are threadbare and mismatched; the white towels are grey from washing. The shower doesn't have a curtain and the water splashes all over.  Nothing looks clean. The broken elevator made it difficult to bring the luggage to the 5th floor. Good I was not alone and got help with this, otherwise I would be going to a hotel.  The apartment itself is on three levels and may be inaccessible to older guests.  No return renters from this family.
It was a bit more noisy than expected, but very clean

We stayed there for 3 nights, we liked that Tram line is very close and place was very clean.  Host was helpful when needed for fixing Wifi issues, but Wifi was very slow. We did not like that there was smell of paint from windows which bothered me while my stay.

Sleepless Nights Due to Undisclosed Nighttime Construction – Avoid This Listing This was the worst Airbnb experiences I’ve ever had. For three out of five nights, there was extremely loud construction happening right outside the apartment, starting around 11 p.m. and continuing until 6–7 a.m. We got almost no sleep. The host admitted they were aware of nearby construction but claimed it only happened during the day—which was completely false. When we asked for help, he dismissed us and offered no solution or support. Nothing about this was disclosed in the listing. If you value your sleep or peace of mind, do not book this place. It’s unacceptable to charge full price while ignoring such a serious issue.

Early check-in, which we paid extra for, did not work; host non-responsive to calls and text. It was a studio and not a 1 bedroom apartment as it was described. No place to hang towels for two guests. Moldy shower curtain. No work space and dining table as advertised. No instructions to washer & dryer. In fact, it needed a code, which was only provided after inquiry. There was no chance to wash, since the 2 washers and 2 dryers were in almost constant use by the cleaning staff for linen and towels of the 12 apartments in the building. No additional pillows as advertised. The "Rolladen" for the kitchen window was broken and stayed on "half-mast" (could not be lowered or raised). Sitting accommodation was 1 wooden chair and 1 metal folding chair as well as some sort of a small wooden bench in the kitchen area. No extra trash bags (for stay of 2 weeks). Building door entry code was replaced. Luckily, we were in the building to get the email about the new code on our computer.

Anna's place is really spacious, well located and great value. The upstairs loft bedroom is amazing :-) It feels very homely, has a lovely atmosphere and has everything you need. I can totally recommend it and will be staying there again on my next visit to Zürich.

We are so disappointed- since check-in nothing but problems. One- we paid for nice, bride app D, and instead they put us in app C, old, musty place stuck in 1970’s. Swisstay is not available on the phone- only email and text. And every time a different person responds after 1h!!!! Finally after hours of back and fourth- we got a massage that the place we paid for is not available and pictures on website are only a „general” way. Scam!!! Now apartment- dark, painted like a old prison cell, mold in a bathroom, one couch in living area and 3 IKEA chairs by a fold-in table. On balcony- rusted table and two old, broken chairs. Host is nothing but scam! If you have a chance to change your location in Zurich- do it!

We checked in and immediately saw ants in the kitchen and surrounding rooms. We told Jaybee and it took 24 hours to get a cleaning team to assist. We ended up moving to a different apartment (which was very nice of Jaybee) but this apartment was extremely hot. We had the heat turned down as low as it would go and even having the windows open and a fan did not help enough. We would not recommend staying here.

disappointed with the stay. the home was super hot and we requested for a fan to cope up with the heat. only suggestion we got from the host was to open the window. host said they will arrange a fan, but never did for entire 3 days of our stay. this became very tough to sleep during night
Very nice place. Checkin was easy. The third bedroom is a loft which we didn’t realize- open to the living area. Pillows were not great. Nice place and location
We had such a pleasant stay - the host was so sweet and welcoming and gave us great recommendations for the city. The place was beautiful, we felt super at home

The appartement is modern as shown in the photos, and provided everything needed. Only the problem is too close to the street and the noise from the car passing by outside was really annoying from day to night, so I had to cancel the rest of the nights and find another place quiet.

Frank's team was very communicative and responsive. The kitchen was usable, but nothing fancy. The apartment was furnished cheaply and the balconies are not usable, with lots of weeds. There were many maintenance issues, which they worked hard to repair. Only one toilet was a big surprise, and "laundromat nearby" seemed misleading, since it takes 13 minutes to walk plus a 6 minute bus ride to get there.  The two twin mattresses had blood stains around the edges, although we didn't see the black dots that positively indicate the presence of bed bugs.  The location was medium. Pros: a busy tram station was right outside, Migros grocery plus a pharmacist next door, and a mall one block away. Cons: very few restaurants in the vicinity though, and the area felt stark and unfriendly.

Cannot in good conscience give this a high rating, no clue how it has such a high rating. To start, oodles of unnecessary rules for such a mediocre property. Bed was extremely uncomfortable. You can literally feel the springs in the mattress. The pillows were worse than ones you would find on a sofa. The location is pretty low rent.  I know this isnt a reflection of the property itself, but after I was upcharged for a parking spot, was accosted by a neighbor. This doesnt reflect on the owners, but this was just one of many small experiences that made our stay uncomfortable. They dont disclose noise issues until after booking reservation. Heater has an incessant noise that just adds to street yelling and traffic that will undoubtedly annoy some people. There is pretty annoying light in the kitchen.  We checked out an hour late, slept in after not getting quality sleep based on terrible bed. The owners upcharged for cleaning, owner was cleaner, was waiting by door for us to leave.
Perfect spot, near to public transportation. Cozy and suitable for a family of 4-5. The downside is the lack of parking spots. Had to park 7 mins (walk) away each time in a public parking garage.

They provided beddings for 4 people, although we reserved for 5. They told the fifth person to use the dirty couch with chocolate and other marks everywhere, and the pillows on the couch. They did not provide bed linens, and clean sheets for the 5th although we asked them to do so in the moment we checked in. We checked in at the earliest moment they let us. They said sleep on the dirty couch tonight, and the clean sheets will be provided the following day. As it is a company, they stop working after 4-5 pm, which cuts any type of support if you need something. Yes, you can chat with them online, but they will just tell you to wait until the next day.
It was a good apartment to stay on for two nights the only issue was the whole building was a Little bit smelly , also we didn’t have A/C but we opened the windows to get a cool air from outside.

Positive: Great location, easy to walk anywhere. Negatives: Hosts were inconsiderate and dishonest. We had asked if we could drop our bags early, as our plane arrived in the AM. One person told us they would try to accommodate us. Upon landing, another one informed us the unit was still occupied (1.5 hours after checkout) and said to store our bags at the train station (which cost $50). Worse, before they said that they would provide check in code 24 hours in advance. When we were at the airport (after which we would have no internet), they said it would be 2 hours before check in. Upon questioning, their response was "Our team has changed the procedure this week." WOW! Only when I said I would escalate to Airbnb were codes provided. Also, the space is poorly maintained. Coffee table wobbles badly, there's a broken paper towel rack on the wall, shower curtain is 2 feet too long and clogs the drain. Also, we could find no way to convert the sofa, so our 6 year old had to sleep with us.

DO NOT BOOK I deeply regret booking this accomodation. I have stayed in many Airbnb apartments and while they can differ I've never given less than 5 stars until now. Jacqueline promised us more than a month in advance that we could check in at 2pm, and we booked our train and other travel commitments around this. She messaged us the afternoon before we were due to arrive in Zurich to say we could not check in until 6pm because the cleaner was sick. We asked if we could drop our bags in the apartment and come back later when it was clean, but she flat out refused. We still don't understand why this was an issue as she originally said 2pm would be fine and it's just the cleaning part that was an issue. The host became very rude after we questioned this. She did offer to pay for our bags to be locked in at the train station and I explained this was a hassle and I didn't like the idea but appeared we have no choice - only to find on the day that the train station lockers were closed down by police and not able to be used. So we spent FOUR HOURS lugging 4 suitcases around Zurich, waiting to be let into the apartment, with Jacqueline being unresponsive to our messages. When we turned up, we doubted that the bed sheets had even been changed and the bare minimum was clean. When people say it is a clubbing street ... keep in mind it is a loud strip club street. The police arrested a man in our doorway for theft, and we saw a couple of drug deals and strippers in our building. There was also construction work. I understand this has to happen but a heads up  would have been nice as it was hard to sleep at night with the noise, and hot as we also couldn't open a window for this reason. And during the day the construction noise was so loud we couldn't bare to stay in the building. This is the only Airbnb I have ever had a problem with and the whole experience was just seedy, unsafe and regretful.

cons - no elevator (as listed apparently). we had 2 kids and tons of luggage so it was a nightmare, especially after a long trip on multiple trains. to get there is already hilly. when asked, we were told that we didn't ask about it, kinda rudely. could be the language barrier but we didn't appreciate it. definitely not 'superhost' material. if you came to Switzerland to hike, this is the unit for you. apartment was kinda dated. sofa bed not so comfy. older style kitchen and toilet. pros - not so value but as value as you get in zurich. near trams, just 2 or 3 stops from town centre. somewhat of a view out the balcony. not recommended.

I’m genuinely concerned about the people who left a positive review on this place. For starters, we weren’t able to check in at 5 (which is already a pretty late check in time) because the room wasn’t ready. They offered to let us leave our bags in the room while they cleaned it, so we did. When we came back, our bags were thrown into the hallway which was attached to a bar. They could’ve easily been stolen. The meal I spent $50 on at a restaurant down the street had been thrown away. I planned to eat it for dinner, but had to go to the convenient store instead because of this. The “cleaner” didn’t even change the sheets that were slept on the night before. He also had zero cleaning supplies with him to sanitize anything. In the middle of a pandemic, nonetheless. Katie is a rude and inconsiderate host who does not care about the people paying money to stay in her Airbnb. Also, we had a flight at 5 am and we got NO SLEEP because the bar was playing music (the same song over and over again) and drunk, obnoxious people were yelling and stumbling around all hours of the night. I addressed these concerns and Katie responded saying our room wasn’t ready because our bags were in the way (one carry on item each, that weren’t even in the room until 30 minutes after the check in time) How does that even make sense!? The bathrooms are also the ones the bar customers use so have fun with that. I was refunded $10 when the total was over $100 not including the $50 meal thrown away. This is a joke. I hate this place and 0/10 recommend staying here. YOU’VE BEEN WARNED!!!!
This place is not worth for money we paid. blanket was very short.bed is too soft. no proper window covering.  no Ac..no wardrobes to store cloths. host is very responsible to respond your messages.

The room itself was beautiful and very clean, but the overall stay was not great because of the enormous amount of construction work being done on the whole building, which was NOT disclosed in the public listing. I wouldn't have stayed here had I known that there would be so much noise and lack of privacy. They said to me in my first message AFTER booking that "the studios should not be affected directly" by the construction work, but obviously that wasn't accurate.  Duri actually refunded me the entire amount of my two-night stay (which I really appreciated) because there were no blinds on the bathroom windows and construction men were walking around on scaffolds directly outside. I was standing there in my bathrobe and was obviously unable to use the toilet or shower because of the people standing right outside looking into the bathroom. Duri realized the problem after the fact and offered to put blinds up, but I couldn't believe they didn't know about the issue beforehand.  Aside from the privacy issue in the bathroom, the entire building was covered in scaffolding and the construction began at 8 am every morning. The noise was deafening. It seems dishonest not to mention the extent of this construction work in the listing description prior to booking. I was working remote and absolutely could not stay in the building to work because of the noise. I also couldn't open any blinds in the room because of men right outside.  The other things that were strange/annoying:  -- I wasn't able to adjust the room temperature. If I wanted it hotter or colder I had to email Duri and ask.  -- Check-in instructions were vague. Once I got to the third floor, it was just a white hallway with a few different doors and keypads. Nothing was labeled and I had no idea which door led to my room. I had to try my code on a few different doors before I successfully found and entered my room. Same issue for the bathroom.  This place has the potential to be a really nice stay but they shouldn't rent out the rooms while construction is going on.
Flat is a bit noisy due to the tram but fine.

Great location, the apartment itself is large, bright and airy with everything you could need. A place to relax in. Communication with Deborah was great, easy and quick too! Wouldn’t hesitate to come back here again! Highly recommend.

Sofa was not comfortable. Not worth sitting on. Could not get the TV to work but did not try hard. Noise on Saturday night from the street until late. This kind of jars with all the warnings of not making noise ourselves after 22:00

Good view from balcony and location. Old broken furniture. Needs paint job. Wooden floor overused needs replacement. Bad Smell of sewage in master bathroom. Espresso machine not working. Disgusting  water kettle. Kitchen ceiling partly falling down. Old bed sheets and pillow covers  Very old unusable bathroom towels. Stone age TV set and cable channels were disconnected. In general hygiene level is low. When commented to the host upon checkout, he said i should have told him the above he said he has many new items in storage which is strange as why it is not in the apartment. We were daily occupied with our touristic plans and no time to entertain technicians and change of damaged furniture. Not suitable for family that require  hygiene and comfortable place.
I find that leaving at 10, but arriving at 3 p.m. without any flexibility is not very nice.  We missed suggestions for plans around
Cozy and clean. Folks in the building were a bit noisy. Stairs are really tough going up and down.

According to the Airbnb app we paid 100€ for cleaning beforehand. As we arrived the bathroom floor was quit wet, dishes and silverware were kind of greasy and furniture such as the kitchen table wer not really polished. Generally ok, but if the cleaning fee makes up such a big amount if the asking price - and you’re told to clean your dishes and the flat before departure or otherwise you’re be charged another 100€ - the condition we found the flat in was not acceptable. Additionally the common places of the estate were packed with vacuums and cleaning mobs, suggesting a constant state of “progressional cleaning”.
It was a pity I could only stay for one night. Judy was very responsive and consistently attentive, even during my brief visit

Absolutely dreadful. I only have 1000 words so I’ll keep it brief - disgusting beds with hairs all over  the under sheet protectors, pubes in the washing baskets, black marks all over the floor, a stained sofa, cob webs and a dirty floor - there’s no way this place had been cleaned prior to arrival. It was extremely disappointing even more so because of the cost. Then on day 2 the coffee machine started leaking everywhere (it was finally replaced), the oven broke later in our stay (again a temporary replacement was provided after 4-5 days of having no oven !!) and the kitchen was equipped sufficient for an over night stay, not a property marketing 1+ month stays, it was awful. Finally they don’t tell you about the noise. The floors are paper thin and we were woken up throughout our stay at 2300-0300 by people coming back to the flat above and walking around & closing doors etc. I would for all these reasons avoid this property like the plague!! Now they’re making up damage on check out

What put a damper on our stay was Zurich was experiencing a heat wave and the apartment had no AC.  We died of heat and had two sleepless nights. It’s not the hosts fault with the weather with the unexpected weather….. but it unfortunately made it miserable for us
Great location. Only major downside is that it’s a lot of stairs to get to the flat. As other reviewers mentioned the bathroom is small, but that didn’t bother us at all.

We had a wonderful stay at the EMA house! We had everything we needed and more. Beautiful bright apartment which was very clean. We even had housekeeping come in one day which was nice! the rooms are spacious and beds are so comfy. The bathrooms were clean and spacious. We had all the amenities we needed. EMA house was very responsive and friendly throughout our stay! We were even able to check in early which was so great. Will definitely come back if we are ever in Zurich again.

The floor was dirty and the cabin had trash and other things.  In the hall way and the room before entering the bedroom, there are many construction materials sitting on the floor, which makes it looks like a basement. There is a a building site just  opposite to the room's window, so it is noisy in the early morning and the the working time. There are many people living in this house, I would say the room I had is the most noisy one. There is no water in the room and one has to go to the third floor to use the toilet or the tap. The trash bin in the kitchen has many flies around. The room has no curtains, so it is very bright in the morning.  The mattress is broken and one can only lie 3/4 of the bed. There is no light in the room but just lamps which makes it impossible to read at night.   The good point of the room is that it is quiet at night and people living there are friendly (although I didn't meet Pearl). The washing machine is very convenient to use.

Black mold in bathroom. Room did not match pictures. WiFi was missing at first, then unusable once provided. Noisy apartment. Shower fittings were broken and dirty.  Would not recommend staying here. The location is fine, we had low expectations due to the price but were still disappointed. Most issues we had would not have been resolvable by the host during our stay, they need long term TLC and refurb to fix.

Our stay at this property turned into a distressing and unsafe experience that no family should ever have to endure. The area surrounding the accommodation was completely unsuitable for a peaceful or secure stay—especially for families. It was surrounded by pubs, frequent road fights, and intoxicated individuals loitering in the vicinity. The atmosphere was chaotic and intimidating, and we felt genuinely unsafe from the moment we arrived. We were forced to leave the area immediately due to the threatening environment. In a state of fear and urgency, we had no choice but to arrange a high-cost emergency taxi and book a last-minute hotel at a significantly higher rate. These were not optional decisions—they were made purely out of concern for our safety. What made matters worse was the host’s response. Rather than showing any empathy or concern, the host was dismissive and completely unwilling to acknowledge the seriousness of the situation. Their communication was never guest friendly

Unfortunately, no one had made us aware that there would be road construction all around us and also in the old town area, which made it difficult to get around. It was also not mentioned that construction would start every morning at 7 AM and the noise was too much.
Angelika and her husband were tremendous hosts! Stayed here for a week long conference and couldn't have been happier with the accomindations. Would book with them again in a heartbeat.

I would not recommend this apartment unless you are desperate and trying to save money. It was noisy until late at night and also early in the morning. The floor heating could not be turned off even though it was the height of summer and we were bitten by mosquitoes at night when we left the windows open. It is literally impossible to park anywhere nearby due to parking restrictions and no parking space provided with the apartment. I would say that the host did their best to try to help and fixed the blocked sink as soon as we reported it. The apartment itself is not in the best of shape, but is clean and tidy.

Overall stay was fantastic, convenient to transportation, restaurants etc. apartment is perfect for what I needed as an extended stay business traveler BUT the bar downstairs is noisy at the worst times (like Wednesday or Sunday) until the early hours of the morning.
Location is great,  but the lack of poor response from host and the dirty apartment was very dissappointing.

This is my first negative review ever and also my first stay in Switzerland with Katie was really bad. When I checked in, the room was extremely dirty and clearly had not been cleaned. There were no towels provided and no blankets available. As a result, I had to sleep on a bare bed and use my coat to keep warm. I contacted the host immediately to report the situation, but I have not received any response since last night. The accommodation was not as described in the listing and was not suitable for staying. I would not recommend this place since Katie didn’t take any responsibilities at all, no responses and left me behind with all those dirty stuffs last night. I need my money back!
Gets the job done, I paid ~$130 per night and thought it was good. Only issue was bumping my head on the ceiling of the stairways and apartment but I am 6ft 2in.
Great place, with excellent service. Neighbours were so loud sometimes that I could not sleep. But the place was great. Very central

We stayed for 3 1/2 weeks with two young children and this was the perfect space for them. Petra provided a cot and a highchair for the baby and lots of interesting toys suitable for my 9 month old and 4 year old. The location is very walkable to lots of great parks and supermarkets and to public transport.  Petra was extremely helpful and communicative despite being away herself with her family.
Very good location. But it's on higher floor. Not good for people with heavy lugggages.
Very convenient location stepping out of the apartment

A neat concept/apartment but self check in process was not straight forward for us. We found the portable air conditioning unit not v effective and very loud.  Windows could not be fully opened so sleep was difficult for us. May suit others more.
Very cozy apartment. Near the center and the lake. The room overlooking the courtyard is very quiet.
Very centric and it’s private, I would stay there again.
Only issue was the floor was a little dirty, other than that everything was great!

The host was very responsive. The location is very central and couldn't be better, in my opinion. The apartment was a spacious studio that had everything you would need (sink, dishware, Netflix, etc.). My only negative is that the place did not feel 100% clean to me. There was a smell of cigarettes when I got there, which I had to air out by opening the windows.
Great little apartment with big windows that look out onto the river. The location is truly unbeatable. And the host was very friendly and responsive! Highly recommend
Kay's place provided everything I needed for my business stay. Location stands out, so close to lake Zurich.
Second time staying. Very central and handy locations. Apartment has everything you would need for a short stay and even has laundry for the longer stays. Very accommodating host.
Every thing is excellent to stay here. There is only one concern about its mattress. It’s very uncomfortable to me because it’s too soft. However, my husband feels okay.

They threaten us because out of 4 people only 2 checked in and gave the passport, the other 2 arrived late at night, the day after they said they would have kicked us out and called the police if the documents where not shared… it seemed a bit too much for a slow ID sharing. The apartment was hot as a sauna and they were telling us there was aircon, in reality there was only 2 small ventilators not working properly. After we checked out, there were 2 plastic plug/socket broken - they were already broken and they tried to charge us 330 chf for it. We refused to pay and escalated to Airbnb which charged us 22 eur and we decided to pay. Afterwards, they privately reach out telling that they would have escalated criminal charged. Worst experience in Airbnb in my life, despite I’m a pro user and always got great reviews.

For the physical apartment itself, I would probably give it 3 stars. The bed in the primary bedroom is extremely uncomfortable (and I am by no means a snob when it comes to bedding). It just felt old and lumpy. As stated in other reviews, the bed in the second room is a pull out couch. The two rooms are separated by a barn door so there is no noise privacy. With that said, it is a very clean and spacious apartment. A pack-n-play was provided for our baby. Of note, you do have to go up 3-4 flights of stairs to get there. I gave an extra star because the host was very responsive and allowed us to check in early.   I almost gave 1 start because we had a TERRIBLE experience at the bar downstairs. First, it's cash only, The bartender was drunk the enttire time and very rude. She kept changing her exchange rate for USD. She also would not give us change (assuming she kept the rest as tip to herself).

The apartment is quite clean, charming, but has serious security issues. The lock that opens both the building entrance door and the apartment door is the same. This means anyone with the key to the building can also access the apartment! Unfortunately, we lost our key and asked the host, Saschja, for a replacement. He said he could give us a spare key but insisted that the entire lock needed to be changed at our expense. This was inappropriate. On the day of our departure, when Saschja wanted to discuss the lock issue again, we told him it was not appropriate. We argued that the security problem existed as long as the same key opened both the entrance and apartment doors. We offered to pay for duplicating the key instead. Later, he accused us of potentially entering his apartment in the future, a baseless accusation, especially since we had already landed back in our country. We had to contact Airbnb support for further assistance. This was an unpleasant experience.

Expect to be HOMELESS if you lose your keycard at night! The room itself was fine, but unfortunately, the service and communication were severely lacking. I lost my key card one evening, which I acknowledge was my fault, but what followed was unacceptable. When I returned around 9:20 PM, I was unable to reach anyone through the number on the Airbnb listing or the hotel’s direct line. Had it not been for the restaurant manager who happened to believe me and let me in, I would have had nowhere to sleep that night! Even after getting into the room, I couldn’t leave, not even to use the toilet! The hotel requires a key card for access throughout the building. For a hotel charging £180 a night, I would expect some kind of out-of-hours support or emergency protocol. Sadly, that was completely missing. Not recommended!

Appartment is located close to center and location is great. WiFi doesn’t work most of the time and when it does its super slow. Its bad if you need to send email or anything. The room is cold during the night even in summer. Its in basement with no light. Owner lives there as well and speak no English and its very difficult to talk to him. Good maybe for one night, but not suitable for one week stay.

Alright location but no AC means you need to open the windows at night and there is a very noisy bar underneath the apartment with outdoor seating which is crazy loud and a brothel across the street where a woman was yelling all night at prospective johns. And I mean ALL night. From approximately 6-8pm until 7:30am there was lots of noise. Fireworks, yelling, live music, smashing bottles, etc. location is ok in general but the exact location kind of sucks for the previous reasons. I would not stay there again unless there was AC so I didn’t have to open the windows.

Miserable experience!! There is no curtains on the windows and shared rooftop with other rooms.  Someone was looking in at me at 1:30 am on the rooftop trying to open the locked sliding glass door. I didn't feel safe in the safest country in the world and left to stay at the Marriott at 2:00 am. When I left this place the security was at the bottom of the floor with the women guard walking around and I left in a uber. Very frustrating stay and not very clean.

It was 3am before the bar across the road started to quiet down. The description said if you’re looking for a quiet break might not be the area for you but the noise was awful and we, after a couple of drinks ourselves, couldn’t get to sleep. I’m sorry but I would not recommend

Works for stays up to a week if you have a tight budget but rather dirty place. It had a chemical smell. The floor in my apartment was dusty. One can hear everything through the apartment door, I heard full conversations of neighbours and, one night, I could hear one neighbour having sex. When I was checking out, I also saw a cockroach in the staircase.
The apartment was nice and clean. It was close to the train station and the neighborhood has everything you need, like grocery stores, bakeries, etc.

Good location in peaceful neighbourhood. Walk down a slope for 5 min to a train station. Shampoo and shower gel are not available although they are listed in the amenities list. The hair dryer's power cable is damaged, with exposed wiring near the plug, and the plug itself is held together with tape. There was burnt smell when I turned it on. It doesn't appear safe to use. Contacted host, host asked to get our own shampoo and shower gel. Would have been better if this is accurately explained in the listing. Host said hair dryer may be damaged by previous guest and she won’t check the hair dryer condition after every guest checks out. But the tape on the cable looks very old. Spacious and cooling unit during summer.

Host was helpful and responsive, but unfortunately this did not outweigh several very negative factors.  To her credit, the host tries to have a simple, high tech experience for checkin.  That easy was complicated by the numerous codes necessary to get into the building and that had to be inputted into a phone app, which was further complicated by the fact that every person in the group (which included 3 minor children) received codes too.  It was very complicated to understand and process what was being sent.  After we understood the different codes, the interface was much easier. There was no disclosure that the apartment was on the 4th floor with no elevator/lift access.  We have 3 young kids and had several heavy bags.  Had this simply been my wife and me, not an issue at all.  But, with kids and heavy bags, it really made for an unpleasant arrival and departure. At night, the train station next to the apartment never sleeps.  There was noise all.night.long.  Very hard to sleep.
Good place and location. But minimal amenities. Not very friendly for elderly as it was quite dangerous to get in and out of showers. Otherwise would recommend

It’s a nice location. I was expecting more comfort. The double bed had a one-person duvet, instead of a double one and I slept for two days with my feet outside the sheets, until In realised I should twist it. The coffee machine was not working. The host told me that the capsules were not the right ones, but I couldn’t find capsules for that brand in the nearby supermarket. There are some utensils missing on the kitchen

The elevator, it’s only for luggage and even that didn’t work when we left. It was terrible having to carry all our suitcases up and down so many stairs. Be careful if you’re not young or have health issues, because the stairs are a serious challenge.

We are family of 4 ( our kids are 5 years old and 3 months old) in search bar we put our number of family and after we got the conformation we received email at the arrival, that normally is for 3 person and that they made us a favour. We slept only to nights and the neighbor from down she came up to complain about noise imaging we arrived at 1:30 at night and she came 10 in the morning to complain ( we didn’t even had energy to be wake fully) after 8 hours driving  The key box was in the number 21 but the apartment was in 23 and we needed to search and figure it out without telling us specifically instructions because in some countries the email ( key )  box is inside at the entrance  So very very poor instructions  Locations was ok but NOT  recommended from us at all

I was hesitant to write this review because I don’t like being negative, but I also can’t be dishonest. The booking process was smooth and the original apartment location was very convenient. However, upon arrival, the access code provided did not work. I had to contact support and went through a long, frustrating process before being relocated to another apartment. The alternative place was acceptable, though the location was less convenient. The next morning, the checkout experience was unnecessarily stressful. Overall, while the apartments themselves were fine, the check-in process, communication, and handling of the situation were very poor, especially for travelers arriving late or tired.
I've stayed with Haoran twice now in two different rooms. The building is great no matter the floor, and I'll be staying with him anytime I'm in Zurich.

The flat is functional, and 20 mins away by tram from the main station, in a quiet area. Communication-wise, the flat was missing a control wheel for the oven, and the entrance lights were not working, so I contacted the host on the 2nd day. The third day after that I contacted them again asking about the oven missing piece and then I got a very fast reply from Céleste, who came and gave me the missing oven control piece, so I think the first message was somewhat lost during communication. The entrance light was not fixed, however. The host also contacted me right after booking to inform me about the building being old, but that had no impact on my stay whatsoever.
Spacious apartment with all you need. Two balconys is a huge plus! John was a friendly and helpful host, and is highly recommended

Unfortunately, the whole flat was totally dirty when I arrived. Dust, crumbs, long black hair everywhere, even in the bed.  The bathroom was under water, long black hairs everywhere, I'll spare you the description of the toilet.  The kitchen was also dirty, with food leftovers on the worktop and the floor, the inside of the fridge smeared, the rubbish overflowing.  After a lot of texting back and forth, Shelly finally came at 10pm to clean up.  But even after cleaning, there were still long black hairs in the bathroom. I got a so-called "upgrade" because I had complained that, contrary to the picture, there was no desk in the room, which I needed for work.  However, apart from the desk and a wobbly plastic stool, there was nothing in the room. No chair or shelf, nothing. I was then "allowed" to take a chair from the kitchen into the room after it had been cleaned. The only good aspect was the area, which is very pleasant. Otherwise, this Airbnb felt like a total rip-off.
nice studio, warm underfloor heating everywhere, quiet, 1 flight of stairs, only negative for me was the very soft mattress
Very professional! Quiet location but very centrally located, tram stop is just around the corner. Recommended.

By far ... The most disturbing experience on Airbnb .  First let me begin by saying that the photos are as photoshopped as one can get . The reality is totally different . That is a very old, dirty , grissy ,noting looks like in the pictures .  The area is nice as you walk straight into lots of cafes and bars but very noisy if you want to rest. I have never met Alberto but upon arrival he has organized a lady to come hand me the keys, she has spent 3 minutes showing me what is where and left. I have spent very little of the month in that flat for it wasn't a pleasant experience being there . Other Swiss people that heard of the price I paid for a month there said that this is hilarious. The sheets and towels were old but most important were NOT ENOUGH for the period of one month - he never provided cleaning whatsoever for one entire month and complained the towels were dirty after I left ?!how does he expect will a towel look after a month use?! , I was doing my laundery in the city for big money (1piece-8chf), also for those that don't know in Zurich you need special bags to throw the garbage , since he did not provide them , I have bought some black garbage bags and put everything there . That turned out into a scandal after I left . He never being there , just by the words of the lady I met in the begging is asking me 600 chf on top on what I paid for that flat ! This is the crazy insane thing - I Have to Ask him for refund , not the other way around . there's no furniture , a tiny very old couch that needs to be washed and so does everything there . I didn't touch the tv because it wasn't working and was from another century and it gets crazier - he accuses me I stole his plates or whatever from kitchen .. Not only I didn't steal them .. I used them very few times , everything was dirty and old. All in all a terrible experience, he took the liberty to accuse me of things I didn't do while he wasn't ever even here . For that amount of money I could have stayed in a hotel . Once in a while sadly this type of experiences happen and although I dislike being in this situation it's my responsibility to lighten this up for other people looking to rent this flat . All the best to each of you and I hope this helps make a wiser decision .

I am reviewing this, but I had rented it for my son. He said it was easy check-in and it was a convenient place. He didn't realize the apartment was so easy to hear everything from others and they could easily hear everything from him. He said it was an okay place to stay even though there was no privacy.  Jun was a responsive host and had answered my questions for getting my son to the right place. I feel bad that she has to worry about the sensitivity of her neighbors over the comfort of her customers. I paid extra money because she requested my son ruined some of her decorations, plus she wanted me to pay for her disgruntled neighbors. However, that is not something that is an Airbnb's customer should have to worry about. I always try to leave my Airbnb homes better than I left it. My son said he tried to do the same but it ended up being a negative experience because of the few previously mentioned items. I do feel bad this didn't end better.

Had high hopes but was sadly disappointed. Probably the worst nights sleep I’ve ever had due to noise outside (party / talking / music) till 5 am. Building is not a nice feel, checking in is difficult and a faff The neighbours keep their door open and seem to watch what your doing The bathrooom is across the hallway and needs the key to unlock and lock each time The whole apartment and building smells and there is rubbish bags left lying around.  Terrible
Very nice apartment. Parking can be a bit difficult.

great. i am fine with no elevator, but some guests may have trouble with the stairs. the elevator goes to the second floor, and then you will walk up to the third floor, many stairs, with your suitcases, and back down, when you check out.  i'm fine with this as i am athletic, but some guests might not be fine with it.

There was no smoking yet the apartment smelled like smoke and there was an ashtray on the terrace full of cigarette butts.  Read the house rules before you go they do not supply any soap or anything but toilet paper.  There were only a few drinking glasses and just a few dishes.  The sofa bed in living room is very uncomfortable so don’t plan on using it.

I've stayed in Rosanna's place for almost 2 weeks to work in Zürich, and even if some small attention was here at my arrival, I wouldn't recommend the apartment for more then 2 days... First of all the bed I really soft (my back hurts every morning).  Second the WIFI doesn't work, when you are here to work, it's a bit too bad, i had to spend 40.- to upgrade my phone GB in order to have Internet. Third there's no possibilitie to cook, for a AirBnb it's really too bad, when you know what you pay in Zürich to eat, it's 50.- very day at least...! Not to mention the drunk neiberhood just right next door...
The place does not have air conditioning but the fans are very weak. During summer, it can feel very stuffy. Bathroom needs work

The apartment seems to be a former hotel room, which has been transformed to an apartment. Downside is that there is no kitchen/cooking opportunity and no extra sink to wash dishes. Apart from that, the apartment is very homely and completely fulfilled my needs.

Pros: This apt was beautiful. I would live here. It was perfect for me and my two female friends. The neighborhood is great with excellent restaurants to walk to. Tram stop right at the corner of the street.  Cons: Host was difficult to communicate with prior to arrival, I would send multiple messages and get a response days later. But once I got there he was very responsive. My only real complaint is the check in process. It was a nightmare. There were a million instructions and an app that needed to be downloaded, and despite following all the instructions we still could not get into the building. We also had no cell service as we are foreigners to that country so had to turn on roaming and accrue extra charges just to call the host. He was able to let us in remotely but we stood outside for one hour with our luggage after an overnight international flight so it was exhausting and stressful. If they could figure out a more straightforward checkin system this place would be a 10/10.

Pros:  - Cher was responsive to queries/requests.  - Check-in process was also straightforward and easy to understand. - apartment was spacious  Cons: - apartment is on the first floor, so we had to keep the blinds down all the time for privacy;   - no bowls and few cutlery provided in the kitchen;  - no trash bags provided. We were told that we could leave the trash for housekeeping to clear but it also meant we had to keep our trash in the apartment for 3 days. - shower experience was poor (main reason for the 3 stars). The input/ water pressure for the shower head was poor, and the water kept pooling. For the price we paid, I expected more.
You get what you pay for. Location is great.  No shower was presented to us.  Loud noises in the sanitary system throughout the night.  Unfortunately hammering noises started very early.
Amazing place, very close to shops, close to Balgrist and for walking enthusiasts like me , the city Center is not to far 😊
Only location is good, but it is not like a  B&B , host didn't contact with us. there were very little amenities.

I made a mistake booking his property, I canceled exactly one minute after seeing my error.  The host REFUSED to cancel. I talked to Airbnb many times and they spoke to the host many times and still the host refused to cancel.  Airbnb HIGHLY recommended I keep the booking so I could share this with you.  After the everything was done Nico tried to make it look good by saying he tried to resolve it but it’s a lie.  He was HORRIBLE!!!! Do not rent from this host.  I have every call documented and recorded with Airbnb as well as every text.  I tried hard, I even offered to pay for one night as a result of my booking error.  I paid over $1500 usd to make a point and share this review.  This host is AWFUL!!! I begged, I pleaded and so did the Airbnb customer service representatives with Airbnb and the host REFUSED to be flexible in anyway.  Additionally the area they are in after my stay in Zurich is not a nice area.  Do not trust the reviews you see on this property I believe they are fake

I recommend this apartment. It's so fantastic. Very close to metro.  It has a little bit problem, the speed of wifi is slower than I hope. But it is so tiny problem if compare with the convenience that you will get.

Not really a Airbnb room. It is a basement of a nearly 100 years old house. There is boiler, washing machine, dehumidifier and a very noisy fridge in the surrounding. The room has extreme mould smell and can trigger asthma (I have a history). The bathroom has no door. The room door lock doesnt work. The room was cold as hell due to poor insulation. The bed was making noises. The toilet is upstairs on the hands are to be washed downstairs. There is so much clutter in the house, like mess everywhere. Kitchen was so messy, couldnt see anything.  To the point I ended up calling Airbnb to seek AirProtect and move to a hotel as I couldnt stay there. Unfortunately couldnt find a hotel at late night and had to spend 4 hours and left at 8am and requested a refund.  Not recommended at all. Not worth even for low price for this property.

Julia & her roommates went out of their way to make us feel welcome in their home - even allowing us to drop off our luggage early.  We could use their kitchen, however  no towels were provided so we could not shower. It worked out okay as we only stayed one night and were flying home the next morning. She told us which public transport to take to get to the airport and 43 minutes later we were there. I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend staying at her place.

We enjoyed our stay here for the most part!  The location was great and place is spacious and clean.  The only drawback was that the pullout couch was broken, but we were still able to accommodate our group of 8.  Also, the showerhead was broken so water pressure is relatively low.  But those were minor issues we were able to deal with, and the place itself was pleasant to stay in.  Would recommend overall!
Wanted to leave my review, as the only lace was really good. Dmitrii’s place was really good and he was really helpful, and friendly. Highly recommended.

I cancelled this stay - which was planned for 8 days - after just one night because it was impossible to get any sleep in this place. Someone seems to have emptied several bottles of odor eliminator / room scent in the apartment, presumably to cover up unpleasant smells. However, the smell of the spray was so stingent that I had to leave all the windows open at all times, which made the place even noisier than it would have been any way (it's right next to a tram stop and busy road, windows don't hold back any noises).  Also, the bathroom floor was filthy with dust and particles as if it hadn't been cleaned at all. There is no trashcan and/or garbage bag to be found anywhere. The coffee maker had patina that looked like it hadn't been cleaned in ages, and also came with a full load of wet, smelly and presumably old coffee grounds in the filter.  All in all disgusting, uncomfortable and certainly not worth any of your money.

An excellent stay from start to finish. The apartment is in a fantastic location, very clean, and exceptionally well equipped with everything needed for a comfortable stay. It’s clear that a lot of care and attention to detail has gone into making this place welcoming and functional. I would highly recommend it to anyone visiting Zurich and would gladly return in the future.

My husband and I had a wonderful stay at Dylan’s place! The apartment was clean, comfortable, bright, spacious, and nicely decorated as well.  Having two full bathrooms was a luxury, and we appreciated the use of the washing machine/dryer. The kitchen seemed to have everything, but we didn’t cook during our stay. (The kitchen doesn’t have a microwave, which is unusual to an American, but apparently they are not so common in Switzerland.) There are also TWO big, beautiful patios to enjoy! Dylan kindly set up the air conditioner for us in the bedroom, which was very helpful during the hot spell we had. The main living area does not have A/C, but we learned to manage the heat as the Swiss do - by opening the windows in the morning and then closing them and the blinds against the midday heat. We chose to walk to & from Zurich station (easy 15 mins), but we took the tram for longer distances, and it was just a 5 min walk to the tram stop. Lovely and welcoming - we want to return!

Unfortunately, we experienced a number of issues with our stay here. The outside door buzzer did not automatically open the door as it should have. The area felt unsafe, particularly at night being located next to a cannabis shop, strip club and sex shop (erotic megastore). I would therefore, not recommend the location to families, nor solo female travellers. On our last night, we were approached aggressively by two men leaving the cannabis store and quickly entered the apartment to avoid them.  Apartment itself is small, but well equipped. The iron has a UK plug but the adapter provided does not fit the Swiss sockets. Noise is a real issue at night, with road noise seeping through and church bells which go off every 15 minutes, 24/7 - we found sleeping very difficult. Host provides code for keyless entry, this added to our anxiety as anyone with the code can enter the apartment. We found the host's communication very slow and in some cases, did not respond to our messages.
Can highly recommend for a short stay in Zurich, located in a quiet area with excellent public transportation connections.

We had a great stay at Franks appartment. Only 15/20 minutes from the centre on the tram with plenty of space for the 7 dancers of the Co. One bed had a problem but was delt with within the day. Would recommend this place to all and will be glad to use it again when we come back to Zurich. Thanks Frank & team.

I couldn’t get the key to the flat even on the next day. There was a problem with the lockbox, and I was messaging back and forth with support, but they said they couldn’t do anything, even the next morning (I spent the night elsewhere). I had to look for another place. The host refunded my reservation
Overall the place is great, very central and upscale neighborhood. The elevator was unfortunately broken during our stay

This ruined our 10yr anniversary. No review on property, since i never got access. 25min before my arrival I asked to inquire about the arrival and check-in instructions and thats when we were informed that the unit not available. No Reason given. We were offered a new upgraded property instead but when we arrived at the new property, There was no key in the lockbox to access the new property. We spent over 4 hrs with airB&B support and host (That was also a very nasty experience), at the end we had to pay high cost of stay at a nearby hotel. AirB&B gave full refund (As they should) and offered 20% of the total cost of stay toward next stay. Which by the way did not cover the total cost and we had to pay over 1K out of pocket. When you combine the cost of transport, the food and other costs. We were planning on cooking and saving cost, so that added significant cost. Overall very bad experience. I will not book this property or Host, and will reconsider other options instead Airb&B

There is a construction going on in the building next time this place, so the noise starts at 7am and you need to open windows because there is no AC, so the noise wakes you up and the floor gets dirty so fast because of the dust. The tram station is in front of this building so you can hear it at night and feel the vibration of the tramway. The bathroom’s curtain is falling on one side and it is dirty on the bottom, I recommend changing it.  The place is big enough and the towels smell so good!
Fair option for a stay in Zurich; flexible check in and timely communication with the host. Not super central but a 25 min walk from the city centre.  Would book again.

The apartment was good, but after checking out, the company has been creating false accusations about us checking out at 3pm and requested for money when we did not check out late at all, after closing that accusation, they had then brought up several things like missing mop and buckets and spatulas and had wanted to charge us even more money when in fact we had never even touch them! I think this company is scamming and i’ll be reporting them

The bed is not a bed, it‘s a couch with a bed function so it is not very confortable. The apartament is very small so I found it too expensive for it‘s size. The pictures arent all from the apartament but from places in Zürich that aren‘t even near there. I wanted this room just for transition to my new apartament. I could move in to my apartament 1 1/2 weeks earlier, when I talked to Marie about checking out early and working out an arragement so that neither of us looses money, she wan‘t flexible at all. I wanted to move early and offered to pay the full week if she could‘t find a new tenant, but if she was able to find someone new I would get my money back for the one week I wasn‘t there. Instead she wanted for me to pay the full amount but still cancel so that she could rent it to someone else and make double money.
The room is super spacious. There is a tram station right outside the apartment that takes you to downtown. The only problem is the lack of microwave and insufficient heat coming from radiator
Always available in case of any questions. Very good contact - couldn't be better. Great host.
Great space, super clean in a super convenient location

The flat itself was very good - the room was as described, the contact person was always reachable and helpful. The cleanliness and state of the place really depends on your roommates.  Certain things - if you want done you'll have to ask but the hosts will help.

Washroom had empty bodywash/shampoo bottles pr had very less quantity of toiletries considering we four people with one infant were guest Washroom had toilet paper inside the seat not sure if that was properly cleaned No kitchen cloth was available Garbage disposal point information was not shared When we tried to dispose in trash cans near the property exit, some resident started fighting us So overall it was not a pleasant experience  Informed host over msg but he choose not to respond or react

After a 12 hour road trip to Zurich with my pregnant wife, we unfortunately arrived to the apartment and the key was missing in an already opened lock box. After several messages at 9:30 pm in the app with no response we proceeded to call the host three times with the phone number the host listed. Still with no response, we texted that same number with yet again no response. After escalating this issue with Air BnB, the company was also unable to receive a response from the host after they tried for 30 more minutes. Air BnB apologized on the host's behalf and helped cover our last minute hotel reservation at midnight that was required due to the circumstances. We neither received a call back from the host nor a text back, but quickly after Air BnB cancelled the reservation at 12:30 am the host messaged us on the Air BnB app apologizing 🤔

Absolutely filthy. The bedsheet had a stain. The blankets and pillows feel like it has never been washed or changed because it caused allergic reactions to our faces and skin. There was a huge spider on the window beside the bed, which made us have a fear of it crawling on our faces at night during our sleep, so we slept on the sofa. The apartment is also too cold and has insufficient heating. We left after our second night and didn’t complete the entire stay. And the host is inconsiderate and refuses to even give a partial refund even with the knowledge that we have checked out and did not complete our stay. An absolute regret. It made our experience in Zurich a total nightmare.
Close to the lake and to public transportation-it will only take 5 Minutes via public transport to the old town
Thank you. Can recommend staying in this appartement.

My staying at the apartment was perfect. Big and spacious apartment, you can find so far everything you need to feel as home. The location is great since it’s in a very calm area and easy to reach by public transport. Thank you so much for everything I will definitely come back soon.

The AC unit did not work for our entirety of our stay. Our room was boiling! We requested the AC unit be fixed but they failed to do so. We then requested to be transferred to another room but they said they couldn’t do that either as all the rooms were occupied. The staff told us they would bring fans up to our room, but that never happened. Keep in mind, this is the middle of summer and temperatures are quite hot! Besides this, check-in was total chaos with extensive waiting. The front desk staff seemed totally overwhelmed. We were extremely disappointed with the entire experience. I would recommend you look elsewhere in Zurich even if the price is slightly higher!

Lina’s place was an exceptionally cozy stay while in Zurich. In a relatively busy area for night life her place is just far enough off the strip that you don’t hear or feel consumed by the evening’s revelry’s. She left loads of suggestions in regard to things to experience in the area, and was quick to respond to any inquiries that came up throughout the stay. 10 out of 10!

To say the entire ordeal with this host was atrocious would be an understatement! Please be WARNED NOT to stay at any location managed by this host! Not only did they receive a violation, but also lost their superhost status & rightfully so! They even failed to provide a trash bin in the bathroom so one could dispose off sanitary napkins! Not to mention that they expect trash to be thrown out before one leaves, which is a bit ridiculous considering the amount being charged for "cleaning"! The bed was NOT made! The pillows weren't even put properly! There was still laundry in both, the washer and the dryer! There was no soap or shampoo or anything except for some half used men's shower gel in the bathroom cabinet. There were no kitchen towels and there was a refilled bottle of water, eaten tub of ice cream & a mustard sachet in the dirty fridge/freezer that the host kept lying about and saying belonged to me when reported to Airbnb Support! Threatened, lied & harassed! Worst experience!

This place is clean and very central. You can walk to the city Center in 10 minutes and there is a market nearby to buy food. The communication with Antonio was easy and he is a nice person. Our experience was unfortunately not very good. The place smells like marijuana, there are no dark shade curtains and we had to wake up at 2:30am at night because the host came back little drunk and he had forgotten his keys. Also, the Wi-Fi connection is very bad; the rooter is too far away and the connection kept breaking up. The host said it is a temporary problem. Lastly, the mattress is very soft, it is like a sponge. In summary, the place is fine if you are staying a short time and it really didn’t give us a safe and comfy feeling.

This house needs a makeover. Kitchen, bathroom, doors are very outdated. Bathroom door didn’t close all the way. Kitchen cabinets slide all the way out and could fall out. Made manager aware at checkin that tea kettle was broken and they didn’t bother to bring a new one. Large bag of trash sat outside front door of the apartment for 3 days (our entire stay). Every time I pulled out “clean” dishes I had to check them because half the time they were actually very dirty. Just felt like we were staying in grandma’s empty apartment. Didn’t feel homey at all. Quiet location, clean and comfortable beds. But keep expectations low for this apartment

Only positive point: The property is very close to the tram station, which made getting around the city easy. The Issues Room Condition: The room was significantly smaller than expected and the floor felt sticky upon arrival. Maintenance: There were several functional issues- the bathroom light wasn’t working, and the toilet flush button was unreliable and often failed to work. Value & Policy: The checkout time felt unnecessarily early, adding to the inconvenience. Final Verdict: Between the lack of cleanliness and the maintenance problems, this stay was not worth the price. I would not recommend this property.

I would confirm if the construction is still going on before you book if possible. We stayed on a weekday and they were working next door starting at 8am, which made spending time in the space pretty difficult and was a bummer to wake up loud, constant drilling and hammering on our first morning in Zurich. I'm giving the stay 5 stars because I know they can't control it but I would hate for someone who wanted to sleep in or had kids who needed to nap, etc. to have to discover this after they booked.
Everything went well with our visit. The bed is maybe little smallish for two person. The tram takes you fast to the center if needed.

Clean place, convenient location, small and practical. One downside: Only source of fresh air is opening the window but there are constantly people smoking outside, so I would not recommend leaving the window open for longer periods, i.E. at night.

The host gave me the wrong address, which caused a lot of inconvenience. They promised compensation, but I never received anything. Additionally, I was charged a 250 CHF deposit that was never returned.

I will start with the pros I do think this is great for female solo travelers that want the option of not dealing with men and the terrace and breakfast were nice.  For the bad- I was not able to check in as the QR code I was sent kept having errors, the number on file did not work and I never heard back from the host when messaging. I was able to get into the place because two girls happened to be coming out and gave me the right number to call as there is no staff after 3pm I believe. When I did get a hold of someone it was a male which I found odd for a female only hotel. I will say the next day the receptionist was nice but I was not able to get into the hotel for a while and the host really did not seem to care as I STILL have not heard back from her.
Beautiful, beautiful place. And huge! Perfect spot for a Zurich visit with multiple friends or a big family

simple studio, good location in Zürich. its Close to everything . i did checking in myself with the host directions and easy communication with Alex. there are little insatisfactions but I'm easy-going = I accepted the fact that a rent place is always different to my home. = i am careful with the critics only when its exaggerated.... it wasn't the case. thank you Alex.

The water temp is messed up. It changed from normal to scalding hot to ice cold automatically while bathing causing me to fall down and having an accident one day before the checkout. The cleaning is useless. Dishes were all dirty. Kettle was soapy and unusable. Toaster had previously used bread piece and crumbs and was broken partially.  Quality of furniture is bad. Coffee table was rickety. Bed was creaking a lot making it difficult. Amenities were inconsiderate. Seating space was only for 4 people in living room. Kitchen was full of old and bad smelling nearly finished random oils. No basic amenities provided like bathing soaps/wash, machine detergent, kitchen towel, etc. Flooring is in bad condition. Balcony door was broken which got fixed after 2 days of back and forth. Toaster broken and kitchen unclean. Half the time spent on chatting with the team on these issues. No peace of mind. Did not enjoy at all. Could have called and discussed. Needs lot of work. Ruined 4 days vacation.

While the Airbnb itself wasn’t bad it is advertised as having a parking space  Construction next door completely blocked the driveway prohibiting us from parking in the advertised spot  There is no street parking and nowhere to put a car here while construction is going on  I picked this Airbnb out of the city center because it had a parking spot readily available as I was with my small baby and elderly mother  who can’t walk far  When we were allowed to park briefly, Construction also told us if we weren’t out permanently at 6 in the morning they would block us in the parking lot all day  When I told the host they offered no solutions and just said there was nothing they could do so we had to check out extremely early  Construction was going on at all hours and was extremely disruptive
Cosy place with all the things you need. Good base for walking down to the lake.  Floors are very squeaky which is only a  problem if you need to move around at night.

The apartment was 100% but the host was 10%. Very inconsiderate and not polite. She promised to send entry password by 3pm but sent it by 3:30pm after much reminder. Made me stand at the entry for almost 30mins. Went in summer the apartment was very hot, sent Nicole a message if she could  help with a fan as there was no cooling system, she read my message and ignored me. It was hard to sleep at night. In summary a perfect and beautiful apartment but a terrible host.

We had a wonderful stay! The place was exactly as described- clean and cozy. The host was kind, responsive and made sure we had everything we needed throughout our visit. Highly recommend for a stress-free stay.
A clean and convenient place.  From the airport, get off at the Tiefenbrunnen stop, which is 2 stops on the S16 train AFTER  the Zurich main hub.
Great stay. Not super close to the city center, but close to both trams and a train stop.

I didn’t end up staying and booked myself a hotel instead. Being a solo traveller I felt taken aback when the apartment was on the ground floor despite the photos not showing that, and there was only see through net curtains which left me feeling vulnerable as people could see in. There was also an overwhelming smell of cigarette smoke that gave me a headache and I had to remove the bin from the apartment for the short time I was in there. There were hairs left in the bathtub, in the sink and on the bed pillows.  Air BnB kindly stepped in to sort out a partial refund for me as the host refused to refund and only offered alternative accommodation for one night of my two night stay which was on the complete wrong side of Zurich to where I had to be for a very important meeting the next day. If you’re travelling solo or tend to get anxious/stressed, I would stay away from here in case you also get something less than what you paid for

The room is very clean.Most rooms in Europe have queen beds, but we are mother and son, so two beds were more convenient for us. There is a supermarket 2 minutes walk away and the food prices are very reasonable.

Turan helped me with all the details to reach the location, was very helpful during checkin. But host was not very friendly and didn't provide lot of details regarding the sight seeing. Also the room was not great, all the rooms in the house was well maintained and good looking but the provided room was like a dumping place, it has lot of unused items in the berth and cupboard. It can be a good place for bachelor, but was not a great choice for family.
* hard to get in * lots of noise from 6am right underneath and on the street * no washing machine * broken dishwasher (was not announced)

The room itself was modern and spacious but the area was incredibly noisy. There is a bar/club opposite the road that blasted music until 6am, cars honking non stop and patrons loitering around outside yelling and carrying on. Also no soundproofing on the walls/windows so we were able to hear everything making it impossible to sleep.
centrally located studio and at ground floor in a quiet,residential.Good choice for the senior citizen tourists.
I was not aware of the painting work in the building. It was a chemical smell during working hours. It was not comfortable due to painting work in the building and elevator.

Bandula’s place is absolutely perfect for a solo traveler. Not only was the location just a 10 minute walk from the station but it was very close to the main shopping street. The location was so great I didn’t even use any of the public transport, I walked everywhere. The surrounding area was lively and felt safe. There’s an Aldi and a Coop to Go nearby which helps if you’d like to cook or buy some snacks or a quick bite for breakfast. His kitchen had everything I needed. Zurich was having a few hot days and so Bandula provided me with a fan. He met me right on time and answered any messages as quickly as I sent them. Thank you for the great stay!

Stay away from this place! And anything that is hosted by these people. After being on a flight 11 hours to get to Switzerland and then waiting another 5 hours for their check in time. I was told that if I wanted to expedite the check in process was gonna be extra charges. I refused and checked in at their regular time with my mother and girlfriend. When I walked into the apartment no one cleaned it and the last guest was still roaming around claiming to have forgotten things inside the apartment. Trash everywhere. Cigarette butts and smell. The whole place was trashed. I tried contacting to know what was going to happen and I was contacted to an automated system that said “We are connecting you to an agent please wait” after waiting for another hour, I contacted the Airbnb staff for a refund and relocation. Disgusting behavior, horrible service. Super bad experience for someone who was visiting Switzerland for the first time. Thankfully I rented a car so I could shelter while I waited

This is the one of the worst airbnb I have been to since my registration on the platform. At the start I read "studio" and I assumed its gonna be 20-25m2 which is ok, but its way smaller than a prison cell-14m2. I also checked the price for hotel near by- it was the same price and way bigger+breakfast+cleaning included, I think the price for it isnt normal- above CHF 228 per m² per month what is 5.8 times higher than average market rate for long term and 2–3× more per square meter than a typical short term rentals. There was also some kind of insects living there too, there was no washing machine, ironer didnt go inside the power outlet, no vaccum cleaner, bed was so tough it felt like sleeping on floor-there was nothing. Its definetly not recommended for long-term stays for sure. Ussually I have 99.9% positive experiences on this platform-but this definetly not it.
Very nice place but only room and the bathroom are available

I’ve never left a bad review on Airbnb until now. When I arrived and tried to sleep, I quickly realized the mattress was incredibly thin like a price of foam , and the pillows weren’t proper sleeping pillows — they felt more like couch cushions that where years old and had nothing inside of them. After just one night, I was in so much pain that I had to see a physio because the mattress had caused serious strain on my back. I explained this to the host and asked to check out early so I could find a place with a proper mattress (as I’ve always had in other Airbnbs), but he dismissed it as a personal issue and refused to let me leave without penalty. He also said the pillows were all they had and showed no concern at all. I would never recommend staying here. The lack of basic comfort and the host’s careless attitude made this a terrible experience

The apartment is located in the centre of Zurich and it is very near to restaurants, shops and historical centre. The apartment is clean and contains moderately equipped kitchen, bathroom and living room. However, in the night it is little noisy at night from the busy street and the parking house is nearby, but expensive.
Very professionally run place, all was in order

After my host was late two hours I received keys for a different flat from the one I booked, with the excuse it was overbooked. So I can’t really give any details about this property. I was not happy with the one I stayed in.

It was a mistake staying here. The apartment is completely barren—there are virtually no amenities provided. You’re lucky if there’s even toilet paper. There’s a coffee machine with no coffee, a laundry unit with no detergent, and barely any functional furniture. The kitchen, bedroom, and bathroom all feel empty and poorly equipped, with no sense of hospitality or care for the guest experience. The bathroom setup is especially impractical: there are no hooks, shelves, or surfaces to place toiletries. I had to put everything on top of the toilet while showering, which is both inconvenient and unhygienic. Small but essential details like this make a huge difference, and they are entirely overlooked here. The pillows are extremely uncomfortable—honestly some of the worst I’ve experienced—and the blinds do not block out sunlight, making it difficult to sleep. On top of that, the building itself is chaotic and far from quiet. The walls are paper thin, so you hear everything: people in th

Our stay was disappointing. We booked two nights but decided to leave after just one night with no refund. The accommodation was way smaller than expected, and it had no TV. The kitchen was poorly equipped, with only basic dishes, a small pot, and a pan provided. One major issue revolved around the host's misleading representation of parking. The listing featured a photo of a parking garage, giving us the impression of available parking space. However, upon arrival, we discovered there was no parking space available. When we raised this concern with the host, they promptly removed the parking photo from the listing and argued that they had never made any claims about parking. When we inquired about the possibility of staying for just one night and receiving a refund for the second night, the host consistently evaded the question and never provided a clear response. After multiple attempts, we eventually gave up on this issue. They later claimed they would have refunded us, what a joke.
Great place, clean and big and well located, great value!

The apartment was in good shape. Both bedrooms were comfortable, and we appreciated that the second bedroom had three beds.  The apartment is also decorated nicely and the kitchen has a dishwasher and washing machine. The apartment provides soap/shampoo (no hooks for towels). The location was convenient, close to trams and trains.   The apartment was unfortunately not ready at 3pm for check-in, so we waited until 3:20pm (they were unexpectedly short-staffed).  We would have appreciated a heads-up that they were running late. Unfortunately, the apartment is across from an extremely loud construction site and drilling began each morning at 7am. This was out of the owner's control but had we been warned we would have found a different location (we asked to move apartments but were told there were none). The noise/dust made the stay very unpleasant.  The apartment is above a cafe. There is noise and second-hand shisha smoke that enters the apartment, but this we knew about in advance.
it was written that appartment have laundry bat every time when you wanna use you need to pay extra 2,5 chf . bad very uncomfortable

As a paying guest, it felt awkward when the host was home all day; we felt uncomfortable to make any noise whatsoever in case we interrupted the host. Also, the room provided was well below what we expected for the price we paid for the two night stay. A bar fridge would also be beneficial in the guest room.  The hosts were very friendly though.

Wonderful stay in Zurich My family had a fantastic stay at Alex cozy and well appointed place in Zurich. The location is incredible convenient, just 14 min from Zurich ZB (main station) with excellent access to public transportation, making it easy to explore the city and beyond.
