The neighborhood is charming and well-served, with coffee shops and grocery stores just a short walk away. Whether you are grabbing a morning coffee or picking up essentials, everything you need is close at hand. The apartment itself was clean, comfortable, and had everything I needed for relaxing stay. What truly made the experience exceptional was Alex, responsiveness and always ready to help with any questions or recommendations. Highly recommend place for a 5 night vacation  in Zurich!!!!

The apartment was very pretty and well equipped but the walls were too thin, Daniel and the neighbours seemed to have an issue with the noise even though we were speaking at very low volumes. Moreover, Daniel’s tone on text was rude and intrusive, we did not appreciate that.
It was great and I would book it again :)
This place is a gem, and so is James!  He made us feel so comfortable and we had everything we need!  The apartment is spacious, bright and close to everything!  Can’t wait to go back to visit!

The location is in a boring place, far from the interesting parts of Zurich. Building is old, so you can hear the neighbors loud music and smelly cooking. The place is big though. Also kitchen appliances were faulty: kettle didn't work and would make the whole apartment electricity fail. I wasted 1 hour realizing how to fix it. Marc or his property mangers were totally inconsiderate with the early check-in and late check-out, despite the fact that the property was vacant after my stay. He claimed the cleaner could only come at 11am, but I stayed nearby and the cleaner came at 2pm. Just because he/they didn't want to coordinate the late check-out Overall, quite a bad experience. I wouldn't come to Marc's apartment again.

The host is nice, responded to everything patiently and also gave us early check in at 1 p.m. but the place itself is not worth the effort of booking it or the money. It’d be better to book a hotel even if it is a little more expensive. The place is too shockingly small. Impractical for 3 adults or even 2. It was an unpleasant experience for the lack of space and amenities. The location is good as it is close to the main station. Unfortunately it was a non refundable booking, I’d have liked to cancel the booking after seeing how small the place is.

Had it not been for the cleanliness issues this place would have been good - There was a big brown stain on the bedroom sheets and when we lifted the cover to try and cover it to sleep over the stain there were multiple flying ants roaming around on the bed. My boyfriend and I ended up staying up half the night trying to kill them all, there were probably over 25 or 30 total.
Our stay at Cibzia's place was comfortable and pleasant. There's a nice backyard and the location is central. The communication with her was always easy and we had great time in Zürich.

had issues with the wifi and asked the host kindly for advice. tried to reset the modem but still didn‘t work. next day the host just shows up in front of the apartment door of the airbnb and just starts to spam the door bell and expects me to let him in. i let him in to try and fix the wifi and he was insanely rude. definitely didn‘t feel secure around him - i had a feeling that he could have snapped any minute. he checked the wifi next to the router instead of the office and claims it works. i ask him to check the wifi in the office himself and he actually figured it was terrible. left the airbnb 2 days prior to checkout to get into a different airbnb. terrible host, can‘t recommend. you should be ashamed of yourself

The apartment is well-located in the historical centre with easy access to public transport and supermarkets. The space: clean and very quiet, the bed comfortable. No products to clean.  Our experience was marred by operational issues. Check-in was problematic: the PIN code didn't work, and when we called to ask how to get in, we were instructed to reach through the hole in the lockbox to retrieve an envelope with the key. This felt unprofessional and concerning. We reported two issues upon arrival: the sofa's electric controls only worked on one side (missing adaptor on right side), and the TV box was malfunctioning. While the host, co-host, or property management (?) (never sure who I was speaking with) responded, our accurate technical descriptions were questioned. A technician was supposedly arranged, but neither issue was resolved during our stay. We were told repairs would happen "after departure," which doesn't help current guests paying for full functionality.

Irene's place was convenient to the Oerlikon station which is one stop from the airport an done stop to the main Zurich station.  Irene didn't seem prepared for our stay though.  Our room was ready, but her laundry was blocking the front door making it hard to get in and out of her apartment.  Also after traveling for 18+hours, we were hoping to use the bathroom to freshen up, but Irene was in there for the first 20 minutes after we arrived.

When i arrived in the appartement, it wasn't ready even though it was about 8pm on a sunday. It was dirty and messy and first i thought it got broken into.  They helped me to change the appartement but even the other one wasn't properly clean. For extra cleaning with changing the bedsheet it was around 400CHF. what we didn't do at the end cause of the insane price.  we stayed there for over 2 weeks and the heating wouldn't work. Someone came to "fix" it but it didn't help. i contacted them over and over again and only got a reply on the last night.  The appartement itself is beautiful, so it was a shame that we didn't like to stay there because it was freezing.
Location is amazing direct train from the airport, stones throw from the lake. Lovely neighborhood. Apartment is clean and bright. Karolina is very communicative and thoughtful.
Did not have simple internet access. Need to cancel and only got 1 day back. Not worth it.

Overall a terrible experience  1. When we moved into the house Wifi was not working, after reaching to host it was fixed after 2 hours 2. Pedestal Fans in the house were not working and making loud clanking sounds when turned on. 3. TV not working (no sound) and wires were hanging from TV , creating a lot of electrical risk 4. Only Bathroom had drainage clogged with water spilling out and leaking into apartment below. They come upstairs to complain. 5. After repeated requests and reaching out to Airbnb support they sent a handyman at midnight who poured some liquid into drain with created lot of fumes. We could not use the bathroom and requested Airbnb to step in. 6. Airbnb informed us early next morning that host has agreed to allow us to leave, could not find a alternative quickly and stayed out of the house most of the next day before moving out to a hotel.  Requesting refund due to horrible experience
The location is nice, a bit noisy for the train, but convenient to move arround

The apartment was exactly like the pictures, and clean, with all utilities that i needed. It took me some time to get the key, as i arrived much later than i had planned, but this was sorted out without any problem. My experience was not 100%, as my apartment was very noisy: my apartment was on the ground floor right on the busy street, and in addition the walls to the neighboring apartment were very thin, which meant i could hear almost everything that happened at the neighbours: dishwashing, tv.

Kim and his wife were such lovely, helpful hosts. I immediately felt like I had been welcomed into their home The apartment was absolutely perfect. It was comfortable, spotless, warm and had everything you needed. The position was ideal. Close to the city center without being right in it. Supermarket was next door, transport was next door, shops, restaurants and the river were next door! After freezing watching the fireworks outside on New Year's Eve we returned to the apartment to find we could see them from the living room window. What a bonus. The family absolutely loved Zurich and I put that down to such perfect accomodation. Thank you so much.
I stayed at rosanna's place for three months and would really really recommend it. Great house, great atmosphere, you have anything you need!

When I told them there was a man urinating in front of front door all over the entrance their response was so what it’s the city!  I explained i know it’s the city but you should know what’s happening at the entrance of your place. I was expecting him to say I’ll send maintenance to disinfect but nothing of the kind happened.  Although I called a couple of times to ask specific questions no one would answer just a text 1 hour later.  This is the first time I have left a 3 star review in more than 50 airbnb over the last 8 years.

I am left with no option but a bad review. Things started poorly when after a day of travel we arrived and my wife needing the bathroom, found the toilet seat was both broken and dislodged. What’s more it had been used and not flushed!  As there were 5 of us in a place for 9, I communicated the problem with the hosts.  As we acquainted ourselves with the space, we discovered that not all the bedding and towels were provided. I communicated this. We were staying 4 days in July so I asked about extra towels too.  Eventually, 1 of the partners replied, however the reply was very disappointing. No apology, or acknowledgment of the issues, just a promise of a new seat the next day and minimum items to be brought that night. It’s a Corporate arrangement, the WiFi only works downstairs, not in bedrooms, we felt unwelcome. The minimum is offer and those items the very basic. We felt unwelcome and exploited. For the price it’s neither worth it or supportive of an Airbnb standard.

As the listing states, this location is right by the train station. During the day, there is a lot of traffic in the area and trains that you can see from the windows. At night, there is significantly less noise. There are a few lounges at the street level open until 2 or 5 am (depending on the day), however, we did not hear them on the Monday or Tuesday night we were there. The unit is quite spacious and looks the same as the pictures. Floor heating can be turned on and works quite well. There is a grocery store with a few minutes, walking. The listing does state there is no elevator. The unit is on the 2nd floor, so you do need to go up from ground level to 1, then to 2 on a wide, winding staircase.

Unfortunately, my experience staying in this apartment was extremely negative. During my stay, a large amount of cash disappeared from my bag, which was inside the apartment. When I later checked the bag, the inner pocket was open and the money was gone. Only the cash from the bag inside the apartment disappeared. After that, I contacted the police. A criminal case was opened and an investigation was started. What concerned me the most was that I never received a clear answer about who had access to the apartment while I was away. In a situation where money disappears from inside an apartment, security becomes the main concern. I no longer felt safe staying in this apartment. I cannot recommend this accommodation. For me, it was a very stressful and unpleasant experience involving missing money inside the apartment and having to contact the police afterwards.
This was a great place to stay in Zurich. About a 10-20 min tram ride to downtown. And a 1-2 min walk to the tram station. Would stay again.

We absolutely loved the place. It was clean and very welcoming.  The instructions were clear on how to get to the apartment, key location. Once into the flat, it had everything we needed for our stay. We just loved the place. A heartfelt thanks to Alexandros and his fantastic team. One thing to mention, I had an issue with the wifi, it was quite early when I messaged, I least expected an immediate response, but i was wrong,  I got an immediate response and remedy for my problem. I was mighty impressed.

Ann's place is Ok. But smells deeply of cigarettes, has 9/11 wall sized terrorist imagery on the dining room walls that she'll admonish you for trying to avoid during your stay, located far from everything interesting. She then tried to charge for a lamp that was never used a week after check-out, an amplification of the negative experience. When you bring some of the more sensitive aspects to her attention, her communication is "it's my house, deal with it." I've loved almost all of my 100s of Airbnb experiences, but if you're looking for an aware "host" with sensibilities toward her guests' experience, beware. Honestly. Not good.
Just as expected, very clean. Sofa bed was a bit uncomfortable and no air conditioning but the fans helped.

Honestly, I wanted to give 1/5 for this place but it was really a pleasant stay with them until i checked out. Basically, we arrived on day 1 at 845pm as we were coming from France. Someone checked us in, requested to take a photo of my credit card for “accidental” damages. I found it suspicious but just proceeded as we were tired from the train ride. Before sleeping realised kettle was spoilt and informed and they replaced it. Fast forward to checking out, while I was on the flight. The host requested damage reimbursement from me for their dining table having a huge crack. Which it wasnt caused by us as we used it normally and barely tbh.  They insisted that the huge crack was by us which we totally didnt noticed upon checking in.  Am I suppose to do a house audit before I sleep? Ridiculous. If I knew this would have happened, I will check every spot of the house right?  For anyone that is going to book a stay with them beware if they use this table for accidental damage charges.

Jules' place is located in a nice neighborhood and Jules is a good communicator. The apartment building is nice, but our biggest complaint is that the apartment looked messy and like it hadn't been cleaned before we arrived. The linens looked questionable and the general appearance made us wonder if anyone had just slept there without it being cleaned afterwards.
The place is clean. Very close to the airport. But there was no tissues for use, we had to buy it in the supermarket.

The stay was okay for a family of five but there were quite a few problems that we are not satisfied about. First of all, the air dryer is basically broken as it is super loud and it smells like burnt when u are using it. Second, the WiFi connection was really poor in the flat, especially in the living room and kitchen as it was only one signal sign. Thirdly, there were no coffee capsules besides the coffee machine and tissues in the flat at all.

Great location. Large studio. Adequately equipped kitchen but no microwave. Dimi acknowledged our queries but service was lacking. Booked Art 9 but was given Art 7, bizarre. Shower cubicle was inconveniently small (no photo posted on Air BnB) with ineffective shower curtain. Hence very wet floor. Needed extra bath mats to absorb the water. Host did not mop the floor despite requesting. No towel rack to dry bath towel. Inadequate clothes hangers. Just 4 plus 1 broken, insufficient for 2 pax. Whilst more were subsequently delivered, they were dusty. Requested extra pillow for my leg injury (only 1 per pax provided) but unable to provide. Confusing communication as in one of his replies, host was glad to hear the cutting board & coat hanger in good order. Message obviously meant for another tenant/apt. Whilst the aforementioned issues not too serious in isolation, in totality it was an inconvenient experience. Sincerely hope host will improve upon these shortcomings for future tenants.

We stayed 5 nights. The bear minimum but practical flat in a good location. The flat is facing street (host said facing courtyard) across from a playground. It was quite except weekend. The flat was generally clean but the floor was sticky stains and dusty. A small elevator & free laundry were plus.  We gave 3 stars because it was the most frustrating air bnb experience.  The host was responsive but  didn’t not know the unit. Missing dishwasher and microwave. 1st day wifi didn’t work. No cable TV connection. Back and forth with host we tried what he asked but no cable tv during our stay. 3rd day, the shower curtain fell off. It was not properly installed- no brackets on the wall to hold it. It was kept falling off. Host asked to buy the rod from Coop because he is out of town. We don’t know German, it was impossible. We didn’t want to spend our vacation on it. The cleaning lady put it up but we were scared to touch it. It was stressful stay. Too much time back and forth with the host.

Place was immaculate. Stylish. Finding apartment building is a little tricky. The door is not on the street. It behind the furniture store. Go down the driveway where the World Wildlife Fund panda sign is and then it’s to the right.

Dominique has made traveling to Zürich a breeze! Pros: near town, spacious, and fairly priced. The Airbnb is very spacious, clean and near downtown. Best part is the tram stop is about a 3 minute walk and will take you to most places with a transfer or two! Hot water is great and water pressure in shower is solid. Cons: lack of blankets/comforters, slow wifi, stomp happy neighbors upstairs, no locks, uncomfortable beds. The lack of comforters and blankets was disappointing. I like to be layered in blankets and most airbnbs/hotels ive been to have an extra in the closet just in case. Not an absolute deal break but did want to note that for those that have similar thoughts on this. The wifi is rather slow even while watching netflix in the living room. Lags, cuts out and isnt reliable overall. Neighbors up above stomp their feet occasionally. Not sure if its a child but its happened a few times but thankfully not all the time. There arent any locks on the doors. No locks on bedroom, bathroom or even the toilet. Not a deal break again but keep this in mind if you have more than 2 people staying! The smaller room with twin beds have extremely firm beds which were uncomfortable for me. I experienced soreness and back aches because of it. Please keep this in mind if you do not enjoy firm beds. Overall, I really this airbnb is a hidden gem that hit my overall check list. I would stay here again if i ever come back to Zürich!
Had a great stay at the property. Great location and easy to commute.
Well maintained Apartment except for the Status, it was difficult to claim five floors with Kids and Bagagen

The shower was with a bad smell - specifically the curtains. The kitchen sponge wasn’t good enough. I really recommend to have I new one for each guest. At some point I was disgusted to washing the platters specially in the bathroom sink.  The mattress was very soft. I think it was two single mattress together pretending to be a double. After two days my back was painful.  The view it’s really nice and very good location- it’s so convenient.

A wonderful stay just a few minutes from the center of Zurich. The apartment is beautifully designed, very comfortable, and furnished to a high standard throughout. It’s an excellent choice for anyone visiting Zurich, and I would gladly stay here again for a few days.

I had a problem with the room as it was too smelly, I stayed there for just 2 days and then I had to book something else, the smell was very bad. The host used some product for the floor. The host was very nice, she came by to see what was about unfortunately she could not do anything so I had to leave. A part that the room was almost ok, please be aware that the bathroom has no sink so you have to use the one in the kitchen and the bathroom door doesn't closes.

Overall the apartment was ok. But description is not much on Yann’s place . No electric fan,can’t use the washing machine. Pillows are uncomfortable and old. Bedsheets,Duvet covers , towels needs upgraded .

A gorgeous flat in a lovely location! So many restaurants and bars and cafes to choose from.  Delia was kind and responsive.  The flat was spacious and clean and overall lovely.  Would absolutely stay again!  Thank you!
Josefine was such an amazing host with such a perfect place for my solo trip! She provided me with everything I needed, and was always kind and helpful. Would definitely recommend staying here!

I had Room #1 and it was indeed a big room. Towels and bed linens were as described. The area called Seefeld was very quiet at night which I found incredibly awesome since the location is in the city.  The apartment is just blocks from the lake. There is a Migros grocery store a block away in addition to tram and bus stops. The stop is called Kreuzplatz
WiFi was not working and this makes it hard because the cell towers don't transmit inside.  Had to stand outside to make phone calls
I’ve stayed at Giancarlo’s places previously and they’ve all lived up to expectations.  I would not hesitate to recommend any of the locations that he manages.

When we arrived, the fridge was broken. We could not buy food in the supermarket during our stay. She tried to send someone to fix it, but we didn't know in advance and didn't have time to see her message allowing the person to enter the apartment. In the end, the fridge was broken all week.  She also sends too many messages every day, asking unnecessary questions and it is a bit annoying.  And in the end she even threatened us with a fine of 20Fr if we didn't take a picture showing that we were leaving a power adapter in the apartment, which I found a bit disrespectful, given that we've been without a fridge for a week. I needed to search for the adapter that I didn’t even use, in order to make a picture, proving that I was leaving it there. Because according to her message, if she didn’t find it and I didn’t have a picture to prove that I left it there I could face the fine.  Never again!
all immaculate and everytime I come again there is always something new of variety of goods in fridge and table

The location is convenient and check-in was easy, but the room is very poorly equipped, there’s essentially just a bed, and even a small table is missing. The bathroom is extremely small and uncomfortable. Overall, the space feels incomplete and not well thought out. While the price is lower than other options, the lack of basic amenities significantly affects the stay.

This place smells, is dirty, has no air conditioning, is in the worst location, overall would not stay here if I was getting paid to. would not accommodate late checkout when desperate. we were 5 minutes late for checkout the worker told us she wasn’t sure if we could still get out belongings out of the room and we have to check if the room key still work. DONT STAY HERE

It’s a big room with not much in it. 2 low beds, 2 chairs, a table,  couch  & 2 hangers, on a weird contraption, to hang stuff. Which means your stuff is lying on the dusty floor. If the door is open, the cats simply walk in & climb on your clothes. You don’t even get a bin. All you get is a long list of what kind of garbage goes in which colour plastic bag in the balcony. Which means even to throw a piece of paper, you have to go out in the balcony.  No proper lighting in the room.  Kitchen is much smaller than the pictures. I didn’t bother going in the living room, so don’t know if the TV was available to watch. Room is about 7-10 minutes walk to the nearest Tram station & 15-20 minutes to restaurants. You have to take the tram everywhere. You’re asked not to switch on the bathroom light after 11, you can easily trip while going to the toilet in the night. Overall I didn’t feel very comfortable there. Having said that, whatever little interaction I had with the host was pleasant.
The place was fine, but a bit smaller than expected

This is not a review of the property but a review of the airbnb  experience. we could not enter the appartement at our arrival because the keys were stolen apparently from the locker box. of course this is not the hosts fault but I think some things could have been done in order to prevent this.  the biggest problem was actually the airbnb management of the problem.  we had to call 3 different assistants , 2 hours waiting for a solution. what s the meaning of paying taxes to airbnb as a client /host if they can not cover this kind of situation?  in this kind of situation airbnb should be able to find you immediately a similar appartement no matter the price and the platform. it was not the case. after 2 hours argue, we got a refund a coupon and we had to look an appartement by ourselves.  overall very bad experience, airbnb will definitely be the last resort for booking from now on
Fantastically convenient location, and Giancarlo was very responsive to some initial problems and sorted them rapidly.

This is a lovely place with plenty of room to spread out in a fabulous location! Highly recommend for a visit to Zurich. Located in a walkable area with restaurants, shops and right near transportation making it easy to get around the city!!

We really enjoyed our stay in this apartment. Great location near the lake and trams also...silence during the night and calm during the whole day. The apartment was very cosy and we feel comfortable there. It has everything what we need during our 5day stay in Zurich.  Thanks goes to kind hosts 🫶 see u next time 🖤
Overall the stay was good but there were no toiletries in washroom.  Washing machine is in the common area. Mattress was very uncomfortable.
Rob was a very responsive host and his place felt quite cosy!
Their place is amazing! Super accommodating and kind, warm, easy going. Couldn’t ask for a better host. Thank you! Big recommend

Not worth the money. I'd like to emphasize the following: - The flat stinks with tabacco smell, from the moment I entered it. And even though I always ventilated the space during the day, it never disappeared - Space not well cleaned: your socks get dirty the moment you put your shoes in the floor and take few steps - There was no shampoo, even though it was described in the comodities - The oven didn't work at all - Very little cuttlery (for examplo, you only have 2 spoons) - Far away from the city centre (35min walk) - There are no containers for food storage - There's no washing machine The only good thing I can say about the flat is that it is located in a quiet neighbourhood.

Location was good.  Check in was good.  No house manual for instructions, or check out requirements, no hair dryer (one was brought to the unit) coffee maker plug not compatible with wall receptacles, dirty glasses in dirty cupboards, really stained pillow, sheets and headboard.  No black out shades, work area, fire extinguisher, first aid kit as described in listing, there is only one plug in the bathroom that is 4” from the ceiling.  You have to stand on the toilet to plug anything in, broken toilet tank lid, dirty shades, dirty furniture. I have photos to back up all of these deficiencies.  No mention the unit is on the second floor with steep stairs or that the unit is above a noisy bar.   It’s a good thing that sheets and towels were left in the washer and dryer as we used them to cover up the pillows, sheets and headboard. The unit was left cleaner than when we arrived.   Unfortunately this unit did not meet Airbnb’s standards nor ours.

This place is a step above a hostel. It lacks the coziness that I am used to, but it is probably because this place is only used for Airbnb. By coziness, I’m referring to the basic amenities that one expects when staying in someone’s home as a guest.  There was no hand soap in the restroom-something that I consider a basic amenity. We were left having to use dish washing soap in the interim. The bed was also extremely uncomfortable.  The only reason I didn’t rate it any lower is because it is centrally located and within walking distance to everything. I’m just not sure if sacrificing my comfort was worth staying here.

I have used Airbnb eight times, this apartment was rated #2 by my family! Also, for the location the price was reasonable, considering Zurich is one of the most expensive places I have stayed in Europe.

5 rooms for one bathroom, too much; moreover, the fact that the bathroom was not cleaned regularly (never) made the situation worse, full of plants and insects. Too many rules, the kitchen cannot be used, no shoes in the house. Good location and below average price,
Very nice apartment, really recommend it, easy and very clean apartment, very modern and has everything I needed

Check-in was difficult. The host (place is owned by a corporation) did not proactively communicate that the apartment was not ready or cleaned, which was stressful and initially made me worry the booking might not be legitimate. I was eventually moved into a different unit. The building smelled strongly of cigarette smoke. Noise was also an issue—there was frequent loud music from an upstairs neighbor, and the street and surrounding area were loud as well. At times, the neighborhood vibe felt uncomfortable.

I appreciated the early check-in, which was helpful. Unfortunately, my experience was very uncomfortable due to the host’s behavior. The apartment is in a multi-unit building on an upper floor, but the exact floor was unclear. When I asked which floor to go to, the host urged me to come quickly but later reprimanded me for not “acting like I already knew her,” which was confusing. She repeatedly instructed me not to mention Airbnb and to pretend I already knew her, making me uneasy. I was not happy about being asked to lie that I already know her and maintain secrecy about Airbnb. Basic questions about keys were met with condescension, profanity by the host, and raised voices. Communication felt confrontational, and she even asked me to leave shortly after check-in, but she did not cancel the reservation. I stayed quietly and checked out after two nights. Due to the aggressive, confrontational, and uncomfortable behavior, I would not stay here again or recommend this listing to others.

The location of this place is great, close to public transport and close to the city. However, there are too many house rules and the house is not very clean (it did not get cleaned a single time in the 6 weeks I was staying there, except for the room which got cleaned once at the start of my stay). Most importantly though, the bed is not good. It is a double bedframe but only has a single and very thin mattress and the duvet doesn't fit the cover. If you open the window it is quite noisy because of the traffic, but with the window closed it is quiet. I would not recommend this for a long stay, as I found it hard to get proper sleep with the bed.

5 stars for each the supporting and the cleaning teams.  5 stars for Zurich.  Below 0 for the premises – subprime* premises for or a prime price. Cheap and already in a slightly trashy state. Cheaply 'equipped', or not at all – mostly you'll find nothing where ever you look for even most basis things. An old water damage in the kitchen, slightly stinking already (you'll get wet feet..). Apparently, the proprietors cannot care less.  Very disappointing. And no, we do not like to write negative reviews. _________ *'subprime' is a Wall Street euphemism for 'junk' (Allan Sloan, editor at large, Fortune/CNN)
The home was the one advertised, overall still good, but a bit dirty. No issues with the neighbours and the location os pretty chill
It was a nice stay. Very clean and fast answering :)
Check in during after office hours means you must be prepared for the worst as the helpline was not being answered
Nice location. Close to the center of Zürich. But it is a little noisy at night because there is a bar at first floor

Itamar was great! Super communicative and helpful. Let us check in a little early since the room was ready which was super helpful. Very nice location, right next to restaurants and grocery stores. Very close to the tram/bus station. Super quiet area. Was a Little warm in the room due to it being summer, but we were able to open the windows to get a nice breeze. Would stay again.

Mario’s place is located very close to the central part of Zurich, we walked everything by foot. Mario was fast to communicate although we found we had to message him frequently due to issues. We felt like we needed to do the legwork as guests. The keys were collected from a different location, you have to instal your own blinds otherwise you’re totally exposed, we had to ask where the guess towels were and I touched wet used towels under the bed and check out instructions included us having to empty the bin and find a specific one on the street which I couldn’t find. I ended up walking up and down the streets with a bag of rubbish before I was told I could just leave it for the cleaners.

I had a comfortable, large room. The bathroom was clean. Finding the place was a bit challenging, but not hard if you follow the instructions exactly.   Parking is very difficult in the area. There's a parking garage 500 m away that costs 40 Swiss francs per night.
Lovely host, but…place looks like it had been lived in or used for 20 or 30 years with no attention to standards and quality.
Alan’s listing does not exist. He would not respond to any questions, did not provide check-in instructions. The listing did not exist. We found out the day of arrival and a new country.

terrible place, unlivable, the door has a gap a few centimeters high so you hear everything in each apartment. really bad, can’t get out onto the terrace because the door is blocked by the bed. also the bed is a couch with cushions.

Hey, I stayed for 6 weeks at Christa's place. The place is okay at best, its pretty old and especially my room has weird furniture-structure. One cannot use the couch properly because the desk stands right in front of it. All furniture is pretty old and looks a little bit scrubby.  Location wise, its not optimal. Its already in Oerlikon, which is pretty far away from the city center, but then its also pretty far from the oerlikon train station, so you cannot just jump on a train and go to Zurich main station in 5 min but you have to take a very slow tram to get to Zurich main station.  But the worst thing is the host: I lost the keys to the airbnb, which is honestly my fault. I was willing to pay the cost for replacing the keys, what I always communicated openly. I talked with the Co-Host and she confirmed to me, that the total cost will not be more that 50-60 CHF. I was very fine with that. I just discovered the she requested 880€ for exchanging all the locks. A total overkill, because I lost the keys in a different part of the city without any hint to the address or to my name. She did not explain the sum or why she decided to exchange the locks, she just send me the bill.  There was also another thing: when I lost the keys, I needed a way to enter my room. so I asked if they had an additional key. they said no so we ordered a key-service to open the door. I had to pay for the key-service (which is totally okay). after we ordered the key service, the Co-Host discovered a bunch of keys including a key for my room.  I still had to pay for the key-service, which was a waste of money, because now we had a key now and the Co-Host did not even say sorry or was willing to cover a part of the bill.

I had a wonderful two-night stay at this apartment. Blanca wasn’t present during my visit, so I ended up having the entire place to myself—which was a pleasant and unexpected bonus. Despite not being on-site, Blanca was incredibly responsive and helpful whenever I had questions. She also generously allowed me to check in early and check out late by several hours, which I really appreciated. The apartment was very well stocked and thoughtfully prepared. It was exactly as described in the listing, making for a comfortable and easy stay. The washer and dryer in the basement were a great bonus as well. In terms of location, it’s not very walkable from the main train station or the old town, but it’s just a few minutes on foot to the nearest tram stop, which takes you straight to both in 15–20 minutes. There are also supermarkets and restaurants nearby.  I would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend this place to anyone visiting the area.

First, as a prior commenter said, I found Fernando's explanations of how to get into and out of the apartment to be very unclear and had to repeatedly ask for clarification. Additionally, I found this AirBnB experience to be lacking--when I arrived, I found multiple holes in the sheets that were clearly visible, which Fernando said was due to the cleaner overlooking them. The note that there is a TV present in the room should be taken down. Once I got to the apartment, I asked Fernando why the TV remote had no batteries in it and Fernando explained to me that the TV didn't work; however, I plugged the TV in and it appeared to turn on, so I found this explanation to be a bit strange. Finally, as I was leaving, Fernando essentially asked me if I as going to leave a good review, which I felt was overstepping.

Amin was incredibly helpful/friendly with a great food recommendation as well! Was this the nicest place we’ve stayed at? No. Did it serve exactly what we needed? Yes. It is the epitome of what an Airbnb should be - someone’s home who had the local expertise and care that we loved. Amin had great food recommendations and was one of the most helpful hosts we’ve ever had, even offering to ship a charger that we left at his apartment.  The place was small and the shower wasn’t ideal, but for the 2 nights we stayed, it was exactly what we wanted in the right location for the right price. Very easy to get to from the main Zurich train via a cheap Uber/taxi, and then conveniently located by the stadium and restaurants. We would definitely recommend Amin’s place for anyone looking for a great value in Zurich!
many things are old, for 200 a night, its  not worth it, i will compare this to a cheap Ibis stay at 120 a night...
The bed is terrible the spring really is in bad condition
It is wonderful apartment. With Good location. The hosts fast reply and good communication. It will be my first choice in Zurich

I am sorry to say I was very uncomfortable in this place and we have stayed in many Airbnb's, and I am not picky. The place was not very clean, there were many items in disrepair, the back of the couch would not stay up, the table next to the bed was hanging off the wall, some of the kitchen appliances didn't work properly etc. In addition, it wasn't very well equipped; only 4 bath towels for a family of four for four days. No extra anything, no soap, (other than the half-melted piece of soap in the shower), only 1/2 roll of toilet paper, no extra towels, linens, blankets, or pillows.  The two serious problems are the black mold on the ceiling in the bathroom and the fact that there are no privacy window coverings, only sheers. It is on the main floor, and anyone can see in every window. The host was very responsive the first night when the wifi didn't work and it was easy to get in and easy off the subway, but I don't feel good about recommending this place to others.
A Superhost that more than deserves the title.
Cool little apartment in a central area of Zurich with good links to public transport.

This Airbnb location is not what the renter represents.  We have a disabled child and the elivator does not reach the room location.  They say they have air conditioning but they are simple air units that do not cool the rooms in the summer.  Three units for 7 rooms.  We found the host James to be very dishonest.

This is an attic room in a very quiet neighborhood. Ernst sent very detailed instructions. The weather was hot, but there's an air conditioner in the room. Considering how crazy expensive Zürich is it was a good deal.

Best Airbnb I stayed in :)  Great host. Amazing place. Clean. The host is loving, caring, and supportive. Helped me book my train tickets. Helped me find deals. Helped me with my checkout. They are a joy to talk to. I love the place. I love the people. coming back soon. Merci Simon.
The apartment is next to a tram station which is 10mins from the city center.  Very convenient. But the wooden floor is a bit noisy.
The apartment is only 5 minutes of walk from the central train station. It has the access to the roof with the incredible view. My top-pick for the next Zurich stays.
My son stayed for another month at Jurg’s. Great location and a caring host
Manuel's is an excellent host and his apartment is not only worth what you pay for but is very convenient for any visit to Zurich. Everything was excellent. Highly recommended

The place was good, but few things would have certainly made our stay better. First, the communication was horrible; it took the host over a day to reply, and even when we got a reply, it wasn't helpful at all. There were no what we would consider staples like soap, shampoo, and/or body wash. We had to buy it, which is the first time that has happened with a host. Also, some of the amenities were broken or didn't work, like the dryer, and coffee machine.  If the host had made us aware, we wouldn't have washed our clothes or had to dry them on the balcony where the furniture was dirty and which defeated the point of washing.  When I messaged the host about these things, all I got was I don't use the place often, I don't know.  Best,

Be mindful that this is a business which has multiple apartments under it, so the apartment you pay for may not be the one you ACTUALLY receive. The heat did not turn off in our apartment the entire 3 days. There were multiple stains on the flooring & marks on the walls & floor. Also, no parking available except public roadside (blue zone). This is apart of low income apartment housing, so would not recommend for children or privacy.
The apartment is spacious, clean, and light filled. The location is very convenient to the tram stop at the end of the block.
Giancarlo is fast, reliable and you get what you pay for. Always again!
Good location but little bit noisy as house is old and in the Main Street.

I recently had the pleasure of staying at Cher's apartment, and I couldn't have been more impressed. I was greeted by a pristine and exceptionally clean environment. The attention to detail in maintaining the apartment's cleanliness was very noticeable. It made my stay not only comfortable but also very enjoyable. The apartment is also well located right near Wiedikon bahnhof/train station for quick access to Zurich HB and the airport. There is a Migros grocery store a very short walk away from the apartment. The host was very communicative and helpful during my stay. I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a spotless and aesthetically inviting apartment with modern furnishings in Zurich.

Beginning to end,, horrible stay don’t bother emailing them as they’ll never get back to you,,ever! Even if you’re staying in the hotel, bad business. . If you’re allergic to down pillows & bedding you’re outta luck.. I slept on the floor the first night. If you desire a shower forget it, I’m 5’1”, 107 lbs & I had a hard time in that tomb of a shower,, oh!! And there was no hot water the morning we were leaving,,found that out the hard way by freezing myself senseless!!! And don’t let ‘em tell ya, they’re gona ‘upgrade’ you… bahahaaaaaaa… What saves this miserable place is the nice staff who apparently have their hands tied & are unable to help out the guests. Cool chocolate fountain,, bad stay. I highly recommend ya don’t stay here, total waste of money. There are many other hotels in the area to check out.. do that, not this.

The kitchen is not a proper kitchen and there is no dryer although it has the washing machine. We were in the apartment in the hot summer, we could not open the windows as the street noice was so bad even at night time, the neighbor even talked outside around 10:30pm. That was not nice

In my 15+ years of using Airbnb, this place was the worst experience we've had. Here are 2 things that went wrong that I recommend future users to keep in mind: 1. Place is a STUDIO, not 1 bedroom. It is advertised as 1BR and pictures are taken at right angles not to make it look like studio. Although host describes in listing that place has no walls, yet it is advertised as 1 bedroom and not everyone pays attention to detailed write up. You can find other reviews with same complaints (and hosts's defensive response).   We had an infant with us, so we were stuck in very suboptimal conditions.. 2. On the floor where entrance is, there is a medical clinic next door - hallway smells like ER room and bunch of patients go in and out all day. If you are looking for charming European place to stay, this isn't it - you'll be staying next door to medical office which takes away a lot of vibe. Host was very quick to communicate. Although I could see they got defensive in other reviews
Central location, quite noisy because of the tram. The furniture are quite old and uncomfortable.
Convenient spot, spacious, and has a bakery, pharmacy, grocer, and transit stop all within a block.

While the location was beautiful and initially made the apartment feel exciting, it became clear quickly that we had wildly overpaid for a miserable stay. For this price, go to a 4 star hotel. The whole apartment smelled of wet dog/mildew. It was extremely hot but we couldn’t open the windows because of the mosquitos from the river. There was supposed to be a fan but it had a large vent out the back that would produce hot air. The patio cushions were not on the chairs, instead in a broken box that had water mold/ damage. The kitchen was dirty and no paper towels or napkins, only old rags under the sink, the trash bag was too small for the trash can. The bathroom with the washer and dryer was the worst part of the whole experience: she had left wet towels in the dryer and it seemed the dryer was not very useful. We had to run HER laundry for her twice before taking it out. There were no towels left for us, Roxanda told us to use some from the closet. They smelled heavily of mildew.

Lovely apartment with ideal location  nice view on the lake. There are two independent zones in the apartment, it is ideal for persons who wants to keep privacy. There is a nice room for work, where we had brainstorming with our colleagues. The apartment includes all necessary items that may be needed during residence. Jan  is very responsible, kind and hospitable. We strictly recommend this apartment for everyone who arrives for leisure and for business.
House was perfect but service not really satisfying. My family is not pleasant with the attitude when the host replying the message. Tv not working and don't bother to come to the house to fix it.

Having use Airbnb platform several times for professional reasons and still continuing to do so, I believe I never had such issues encounter with the property owner of this flat.  It has been a real surprise when after having been informed of the presence of technicians for reparation in the flat during my stay (programmed with the presence of the property owner and when not having had the choice to say no to it) I discovered two technicians when coming back to the flat in the middle of the afternoon, with the door of the flat largely opened without any property owner with them... ! In addition to such disrespect of the common sens of safety rules and respect of the tenants rights, the last day of my stay I had to check out for 10 am, the housekeeper enter also in the flat at 9:30am like a ghost ... Surprised, I have left the flat 30 mins after the normal time of check out as I took slightly longer time to pack and finish some emails. So at 10:30 after having receive the call of the property owner by the intermediary of the housekeeper, saying that I should leave “IMMEDIATELY” the flat as I was passing the check out time (I was taken some how and listen to him, as a kind of robber !) I took the time to redact a message for all users of Airbnb and, would NOT recommend to pass throughout the flats own by this property owner to anybody, as the risk of facing such disrespectful behavior no respect of tenants rights and bad treatment is high.  All simples rules of intimacy aren’t respected from the property owner a side of clear irrespective behavior with his tenants. In this matter please note that an email has also been sent to Airbnb staff.
Excellent host and stay, in a nice and quiet area. The communication was superb and me and my partner had a very pleasant stay. The local recommendations also came to good use!

Nice apartment, great location with car. But we had problems checking in, tried contacting airbnb host, she didnt answer. When calling Blueground we spoke to Dexter, he was very disrespectful and no help at all left us waiting 2 hours in the cold. We after spoke to Eleyna and helped us check in.

It's located very close to Zurich HB. Surrounded by restaurants and bars. That's a big plus. The big negative i had was that it was smelling very bad.  There is a smoke shop in the ground floor of this building. So, our room was smelling very very bad. We can't even open the windows to get fresh air. Had the host has mentioned about the smoke shop, I would have never booked this place.

No lift, stairway is narrow and dark at night, not recommended for family with large luggages, have to climb 2 flights of stairs.  Very noisy with the bar at the ground floor. Bathroom floor don't have proper irrigation, which make it flooded after using the shower. Portable fans are listed, but host denied it, saying that I should be glad to have it, and they are not working properly, one can't rotate, another fan stand is not stable.  Dryer is not provided but listed, only washing machine is provided.
I had a good stay at Sonja's. No issues what so ever.

In 50+ stays I've never left a rating below 4 stars. This space has high ratings in general, so it is confusing why my experience was so negative. Perhaps it is being managed or maintained by new people. Below is the summary I left for Max and Vika of issues. I gave them the opportunity to correct this by issuing a partial refund, but they ignored this. In the end AirBnb agreed with my issue and gave me a $200 refund. Judge for yourself if this is the type of place you'd like to stay. I would not stay here again. BEDROOM: Hair (human and or animal) in bed upon arrival (photos provided).  KITCHEN: Lack of large cutting knife or spatula, damaged non-stick cookware (dangerous so unable to cook), non functioning and foul smelling dishwasher, forced to wash the last tenant’s dishes. GENERAL: Noise from upstairs construction from 8pm to 12AM on an evening (unable to ask them to stop as it is an illegal AirBnb and I was requested not to reveal this), broken light bulbs in 5 of the lights.

Nice location close to a tram stop and with a great view over the city. The room was small but equipped with all necessities and even a small coffee machine. There are common bathrooms and a kitchen, which is unfortunately a little small and you have to eat in your room, which can be a bit of a nuisance for longer stays.

Place was clean and specious.  We were disappointed due to noise at night from surrounding parties.  There were constant loud noises at night until 2-3 AM.  We were not able to sleep due to noise.  You can’t keep the windows closed since there is no A/C and only one portable fan.  I would not recommend the place for family.

After we checked out, they said we need to pay $250 for stains on pillows which was there before we checked in, after many discussions also they asked us to pay $250 otherwise they said we have to pay $450. Finally we’ve paid $250 for the damages which we have not done any wrong. Request everyone to take photos of everything after chek in otherwise you have to pay big amounts after check out.
Everything is as written and what you see on the pics. Great location, quiet yet central. Smooth check in, clean place, well equipped.
Nice and cozy apartment! Great location and super calm neighborhood. Also, amazing views to part of the city and Uetliberg mountain.

It was interesting. I walked in and saw what it seemed was a friend leaving a friend a note. It was the previous guest saying goodbye. Michael is like that , a very friendly accommodating guy who wants his guests to have a good time. Totally recommended especially nice pillows. Thanks Michal. Enjoy your holiday.

Many issues with this booking, please read carefully before booking your stay. This is the first time I’m leaving a negative review.  1. The oven was very dirty and the host even asked us to put the tray in the dishwasher to clean for him. We simply put our handbags on the sofa but the host accused us of using the sofa in the living room.   2. The host accused us of damaging his table and wanted us to pay more than £2000 as compensation. We did not cause any damage to the table.   3. The host contacted me privately on my private number, amounting to an intrusion of privacy. This made me feel very unsafe and Airbnb has yet to specifically address this.   4. The host also accused us of hosting additional guests based on the number of chairs at the dining table. I am very disappointed that the host decided to report me over “damages” that we did not cause. Proceed with caution.

I recommend the accommodation. Great transport accessibility. Accommodation clean, equipped. Corresponds to the photos. A little noisier traffic outside, but we didn't mind. The accommodation is really small, about 10cm from the bed is the entrance door, but it's enough for a night's sleep.

PLAce of TANIA is recommended for  big family.  Too big fo us since we are just 3 pax. But the TOWELS provided is not enough for us since i got only 1 big and 2 small which is not enough for our 4 days  3 nights stay.  Heater is not enough to WARM the whole place.  It is  winter time and we have to use jacket inside the house i was expecting to feel comfortable inside to WARM us but was so dissapointed with the heater.    HAd also problem with the TV. It takes time for us to find out how to open a simple TV. KItchen and Tablewares incomplete too.   Location is far from CENTRo but there is grocery nearby a few blocks away from the unit.  Some stores beside the buildings too.   TRAM is just across the bldg.    Washer/Driver - at the basement.  Not inside the Unit.  Elevator was included in the amenities but not allowed if your not a unit owner. had a problem carrying our 3 big luggages since Tania's unit is at the 2nd floor.

My experience was significantly impacted by very poor communication from Tobi. Despite requesting check-in instructions in advance, they were never sent and I received no response to my messages. I spent nearly three hours trying to get in touch and ultimately had to contact Airbnb support to access the apartment. Upon arrival, I found dirty underwear left in the closet, which raised serious concerns about the cleaning standards. I also reported that the hair dryer was not working, but again received no response or assistance. For check-out, I followed all instructions, including taking out the trash as requested. However, it was disappointing that basic cleanliness had not been ensured prior to my arrival. Check-out instructions were sent with repeated reminders about the 9:00 a.m. time, despite my delayed check-in due to lack of communication. Overall, I would not stay here again and recommend confirming responsiveness before booking.
Very clean, excellent location, friendly host, will come again.
This place is a scam. They took our money and never gave us check in instructions. We never got in and had to find a new place to stay. Stay away from any swissstay airbnbs. They are a scam!

The place was as described. It was spacious, bright and functional. However it is run by an Airbnb company not a person. The whole building is run by a company. This isn't clear in the listing as they call themselves Cher. This made it lack of character, didn't have a "home feel" and had standard cheap furniture. There was a lot of echo throughout the appartement and the TV sound was terrible. We couldn't have it on loud enough to hear it if someone was trying to sleep in on of the bedrooms. There were many emails being sent with complicated instructions on how to self check-in, whether we got there, if everything was ok from multiple different people in the company. The apartment was clean except for the floors that had residual shoe prints as if it had been vacuumed but not mopped. Or like someone stepped on wet floor with shoes. All round ok for a couple of nights but a very expensive couple of nights for what you get. Definitely not the best value in town.
Place is great for transportation, restaurants, shopping and easy to get around.   Spacious and well maintained.  Highly recommend.

The stay was a nightmare. We were 2 females with kids. We reached a little early for which they asked to pay extra amount to keep our luggage in the basement. The payment to their link was not going through and without any consideration they declined our request. We had to wait outside, the building for 2 hours with kids sitting on pavement. There was no mop for cleaning the house.  When we asked for cleaning person to clean the bathroom and kitchen  for our 3 day stay they blatantly refused and asked for extra money if we need cleaning. Morever, they have asked for exhorbitant amount after we left with false claim of burning their sheets, for house cleaning which they specifically told us would be done only when we leave.  They expected us to clean their bathroom, kitchen and tidy up the entire house before leaving which was impossible (we had to catch an early morning flight) and also not informed while booking. Exteremly Bad Host & Horrendous Experience. Airbnb should take action.
A lovely room, cosy and warm. Comfortable bed and a great location (1 tram of 10 mins away from Zurich HB) The hosts are super with communication and really kind! Thank you, I would recommend.

There was miscommunication between the host and my family and it turned into an argument.  The host decided to kick us out of the home in the middle of the night in a new country when we also had a 6year old kid with us. She told us she didn't want us here and she would give us a refund. Once we got our luggage out of the home, I assume wanted a way to keep our money so literally as she kicked us out she said if you really have to stay here's a key. That way the cancelation was in our hands and that way she didn't have to give the money back to us. We didn't end up living there. We were disappointed.

The worst experience of my airbnb journey. The check in was rude and gave me no information. I didn’t even receive a key for my door so was unsafe and could not reach my host. I messaged about it and she didn’t listen then I messaged again and didn’t hear from her for 6+ hours until she obviously heard from the Airbnb team. Even then she refused to accept what I was telling her, She refused a refund despite it being unsafe for me to stay in. I had to go and find a last minute hotel to stay in.
Rafael’s place was exactly as described in the listing. He was a very communicative host and flexible with the check-in. The apartment is in walking distance of Zürich HB and is very convenient.

The space is quite different in person -- I almost thought we'd missed the door. Technically, most things are accurate, but the wording is misleading and the photos are very flattering. For example, the listing says that the space is a one bedroom, but later on mentions that one of the rooms is actually locked - so you're effectively getting a studio, but you won't know that unless you are reading very carefully. The description makes it sound like there's a usable living room in addition to the sleeping area, but this is not true: you'd have to both fold the bed AND move the couch around to create a living area. One major inaccuracy is that the listing says that there are no stairs, but this is not true: there's a flight of stairs to the door of the building, and two flights to the apartment. Lastly, there was an unpleasant musty smell that made the place unpleasant to be around. Not the best stay, but Kathrin was very lovely!

Home was lived in, looked as someone had just left, including dishes on the counter.  It was free of any other clutter but the lived in feel made us so uncomfortable and we were not willing to stay.  We left after an hour, and still had to pay full price.  Our expectations were too high based on previous stays, something closer to a hotel.  We relocated to a hotel.
Easy and great location for exploring Zurich! Lovely staff and fab rooms!

This is a basic accommodation as explained in the listing. The amenities are old but in decent condition. Be aware that the bed linen and towel is not provided but can be rented at 25 SF. The shared bathroom is clean and in good condition. Location and public transportation options are the best advantage of this accommodation.

It wasn't translated into the Italian language that there is ongoing reconstruction next to the apartment. We were woken up at 7 am and had to leave our accommodation.  We spent the whole week trying to get our money back. Unfortunately, this is a mistake from the Airbnb platform and not the owner. So be careful and read all info carefully. It's impossible to spend more than one night there. Location and place are pretty.
It’s a appartement really nice really clean with good location. Tania is a good proprietor, very professional. I really recommend this appartement!!!

Thank you for a clean and tidy convenient location for us to stay in on our international travels it was noisy due to construction and a small Appartments but the place its self was need tidy and accommodating.
Location was central, you can reach anywhere’s within 10 mins walk.
The apartment was exactly as described in the listing. Patrick was in constant touch and very helpful before and during the stay. Our stay was very pleasent.

We had a terrible experience on Christmas Eve when checking into our apartment in Zurich. Our plan was to celebrate Christmas and enjoy the Xmas market, but unfortunately, it turned into a nightmare. Upon arrival, we encountered a steep slope leading to the apartment, but that was only the beginning. After collecting the keys, we discovered a spider staircase with over 20 steps, which was not disclosed to us. We were left wondering how to carry our luggage up to the 2nd floor. Things only got worse upon entering the apartment. We were shocked to find the kitchen dustbin unemptied. The common bedroom toilet had an unemptied dustbin and terrible brown stains on the towels. The master bedroom We were extremely upset with the entire check-in process and the unprofessional cleaning of the unit. With no other choice, we called Airbnb to cancel our stay. This last-minute cancellation forced us to search for a hotel at the highest rates, making our Christmas Eve even more stressful.

What we liked the most is its location - very close to a lot of restaurants, supermarket, the train/tram station, and the Lake Zurich! Apart from the following very minor comments, our stay at Gerard's place was nothing but great!  1. No sponge included for washing the dishes 2. Would have been better if the body wash was placed in the toilet/restroom instead of putting it in the kitchen cabinet as then we would have not needed to buy body soap.

The host was friendly but communication was lacking. She went out for the evening/night, and when we asked when she’d be back (as we were uncomfortable with someone returning in the early hours while we were asleep), we got no answer. Her two cats hadn’t been fed (due to the host being out all evening) and were begging us for food. One even vomited in our room on the first day, which we had to clean , the litter tray is also kept in the bathroom. The bed was extremely uncomfortable—the worst sleep I’ve had. The noise from the road outside was constant, and there was no blind on the glass balcony window, so we were woken early by the light. No proper storage—just two flimsy hangers. A bare bulb dangled by the bed with no lampshade. The front door was always left unlocked, which didn’t feel safe. We did self check-in, which was fine, but when we saw the host later, she didn’t introduce herself—just awkwardly said hi from across the room with her boyfriend. Overall, a disappointing stay.

This could have been a nice Airbnb - location is okay and the space well organised -, but the failed on the core and essential feature, i.e. beds and blankets.  While i asked for 2 beds to be made, the housekeeping only made one, and furthermore, in both cases, forgot to add sufficient blants. The heating was insufficient and we were cold the whole night. Bed sheets were not even that clean.  Would not recommend.

I am so sorry to say that this apartment is not a family friendly accommodation. We are a family of 4 parents and 2 children of 12 and 16 years old. The apartment has  3 separate occupancy in which we stayed in a 2 joined bedrooms. The owner stayed in the other bed room and there was another occupant in the other bedroom. In the website it was mentioned that that only the owner will be sharing the apartment with us. However there was another occupant in that apartment. This is misleading as decided to take apartment as it was mentioned that only the owner will be sharing the apartment with us. Moreover none of the rooms including the bedrooms had key and lock. We felt uncomfortable and unsafe. This made us to carry all our personal belongings wherever we travelled. Though the rooms looked clean from outside there was lot of dust under the bed and the piano which caused some allergic cough. We used the apartment only to sleep at night, we were out during day time. One morning we were hurrying up to get the train on time at around 9am and talking in a NORMAL VOICE, the owner came and shouted at us accusing that we were making lot of noise. It was 9AM in the morning.My children got very scared and the whole day was ruined. Since that incident children stopped talking when we enter the flat as they felt uncomfortable and panicking. This is not a family friendly accommodation. Unfortunately we didn’t feel real sense of hospitality .

Misleading listing. There is only 1 toilet (not 2). The description of  the bathrooms: one with a toilet and shower, the other one with a tub/shower. Then the Bathroom photos and description: Full Bathroom 1 (photo) and Full Bathroom 2 (Photo). A "Full Bathroom" includes a toilet, Google it. Funny how sinks weren't mentioned but both bathrooms had them. Speaking of sinks, one of the sinks is cracked and tile is missing under another sink.  We also found hair under the remote control and the inside of the medicine cabinet was dirty. Despite this both the host and airbnb claim no violation was made.

As someone who travels for about six months a year, this was one of the worst check-in experiences I have had. When I arrived, the key would not come out of the key box. I contacted them through both Airbnb and messaging app around 2:00 PM, but only received a reply at 3:40 PM. The reply was not a real solution, only telling me to contact the technical team. The technical team could only be contacted by phone, not messaging app, which is very difficult for travelers who are not comfortable speaking the local language or English by phone. I had to wait outside on the street for about an hour and a half. Luckily, I met a staff member by chance and she helped me get inside. Without her, I would likely have waited outside for at least another 3 to 4 hours. The view was nice, but the new-building chemical smell made my throat and airways uncomfortable. Overall, I was very disappointed by the poor communication and check-in support.

Very centrally location, opposite a tram line and two local shops opposite which stock everything you need. The tripple windows block out any noise from the road. Kitchen is well stocked and apartment is modern. Only issue is in a heatwave its too hot even with the internal ventilation system. Ask for two fans and leave windows open. The temperature when we stayed was 37 degrees.

we only stayed one night, before our flight at Zurich Airport.  it got the job done, it was a simple room with ample closet space. host was very communicative and provided photos for how to locate the building.

We were disappointed with the size of the space, the lack of areas to put away clothes and most of all the communication response time was over a week. Overall a disappointing experience and the hosts did not care to make the situation better.
very near the tram so that’s a plus. It is hostel-run so they’re not the usual individually-owned type of house you will usually see in airbnb - nothing against that though.

The flat is great, but sadly it’s managed poorly by Keys’n’fly. When asking Marc for assistance his answer was complete silence radio. Also there was no shampoo nor body wash and no garbage bags (according to Marc’s instructions, garbage can be disposed in the container next to the flat - at no time did he mention that in Zurich, garbage can only be disposed in official taxed bags. If we had followed his instructions we’d have exposed us to considerable fines for illegal waste disposal!). The flat was well furnished and clean, though it’s next to Zurich’s slaughterhouse and the smell of death kept us awake at night. Not a good place to stay if you’re a vegetarian
Thomas was very responsive from my arrival to my departure. There was no city noise, my room faced a courtyard. “Clean” is an understatement regarding his place!
Host allows us early check-in that allows to drop luggage and saved half day for sightseeing.  A man's flat with corresponding approach to organisation of everything.

The good: Host was very friendly and communication was smooth. Neighborhood is pretty quiet, and for me was walking distance to the center (about 15min to Opera, 20min to main train station with luggage). The bad: It was very difficult to find the key for the appt. The instructions say to open the mailbox, but it's unmarked (so you have to open everyone's mailbox). As soon as you enter the common area, a bad smell is present. No schuko sockets are available for charging. The rooms are separated with drywall and there is zero sound proofing/privacy. The ugly: Both bathroom (especially) as well as my room were pretty dirty. Room and bed were very dusty with hair, and bathroom was very dusty, toilet wasn't properly cleaned, and there even was some mold in the wall.

Dimi was a great host, the place clean and spacious. It wasn’t the apartment we had originally booked - we had to relocate due to a water problem - but Dimi took great care of us. Would definitely stay there again.

I had a wonderful stay at the Apartment on Universitatstrasse. The location is unbeatable — right in the center, with shops, cafes, and public transport just steps away. The apartment was spotless, well-equipped, and exactly as described in the listing. The bed was very comfortable, and the kitchen had everything I needed for my stay. Communication with the host was smooth and prompt, making check-in and check-out a breeze. I especially appreciated the thoughtful touches that made it feel like a home away from home. I would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting the area!
The size of bed is small and it was not comfortable quality of bed is not proper so while sleep its go inside from centre and moving

Amazing place to stay in Zurich! A really fun and pretty area to walk around with plenty to do! Plus the duplex was beautiful and had everything you could ever need! Fran was a great host! 10/10 all around!

The apartment and its facilities and furnishing were clean and well maintained.  Not so great in terms of location as one had to still take a bus/tram from the Zurich main railway station with heavy luggage. There is a park/playground directly opposite the apartment and there were many eateries and a supermarket nearby.

Very bad! The nice area suggests a good place, but you will find a shitty small one room apartment, with a nasty bed (though washed, but full of hair, spots and dust balls). No working ceiling light, but a power outlet that falls apart when you touch it (dangerous if you‘re not careful), mould in the super small bathroom, ugly spots on the carpet, and just no atmosphere you wanna spend time, let alone sleep in. The Owner agreed to pay back the money after i left for a hotel, but he said he would only do so if i didnt leave a bad comment, which is borderline extortion. Also, he didnt pay back all.  Way too expensive for what it is, a four star hotel is cheaper. If theres nothing else available, and you get drunk anyways and just need a place to crash, you may consider it because of where it‘s at, but its definitely nothing to spend a weekend with your partner or anything like that.
I do reccomend you to stay at this house!!!
Great location and very spacious apartment. toilet is outside but very private so no issues.

My wife and I are on a world tour of South America, Central America, Europe, and the Middle East.  We have passed through many countries, always using Airbnb.  Of the close to ten places we have stayed so far, this was the worst!  Beata promised me they had internet (using the word "promise") but they do not really have internet.  After 24 hours without it, I had to "call in sick" to my job.  I lost the money, and afterward, Beata agreed that it would be fair to reimburse me for what I lost.  This, unfortunately, was a way to get me to stay at her place past the 24 hour check-in period... thus, lose the chance to move to an appropriate location.  She did not refund anything (once again breaking her word.)  I found out later by reading negative reviews of other guests that she actually knew the internet did not work at the time she promised me everything was fine!  In the end, I advise people to stay away from this apartment.  They will say whatever they think you want you to hear to get you to stay.  Be aware, honesty is not something you will find with the woman renting this place!
Very nice place and they were able to keep our luggage before our check in time  while we went on a tour.
